1.judgment_es: Éxito sublime. La perseverancia es favorable.
1.judgment_it: Successo sublime. La perseveranza è favorevole.
lines_zh: 初九：潛龍勿用。
九二：見龍在田，利見大人。
九三：君子終日乾乾，夕惕若厲，無咎。
九四：或躍在淵，無咎。
九五：飛龍在天，利見大人。
上九：亢龍有悔。
lines_en: First nine: Hidden dragon. Do not act.
Nine in the second place: Dragon appearing in the field. It furthers one to see the great man.
Nine in the third place: The superior man is creatively active all day. At nightfall his mind is still beset with cares. Danger. No blame.
Nine in the fourth place: Wavering flight over the depths. No blame.
Nine in the fifth place: Flying dragon in the heavens. It furthers one to see the great man.
Nine at the top: Arrogant dragon will have cause to repent.
1.commentary_desc: Khien (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and firm. [King Wen's utterances.]
commentary_reading: In the first (or lowest) nine, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon lying hid (in the deep). It is not the time for active doing.
In the second nine, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon appearing in the field. It will be advantageous to meet with the great man.

In the third nine, undivided, (we see its subject as) the superior man active and vigilant all the day, and in the evening still careful and apprehensive. (The position is) dangerous, but there will be no mistake.
In the fourth nine, undivided, (we see its subject as the dragon looking) as if he were leaping up, but still in the deep. There will be no mistake.
In the fifth nine, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon on the wing in the sky. It will be advantageous to meet with the great man.
In the sixth (or topmost) nine, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon exceeding the proper limits. There will be occasion for repentance.

(The lines of this hexagram are all strong and undivided, as appears from) the use of the number nine. If the host of dragons (thus) appearing were to divest themselves of their heads, there would be good fortune. [The points are a duke's additions]

image.image_zh: 天行健，君子以自強不息。
image.image_en: Heaven's movement is full of power. Thus the superior man makes himself strong and untiring.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El movimiento del cielo es lleno de poder. Así el hombre superior se hace fuerte e incansable.
image.image_it: Il movimento del cielo è pieno di potere. Così l'uomo superiore si rende forte e instancabile.

tuan.tuan_zh: 大哉乾元，萬物資始，乃統天。雲行雨施，品物流形。大明終始，六位時成，時乘六龍以御天。乾道變化，各正性命，保合大和，乃利貞。首出庶物，萬國咸寧。
tuan.tuan_en: Vast is the 'great and originating (power)' indicated by Qian! All things owe to it their beginning: it contains all the meaning belonging to (the name) heaven. The clouds move and the rain is distributed; the various things appear in their developed forms. (The sages) grandly understand (the connexion between) the end and the beginning, and how (the indications of) the six lines (in the hexagram) are accomplished, (each) in its season. (Accordingly) they mount (the carriage) drawn by those six dragons at the proper times, and drive through the sky.
tuan.source: Tuan Zhuan (彖傳 - Commentary on the Decision), Zhou Yi (周易)

lines_es: Primera línea nueve: Dragón oculto. No actúes.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Dragón que aparece en el campo. Conviene ver al gran hombre.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: El hombre superior es activo todo el día. Al anochecer su espíritu sigue atento. Peligro. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Vuelo vacilante sobre las profundidades. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Dragón volador en los cielos. Conviene ver al gran hombre.
Nueve en lo alto: El dragón arrogante tendrá causa para arrepentirse.
lines_it: Prima linea nove: Drago nascosto. Non agire.
Nove al secondo posto: Il drago appare nel campo. È favorevole vedere il grande uomo.
Nove al terzo posto: Il nobile è attivo tutto il giorno. All'imbrunire la sua mente è ancora sollecita. Pericolo. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al quarto posto: Volo vacillante sulle profondità. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al quinto posto: Drago volante nei cieli. È favorevole vedere il grande uomo.
Nove in cima: Il drago arrogante avrà motivo di pentirsi.

2.judgment_zh: 元亨，利牝馬之貞。君子有攸往，先迷後得主，利西南得朋，東北喪朋。安貞吉。
2.judgment_en: Sublime success. The perseverance of a mare is favorable. The superior man has an undertaking: first he goes astray, later he finds guidance. Favorable in the southwest to find friends, in the northeast to lose friends. Quiet perseverance brings good fortune.
lines_zh: 初六：履霜，堅冰至。
六二：直方大，不習無不利。
六三：含章可貞，或從王事，無成有終。
六四：括囊，無咎無譽。
六五：黃裳，元吉。
上六：龍戰于野，其血玄黃。
2.commentary_desc: Khwan (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and having the firmness of a mare. When the superior man (here intended) has to make any movement, if he take the initiative, he will go astray; if he follow, he will find his (proper) lord. The advantageousness will be seen in his getting friends in the south-west, and losing friends in the north-east. If he rest in correctness and firmness, there will be good fortune.
commentary_reading: In the first six, divided, (we see its subject) treading on hoarfrost. The strong ice will come (by and by).
The second six, divided, (shows the attribute of) being straight, square, and great. (Its operation), without repeated efforts, will be in every respect advantageous.

The third six, divided, (shows its subject) keeping his excellence under restraint, but firmly maintaining it. If he should have occasion to engage in the king's service, though he will not claim the success (for himself), he will bring affairs to a good issue.
The fourth six, divided, (shows the symbol of a sack tied up. There will be no ground for blame or for praise.
The fifth six, divided, (shows) the yellow lower garment. There will be great good fortune.
The sixth six, divided (shows) dragons fighting in the wild. Their blood is purple and yellow.
(The lines of this hexagram are all weak and divided, as appears from) the use of the number six. If those (who are thus represented) be perpetually correct and firm, advantage will arise.

image.image_zh: 地勢坤，君子以厚德載物。
image.image_en: The earth's condition is receptive devotion. Thus the superior man who has breadth of character carries the outer world.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: La condición de la tierra es la devoción receptiva. Así el hombre superior que tiene amplitud de carácter sostiene al mundo exterior.
image.image_it: La condizione della terra è la devozione ricettiva. Così l'uomo superiore che ha ampiezza di carattere porta il mondo esteriore.

tuan.tuan_zh: 至哉坤元，萬物資生，乃順承天。坤厚載物，德合無疆。含弘光大，品物咸亨。牝馬地類，行地無疆，柔順利貞。君子攸行，先迷失道，後順得常。西南得朋，乃與類行。東北喪朋，乃終有慶。安貞之吉，應地無疆。
tuan.tuan_en: Complete is the 'great and originating (capacity)' indicated by Kun! All things owe to it their birth; it receives obediently the influences of Heaven. Kun, in its largeness, supports and contains all things. Its excellent capacity matches the unlimited power (of Qian). Its comprehension is wide, and its brightness great. The various things obtain (by it) their full development.
tuan.source: Tuan Zhuan (彖傳 - Commentary on the Decision), Zhou Yi (周易)

lines_en: Six at the beginning: When there is hoarfrost underfoot, solid ice is not far off.
Six in the second place: Straight, square, great. Without purpose, yet nothing remains unfurthered.
Six in the third place: Hidden lines. One is able to remain persevering. If by chance you are in the service of a king, seek not works, but bring to completion.
Six in the fourth place: A tied-up sack. No blame, no praise.
Six in the fifth place: A yellow lower garment brings supreme good fortune.
Six at the top: Dragons fight in the meadow. Their blood is black and yellow.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Cuando hay escarcha bajo los pies, el hielo sólido no está lejos.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Recto, cuadrado, grande. Sin propósito, pero nada queda sin favorecer.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Líneas ocultas. Uno es capaz de permanecer perseverante. Si por casualidad sirves a un rey, no busques obras, sino lleva a término.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Un saco atado. Sin culpa, sin alabanza.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Una prenda inferior amarilla trae suprema buena fortuna.
Seis en lo alto: Los dragones luchan en el prado. Su sangre es negra y amarilla.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Quando c'è brina sotto i piedi, il ghiaccio solido non è lontano.
Sei al secondo posto: Retto, quadrato, grande. Senza scopo, ma nulla rimane senza essere favorito.
Sei al terzo posto: Linee nascoste. Si è capaci di rimanere perseveranti. Se per caso servite un re, non cercate opere, ma portate a termine.
Sei al quarto posto: Un sacco legato. Nessuna colpa, nessuna lode.
Sei al quinto posto: Una veste inferiore gialla porta suprema buona fortuna.
Sei in cima: I dragoni combattono nel prato. Il loro sangue è nero e giallo.
2.judgment_es: Éxito sublime. La perseverancia de la yegua es favorable. El hombre superior tiene un empeño: primero se extravía, luego encuentra guía. Es favorable en el suroeste encontrar amigos, en el noreste perder amigos. La perseverancia tranquila trae buena fortuna.
2.judgment_it: Successo sublime. La perseveranza della cavalla è favorevole. L'uomo nobile ha un'impresa: prima si smarrisce, poi trova guida. È favorevole nel sud-ovest trovare amici, nel nord-est perderli. La perseveranza tranquilla porta buona fortuna.

3.judgment_zh: 元亨，利貞，勿用有攸往，利建侯。
3.judgment_en: Sublime success. Perseverance furthers. Nothing should be undertaken. It furthers one to appoint helpers.
3.commentary_desc: In (the state indicated by) Kien advantage will be found in the south-west, and the contrary in the north-east. It will be advantageous (also) to meet with the great man. (In these circumstances), with firmness and correctness, there will be good fortune.
commentary_reading: From the first six, divided, we learn that advance (on the part of its subject) will lead to (greater) difficulties, while remaining stationary will afford ground for praise.
The second six, divided, shows the minister of the king struggling with difficulty on difficulty, and not with a view to his own advantage.
The third nine, undivided, shows its subject advancing, (but only) to (greater) difficulties. He remains stationary, and returns (to his former associates).
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject advancing, (but only) to (greater) difficulties. He remains stationary, and unites (with the subject of the line above).
The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject struggling with the greatest difficulties, while friends are coming to help him.

The topmost six, divided, shows its subject going forward, (only to increase) the difficulties, while his remaining stationary will be (productive of) great (merit). There will be good fortune, and it will be advantageous to meet with the great man.

image.image_zh: 雲雷屯，君子以經綸。
image.image_en: Clouds and thunder: The image of Difficulty at the Beginning. Thus the superior man brings order out of confusion.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Las nubes y el trueno: La imagen de la Dificultad en el Comienzo. Así el hombre superior trae orden de la confusión.
image.image_it: Le nuvole e il tuono: L'immagine della Difficoltà all'Inizio. Così l'uomo superiore porta ordine dal caos.

lines_zh: 初九：磐桓，利居貞，利建侯。
六二：屯如邅如，乘馬班如，匪寇婚媾，女子貞不字，十年乃字。
六三：即鹿無虞，惟入于林中，君子幾不如舍，往吝。
六四：乘馬班如，求婚媾，往吉，無不利。
九五：屯其膏，小貞吉，大貞凶。
上六：乘馬班如，泣血漣如。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Hesitation and hindrance. It furthers one to remain persevering. It furthers one to appoint helpers.

Six in the second place: Difficulties pile up. Horse and wagon part. He is not a robber; he wants to woo when the time comes. The maiden is chaste, she does not pledge herself. Ten years--then she pledges herself.

Six in the third place: Whoever hunts deer without the forester only loses his way in the forest. The superior man understands the signs of the time and prefers to desist. To go on brings humiliation.
Six in the fourth place: Horse and wagon part. Strive for union. To go brings good fortune. Everything acts to further.
Nine in the fifth place: Difficulties in blessing. A little perseverance brings good fortune. Great perseverance brings misfortune.
Six at the top: Horse and wagon part. Bloody tears flow.
3.judgment_es: Éxito sublime. La perseverancia favorece. No se debe emprender nada. Favorece al hombre nombrar ayudantes.
3.judgment_it: Successo sublime. La perseveranza favorisce. Non si deve intraprendere nulla. È favorevole all'uomo nominare aiutanti.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Vacilación e impedimento. Favorece al hombre permanecer perseverante. Favorece al hombre nombrar ayudantes.

Seis en el segundo lugar: Las dificultades se acumulan. El caballo y el carro se separan. No es un ladrón; quiere cortejar cuando llegue el momento. La doncella es casta, no se compromete. Diez años —entonces se compromete.

Seis en el tercer lugar: Quien caza ciervos sin el guardabosque solo pierde el camino en el bosque. El hombre superior entiende las señales del tiempo y prefiere desistir. Seguir adelante trae humillación.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: El caballo y el carro se separan. Se busca la unión. Ir trae buena fortuna. Todo actúa para favorecer.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Dificultades en bendecir. Un poco de perseverancia trae buena fortuna. Gran perseverancia trae desgracia.
Seis en lo alto: El caballo y el carro se separan. Lágrimas de sangre fluyen.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Esitazione e impedimento. È favorevole all'uomo rimanere perseverante. È favorevole all'uomo nominare aiutanti.

Sei al secondo posto: Le difficoltà si accumulano. Il cavallo e il carro si separano. Non è un ladro; vuole corteggiare quando arriva il momento. La fanciulla è casta, non si impegna. Dieci anni —poi si impegna.
Sei al terzo posto: Chi caccia cervi senza il guardaboschi perde solo la strada nella foresta. L'uomo nobile comprende i segni del tempo e preferisce desistere. Andare avanti porta umiliazione.
Sei al quarto posto: Il cavallo e il carro si separano. Si cerca l'unione. Andare porta buona fortuna. Tutto agisce per favorire.
Nove al quinto posto: Difficoltà nel benedire. Un po' di perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Grande perseveranza porta sventura.
Sei in cima: Il cavallo e il carro si separano. Lacrime di sangue scorrono.

4.judgment_zh: 亨。匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我。初筮告，再三瀆，瀆則不告。利貞。
4.judgment_en: Success. It is not I who seek the young fool; the young fool seeks me. At the first oracle I inform him. If he asks two or three times, it is importunity. Perseverance furthers.
4.commentary_desc: In (the state indicated by) Kieh advantage will be found in the south-west. If no (further) operations be called for, there will be good fortune in coming back (to the old conditions). If some operations be called for, there will be good fortune in the early conducting of them.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows that its subject will commit no error.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject catch, in hunting, three foxes, and obtain the yellow (=golden) arrows. With firm correctness there will be good fortune.

The third six, divided, shows a porter with his burden, (yet) riding in a carriage. He will (only) tempt robbers to attack him. However firm and correct he may (try to) be, there will be cause for regret.
(To the subject of) the fourth nine, undivided, (it is said), 'Remove your toes. Friends will (then) come, between you and whom there will be mutual confidence.'

The fifth six, divided, shows (its subject), the superior man (=the ruler), executing his function of removing (whatever is injurious to the idea of the hexagram), in which case there will be good fortune, and confidence in him will be shown even by the small men.
In the sixth six, divided, we see a feudal prince (with his bow) shooting at a falcon on the top of a high wall, and hitting it. (The effect of his action) will be in every way advantageous.

image.image_zh: 山下出泉，蒙。君子以果行育德。
image.image_en: A spring wells up at the foot of the mountain: The image of Youth. Thus the superior man fosters his character by thoroughness in all that he does.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Debajo de la montaña brota una fuente: La imagen de la Necedad Juvenil. Así el hombre superior fomenta su carácter por medio de la diligencia en la acción.
image.image_it: Sotto la montagna sgorga una fonte: L'immagine della Fanciullezza. Così l'uomo superiore coltiva il suo carattere mediante la diligenza nell'azione.

lines_zh: 初六：發蒙，利用刑人，用說桎梏，以往吝。
九二：包蒙吉，納婦吉，子克家。
六三：勿用取女，見金夫，不有躬，無攸利。
六四：困蒙，吝。
六五：童蒙，吉。
上九：擊蒙，不利為寇，利御寇。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: To make a fool develop it furthers one to apply discipline. The fetters should be removed. To go on in this way brings humiliation.
Nine in the second place: To bear with fools in kindliness brings good fortune. To know how to take women brings good fortune. The son is capable of taking charge of the household.
Six in the third place: You should not marry a maiden who sees a man of bronze and loses possession of herself. Nothing furthers.
Six in the fourth place: Entangled folly brings humiliation.
Six in the fifth place: Childlike folly brings good fortune.
Nine at the top: In punishing folly it does not further one to commit transgressions. The only thing that furthers is to prevent transgressions.
4.judgment_es: Éxito. No soy yo quien busca al joven necio; el joven necio me busca a mí. En el primer oráculo le informo. Si pregunta dos o tres veces, es importunidad. Si importuna, no le doy información. La perseverancia favorece.
4.judgment_it: Successo. Non sono io che cerco il giovane sciocco; il giovane sciocco cerca me. Al primo oracolo lo informo. Se chiede due o tre volte, è importunità. Se importuna, non gli do informazioni. La perseveranza favorisce.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Para hacer desarrollar a un necio favorece aplicar disciplina. Los grilletes deben ser removidos. Seguir así trae humillación.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Soportar a los necios con amabilidad trae buena fortuna. Saber cómo tomar esposas trae buena fortuna. El hijo es capaz de hacerse cargo del hogar.
Seis en el tercer lugar: No debes casarte con una doncella que ve a un hombre de bronce y pierde el dominio de sí misma. Nada favorece.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: La necedad enredada trae humillación.
Seis en el quinto lugar: La necedad infantil trae buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: Al castigar la necedad no favorece al hombre cometer transgresiones. Lo único que favorece es prevenir las transgresiones.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Per far sviluppare uno sciocco è favorevole applicare disciplina. I ceppi devono essere rimossi. Continuare così porta umiliazione.
Nove al secondo posto: Sopportare gli sciocchi con gentilezza porta buona fortuna. Sapere come prendere moglie porta buona fortuna. Il figlio è capace di prendersi cura della casa.
Sei al terzo posto: Non devi sposare una fanciulla che vede un uomo di bronzo e perde il controllo di sé. Nulla favorisce.
Sei al quarto posto: La sciocchezza aggrovigliata porta umiliazione.
Sei al quinto posto: La sciocchezza infantile porta buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: Nel punire la sciocchezza non è favorevole all'uomo commettere trasgressioni. L'unica cosa che favorisce è prevenire le trasgressioni.

5.judgment_zh: 有孚，光亨，貞吉。利涉大川。
5.judgment_en: If you are sincere, you have light and success. Perseverance brings good fortune. It furthers one to cross the great water.
5.commentary_desc: Hsu intimates that, with the sincerity which is declared in it, there will be brilliant success. With firmness there will be good fortune; and it will be advantageous to cross the great stream.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject waiting in the distant border. It will be well for him constantly to maintain (the purpose thus shown), in which case there will be no error.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject waiting on the sand (of the mountain stream). He will (suffer) the small (injury of) being spoken (against), but in the end there will be good fortune.
The third nine, undivided, shows its subject in the mud (close by the stream). He thereby invites the approach of injury.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject waiting in (the place of) blood. But he will get out of the cavern.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject waiting amidst the appliances of a feast. Through his firmness and correctness there will be good fortune.

The topmost six, divided, shows its subject entered into the cavern. (But) there are three guests coming, without being urged, (to his help). If he receive them respectfully, there will be good fortune in the end.

image.image_zh: 雲上於天，需。君子以飲食宴樂。
image.image_en: Clouds rise up to heaven: The image of Waiting. Thus the superior man eats and drinks, is joyous and of good cheer.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Las nubes se elevan hacia el cielo: La imagen de la Espera. Así el hombre superior come y bebe, y es alegre y fuerte.
image.image_it: Le nuvole si elevano verso il cielo: L'immagine dell'Attesa. Così l'uomo superiore mangia e beve, ed è allegro e forte.

lines_zh: 初九：需于郊，利用恆，無咎。
九二：需于沙，小有言，終吉。
九三：需于泥，致寇至。
六四：需于血，出自穴。
九五：需于酒食，貞吉。
上六：入于穴，有不速之客三人來，敬之終吉。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Waiting in the meadow. It furthers one to abide in what endures. No blame.
Nine in the second place: Waiting on the sand. There is some gossip. The end brings good fortune.
Nine in the third place: Waiting in the mud brings about the arrival of the enemy.
Six in the fourth place: Waiting in blood. Get out of the pit.
Nine in the fifth place: Waiting at meat and drink. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Six at the top: One falls into the pit. Three uninvited guests arrive. Honor them, and in the end there will be good fortune.
5.judgment_es: Si eres sincero, tienes luz y éxito. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. Favorece al hombre cruzar la gran agua.
5.judgment_it: Se sei sincero, hai luce e successo. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. È favorevole all'uomo attraversare la grande acqua.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Esperar en el prado. Favorece al hombre permanecer en lo que perdura. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Esperar en la arena. Hay algo de chisme. El fin trae buena fortuna.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Esperar en el barro trae la llegada del enemigo.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Esperar en la sangre. Sal del pozo.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Esperar ante carne y bebida. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.
Seis en lo alto: Uno cae en el pozo. Llegan tres huéspedes no invitados. Honrarlos, y al final habrá buena fortuna.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Aspettare nel prato. È favorevole all'uomo rimanere in ciò che perdura. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al secondo posto: Aspettare sulla sabbia. C'è un po' di pettegolezzo. La fine porta buona fortuna.
Nove al terzo posto: Aspettare nel fango porta l'arrivo del nemico.
Sei al quarto posto: Aspettare nel sangue. Esci dal pozzo.
Nove al quinto posto: Aspettare davanti a carne e bevande. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.
Sei in cima: Uno cade nel pozzo. Arrivano tre ospiti non invitati. Onorarli, e alla fine ci sarà buona fortuna.

6.judgment_zh: 有孚窒惕，中吉，終凶。利見大人，不利涉大川。
6.judgment_en: You are sincere but being obstructed. A cautious halt halfway brings good fortune. Going through to the end brings misfortune. It furthers one to see the great man. It does not further one to cross the great water.
6.commentary_desc: Sung intimates how, though there is sincerity in one's contention, he will yet meet with opposition and obstruction; but if he cherish an apprehensive caution, there will be good fortune, while, if he must prosecute the contention to the (bitter) end, there will be evil. It will be advantageous to see the great man; it will not be advantageous to cross the great stream.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject not perpetuating the matter about which (the contention is). He will suffer the small (injury) of being spoken against, but the end will be fortunate.

The second nine, undivided, shows its subject unequal to the contention. If he retire and keep concealed (where) the inhabitants of his city are (only) three hundred families, he will fall into no mistake.

The third six, divided, shows its subject keeping in the old place assigned for his support, and firmly correct. Perilous as the position is, there will be good fortune in the end. Should he perchance engage in the king's business, he will not (claim the merit of) achievement.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject unequal to the contention. He returns to (the study of Heaven's) ordinances, changes (his wish to contend), and rests in being firm and correct. There will be good fortune.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject contending;-and with great good fortune.
The topmost nine, undivided, shows how its subject may have the leathern belt conferred on him (by the sovereign), and thrice it shall be taken from him in a morning.

image.image_zh: 天與水違行，訟。君子以作事謀始。
image.image_en: Heaven and water go their opposite ways: The image of Conflict. Thus in all his transactions the superior man carefully considers the beginning.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El cielo y el agua se mueven en direcciones opuestas: La imagen del Conflicto. Así el hombre superior en sus asuntos iniciales tiene cuidado.
image.image_it: Il cielo e l'acqua si muovono in direzioni opposte: L'immagine del Conflitto. Così l'uomo superiore nei suoi affari iniziali è cauto.

lines_zh: 初六：不永所事，小有言，終吉。
九二：不克訟，歸而逋，其邑人三百戶，無眚。
六三：食舊德，貞厲，終吉，或從王事，無成。
九四：不克訟，復即命，渝安貞，吉。
九五：訟，元吉。
上九：或錫之鞶帶，終朝三褫之。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: If one does not perpetuate the affair, there is a little gossip. In the end, good fortune comes.
Nine in the second place: One cannot engage in conflict; one returns home, gives way. The people of his town, three hundred households, remain free of guilt.
Six in the third place: To nourish oneself on ancient virtue induces perseverance. Danger. In the end, good fortune comes. If by chance you are in the service of a king, seek not works.
Nine in the fourth place: One cannot engage in conflict. One turns back and submits to fate, changes one's attitude, and finds peace in perseverance. Good fortune.
Nine in the fifth place: To contend before him brings supreme good fortune.
Nine at the top: Even if by chance a leather belt is bestowed on one, by the end of a morning it will have been snatched away three times.
6.judgment_es: Eres sincero pero estás siendo obstruido. Una detención cautelosa a mitad de camino trae buena fortuna. Llegar hasta el final trae desgracia. Favorece al hombre ver al gran hombre. No favorece al hombre cruzar la gran agua.
6.judgment_it: Sei sincero ma stai venendo ostruito. Una sosta cauta a metà strada porta buona fortuna. Andare fino in fondo porta sventura. È favorevole all'uomo vedere il grande uomo. Non è favorevole all'uomo attraversare la grande acqua.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Si uno no perpetúa el asunto, hay un poco de chisme. Al final, viene la buena fortuna.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: No se puede participar en conflicto; uno vuelve a casa, cede. La gente de su pueblo, trescientos hogares, permanece libre de culpa.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Nutrirse de la virtud antigua induce perseverancia. Peligro. Al final, viene la buena fortuna. Si por casualidad estás al servicio de un rey, no busques obras.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: No se puede participar en conflicto. Uno se vuelve y se somete al destino, cambia su actitud, y encuentra paz en la perseverancia. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Contender ante él trae suprema buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: Incluso si por casualidad se otorga a uno un cinturón de cuero, al final de la mañana habrá sido arrebatado tres veces.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Se non si perpetua l'affare, c'è un po' di pettegolezzo. Alla fine, viene la buona fortuna.
Nove al secondo posto: Non si può partecipare al conflitto; uno torna a casa, cede. La gente del suo villaggio, trecento famiglie, rimane libera da colpa.
Sei al terzo posto: Nutrirsi della virtù antica induce perseveranza. Pericolo. Alla fine, viene la buona fortuna. Se per caso sei al servizio di un re, non cercare opere.
Nove al quarto posto: Non si può partecipare al conflitto. Uno si volge e si sottomette al destino, cambia il suo atteggiamento, e trova pace nella perseveranza. Buona fortuna.
Nove al quinto posto: Contendere davanti a lui porta suprema buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: Anche se per caso viene conferito a uno un cinturone di cuoio, alla fine della mattina sarà stato strappato via tre volte.

7.judgment_en: The army needs perseverance and a strong man. Good fortune without blame.
7.commentary_desc: Sze indicates how, in the case which it supposes, with firmness and correctness, and (a leader of) age and experience, there will be good fortune and no error.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows the host going forth according to the rules (for such a movement). If these be not good, there will be evil.
The second nine, undivided, shows (the leader) in the midst of the host. There will be good fortune and no error. The king has thrice conveyed to him the orders (of his favor).
The third six, divided, shows how the host may, possibly, have many inefficient leaders. There will be evil.
The fourth six, divided, shows the host in retreat. There is no error.

The fifth six, divided, shows birds in the fields, which it will be advantageous to seize (and destroy). In that case there will be no error. If the oldest son leads the host, and younger men (idly occupy offices assigned to them), however firm and correct he may be, there will be evil.

The topmost six, divided, shows the great ruler delivering his charges, (appointing some) to be rulers of states, and others to undertake the headship of clans; but small men should not be employed (in such positions).

image.image_zh: 地中有水，師。君子以容民畜眾。
image.image_en: In the middle of the earth is water: The image of the Army. Thus the superior man increases his masses by generosity toward the people.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Dentro de la tierra está el agua: La imagen del Ejército. Así el hombre superior aumenta sus masas por medio de la generosidad.
image.image_it: Dentro la terra c'è l'acqua: L'immagine dell'Esercito. Così l'uomo superiore aumenta le sue masse mediante la generosità.

lines_zh: 初六：師出以律，否臧凶。
九二：在師中吉，無咎，王三錫命。
六三：師或輿尸，凶。
六四：師左次，無咎。
六五：田有禽，利執言，無咎。長子帥師，弟子輿尸，貞凶。
上六：大君有命，開國承家，小人勿用。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: An army must set forth in proper order. If the order is not good, misfortune threatens.
Nine in the second place: In the midst of the army. Good fortune. No blame. The king bestows a triple decoration.
Six in the third place: Perchance the army carries corpses in the wagon. Misfortune.
Six in the fourth place: The army retreats. No blame.
Six in the fifth place: There is game in the field. It furthers one to catch it. Without blame. Let the eldest lead the army. The younger transports corpses; then perseverance brings misfortune.
Six at the top: The great prince issues commands, founds states, vests families with fiefs. Inferior people should not be employed.
7.judgment_es: El ejército necesita perseverancia y un hombre fuerte. Buena fortuna sin culpa.
7.judgment_it: L'esercito ha bisogno di perseveranza e di un uomo forte. Buona fortuna senza colpa.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Un ejército debe partir en orden apropiado. Si el orden no es bueno, amenaza la desgracia.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: En medio del ejército. Buena fortuna. Sin culpa. El rey otorga una triple decoración.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Tal vez el ejército lleva cadáveres en el carro. Desgracia.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: El ejército se retira. Sin culpa.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Hay caza en el campo. Favorece al hombre atraparla. Sin culpa. Que el mayor lidere el ejército. El menor transporta cadáveres; entonces la perseverancia trae desgracia.
Seis en lo alto: El gran príncipe emite órdenes, funda estados, invierte familias con feudos. No deben emplearse personas inferiores.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Un esercito deve partire in ordine appropriato. Se l'ordine non è buono, minaccia la sventura.
Nove al secondo posto: In mezzo all'esercito. Buona fortuna. Nessuna colpa. Il re conferisce una tripla decorazione.
Sei al terzo posto: Forse l'esercito trasporta cadaveri nel carro. Sventura.
Sei al quarto posto: L'esercito si ritira. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al quinto posto: C'è selvaggina nel campo. È favorevole all'uomo catturarla. Nessuna colpa. Che il maggiore guidi l'esercito. Il minore trasporta cadaveri; allora la perseveranza porta sventura.
Sei in cima: Il gran principe emette ordini, fonda stati, investe famiglie con feudi. Non devono essere impiegate persone inferiori.

8.judgment_zh: 吉。原筮元永貞，無咎。不寧方來，後夫凶。
8.judgment_en: Good fortune. Inquire of the oracle once again whether you possess sublimity, constancy, and perseverance; then there is no blame.
8.commentary_desc: Pi indicates that (under the conditions which it supposes) there is good fortune. But let (the principal party intended in it) re-examine himself, (as if) by divination, whether his virtue be great, unintermitting, and firm. If it be so, there will be no error. Those who have not rest will then come to him; and with those who are (too) late in coming it will be ill.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject seeking by his sincerity to win the attachment of his object. There will be no error. Let (the breast) be full of sincerity as an earthenware vessel is of its contents, and it will in the end bring other advantages.
In the second six, divided ' we see the movement towards union and attachment proceeding from the inward (mind). With firm correctness there will be good fortune.
In the third six, divided, we see its subject seeking for union with such as ought not to be associated with.
In the fourth six, divided, we see its subject seeking for union with the one beyond himself. With firm correctness there will be good fortune.

The fifth nine, undivided, affords the most illustrious instance of seeking union and attachment. (We seem to see in it) the king urging his pursuit of the game (only) in three directions, and allowing the escape of all the animals before him, while the people of his towns do not warn one another (to prevent it). There will be good fortune.
In the topmost six, divided, we see one seeking union and attachment without having taken the first step (to such an end). There will be evil.

image.image_zh: 地上有水，比。先王以建萬國，親諸侯。
image.image_en: On the earth is water: The image of Holding Together. Thus the kings of old established the various states and maintained friendly relations with their vassals.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Sobre la tierra el agua: La imagen de la Solidaridad. Así los reyes antiguos establecieron los estados y mantuvieron relaciones amistosas con los príncipes.
image.image_it: Sulla terra l'acqua: L'immagine della Solidarietà. Così i re antichi stabilirono gli stati e mantennero relazioni amichevoli con i principi.

lines_zh: 初六：有孚比之，無咎。有孚盈缶，終來有它，吉。
六二：比之自內，貞吉。
六三：比之匪人。
六四：外比之，貞吉。
九五：顯比，王用三驅，失前禽，邑人不誡，吉。
上六：比之無首，凶。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Hold to him in truth and loyalty; this is without blame. Truth, like a full earthen bowl: thus in the end good fortune comes from without.
Six in the second place: Hold to him inwardly. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Six in the third place: You hold to the wrong people.
Six in the fourth place: Hold to him outwardly. Perseverance brings good fortune.

Nine in the fifth place: Manifestation of holding together. The king urges his beaters to drive the game in three directions only, and allows the game to escape before him. The people of the town need no warning. Good fortune.
Six at the top: He finds no head for holding together. Misfortune.
8.judgment_es: Buena fortuna. Pregunta al oráculo una vez más si posees sublimidad, constancia y perseverancia; entonces no hay culpa.
8.judgment_it: Buona fortuna. Chiedi all'oracolo una volta ancora se possiedi sublimità, costanza e perseveranza; allora non c'è colpa.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Aferrarse a él en verdad y lealtad; esto es sin culpa. Verdad, como un cuenco de tierra lleno: así al final la buena fortuna viene de fuera.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Aferrarse a él interiormente. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Te aferras a las personas equivocadas.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Aferrarse a él exteriormente. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.

Nueve en el quinto lugar: Manifestación de aferrarse juntos. El rey urge a sus batidores a conducir la caza solo en tres direcciones, y permite que la caza escape ante él. La gente del pueblo no necesita advertencia. Buena fortuna.
Seis en lo alto: No encuentra cabeza para aferrarse juntos. Desgracia.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Aggrapparsi a lui in verità e lealtà; questo è senza colpa. Verità, come una ciotola di terra piena: così alla fine la buona fortuna viene da fuori.
Sei al secondo posto: Aggrapparsi a lui interiormente. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.
Sei al terzo posto: Ti aggrappi alle persone sbagliate.
Sei al quarto posto: Aggrapparsi a lui esteriormente. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.

Nove al quinto posto: Manifestazione di aggrapparsi insieme. Il re esorta i suoi battitori a guidare la caccia solo in tre direzioni, e permette che la caccia scappi davanti a lui. La gente del villaggio non ha bisogno di avvertimento. Buona fortuna.
Sei in cima: Non trova testa per aggrapparsi insieme. Sventura.

9.name_es: La Fuerza Domesticadora de lo Pequeño
9.judgment_en: Success. Dense clouds, no rain from our western territory.
9.commentary_desc: Kwai requires (in him who would fulfil its meaning) the exhibition (of the culprit's guilt) in the royal court, and a sincere and earnest appeal (for sympathy and support), with a consciousness of the peril (involved in cutting off the criminal). He should (also) make announcement in his own city, and show that it will not be well to have recourse at once to arms. (In this way) there will be advantage in whatever he shall go forward to.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject in (the pride of) strength advancing with his toes. He goes forward, but will not succeed. There will be ground for blame.

The second nine, undivided, shows its subject full of apprehension and appealing (for sympathy and help). Late at night hostile measures may be (taken against him), but he need not be anxious about them.

The third nine, undivided, shows its subject (about to advance) with strong (and determined) looks. There will be evil. (But) the superior man, bent on cutting off (the criminal), will walk alone and encounter the rain, (till he be hated by his proper associates) as if he were contaminated (by the others). (In the end) there will be no blame against him.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows one from whose buttocks the skin has been stripped, and who walks slowly and with difficulty. (If he could act) like a sheep led (after its companions), occasion for repentance would disappear. But though he hear these words, he will not believe them.

The fifth nine, undivided, shows (the small men like) a bed of purslain, which ought to be uprooted with the utmost determination. (The subject of the line having such determination), his action, in harmony with his central position, will lead to no error or blame.
The sixth six, divided, shows its subject without any (helpers) on whom to call. His end will be evil.

image.image_zh: 風行天上，小畜。君子以懿文德。
image.image_en: The wind drives across heaven: The image of the Taming Power of the Small. Thus the superior man refines the outward aspect of his nature.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El viento sopla sobre el cielo: La imagen de la Domesticación de lo Pequeño. Así el hombre superior refina la forma externa de su naturaleza.
image.image_it: Il vento soffia sul cielo: L'immagine dell'Addomesticamento del Piccolo. Così l'uomo superiore affina la forma esterna della sua natura.

lines_zh: 初九：復自道，何其咎，吉。
九二：牽復，吉。
九三：輿說輻，夫妻反目。
六四：有孚，血去惕出，無咎。
九五：有孚攣如，富以其鄰。
上九：既雨既處，尚德載，婦貞厲。月幾望，君子征凶。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Return to the way. How could there be blame in this? Good fortune.
Nine in the second place: He allows himself to be drawn into returning. Good fortune.
Nine in the third place: The spokes burst out of the wagon wheels. Man and wife roll their eyes.
Six in the fourth place: If you are sincere, blood vanishes and fear gives way. No blame.
Nine in the fifth place: If you are sincere and loyally attached, you are rich in your neighbor.

Nine at the top: The rain comes, there is rest. This is due to the lasting effect of character. Perseverance brings the woman into danger. The moon is nearly full. If the superior man persists, misfortune comes.
9.judgment_es: Éxito. Nubes densas, sin lluvia de nuestro territorio occidental.
9.judgment_it: Successo. Nuvole fitte, senza pioggia dal nostro territorio occidentale.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Volver al camino. ¿Cómo podría haber culpa en esto? Buena fortuna.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Se permite ser atraído a regresar. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Los rayos salen de las ruedas del carro. El hombre y la mujer giran los ojos.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Si eres sincero, la sangre desaparece y el miedo cede. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Si eres sincero y lealmente apegado, eres rico en tu vecino.

Nueve en lo alto: Viene la lluvia, hay descanso. Esto se debe al efecto duradero del carácter. La perseverancia trae a la mujer al peligro. La luna está casi llena. Si el hombre superior persiste, viene la desgracia.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Tornare al cammino. Come potrebbe esserci colpa in questo? Buona fortuna.
Nove al secondo posto: Si permette di essere attratto a tornare. Buona fortuna.
Nove al terzo posto: I raggi escono dalle ruote del carro. L'uomo e la donna girano gli occhi.
Sei al quarto posto: Se sei sincero, il sangue svanisce e la paura cede. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al quinto posto: Se sei sincero e lealmente attaccato, sei ricco nel tuo vicino.

Nove in cima: Arriva la pioggia, c'è riposo. Questo è dovuto all'effetto duraturo del carattere. La perseveranza porta la donna nel pericolo. La luna è quasi piena. Se l'uomo nobile persiste, viene la sventura.

10.judgment_en: Treading upon the tail of the tiger. It does not bite the man. Success.
10.commentary_desc: Kau shows a female who is bold and strong. It will not be good to marry (such) a female.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows how its subject should be kept (like a carriage) tied and fastened to a metal drag, in which case with firm correctness there will be good fortune. (But) if he move in any direction, evil will appear. He will be (like) a lean pig, which is sure to keep jumping about.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject with a wallet of fish. There will be no error. But it will not be well to let (the subject of the first line) go forward to the guests.
The third nine, undivided, shows one from whose buttocks the skin has been stripped so that he walks with difficulty. The position is perilous, but there will be no great error.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject with his wallet, but no fish in it. This will give rise to evil.
The fifth nine, undivided, (shows its subject as) a medlar tree overspreading the gourd (beneath it). If he keep his brilliant qualities concealed, (a good issue) will descend (as) from Heaven.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows its subject receiving others on his horns. There will be occasion for regret, but there will be no error.

image.image_zh: 上天下澤，履。君子以辨上下，定民志。
image.image_en: Heaven above, the lake below: The image of Treading. Thus the superior man discriminates between high and low, and thereby fortifies the thinking of the people.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El cielo sobre el lago: La imagen del Porte del Pie. Así el hombre superior distingue entre lo superior y lo inferior, y así confirma la diferencia entre la voluntad del pueblo.
image.image_it: Il cielo sopra il lago: L'immagine del Passo del Piede. Così l'uomo superiore distingue tra il superiore e l'inferiore, e così conferma la differenza tra la volontà del popolo.

lines_zh: 初九：素履，往無咎。
九二：履道坦坦，幽人貞吉。
六三：眇能視，跛能履，履虎尾，咥人，凶。武人為于大君。
九四：履虎尾，愬愬，終吉。
九五：夬履，貞厲。
上九：視履考祥，其旋元吉。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Simple conduct. Progress without blame.
Nine in the second place: Treading a smooth, level course. The perseverance of a dark man brings good fortune.

Six in the third place: A one-eyed man is able to see, a lame man is able to tread. He treads on the tail of the tiger. The tiger bites the man. Misfortune. Thus does a warrior act on behalf of his great prince.
Nine in the fourth place: He treads on the tail of the tiger. Caution and circumspection lead ultimately to good fortune.
Nine in the fifth place: Resolute conduct. Perseverance with awareness of danger.
Nine at the top: Look to your conduct and weigh the favorable signs. When everything is fulfilled, supreme good fortune comes.
10.judgment_es: Pisando sobre la cola del tigre. No muerde al hombre. Éxito.
10.judgment_it: Pestando sulla coda della tigre. Non morde l'uomo. Successo.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Conducta simple. Progreso sin culpa.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Pisar un curso liso y nivelado. La perseverancia de un hombre oscuro trae buena fortuna.

Seis en el tercer lugar: Un hombre tuerto puede ver, un hombre cojo puede pisar. Pisa sobre la cola del tigre. El tigre muerde al hombre. Desgracia. Así actúa un guerrero en nombre de su gran príncipe.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Pisa sobre la cola del tigre. La cautela y la circunspección llevan finalmente a la buena fortuna.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Conducta resuelta. Perseverancia con conciencia del peligro.
Nueve en lo alto: Mira tu conducta y pesa las señales favorables. Cuando todo se cumple, viene la suprema buena fortuna.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Condotta semplice. Progresso senza colpa.
Nove al secondo posto: Pestare un corso liscio e livellato. La perseveranza di un uomo oscuro porta buona fortuna.
Sei al terzo posto: Un uomo guercio può vedere, un uomo zoppo può pestare. Pesta sulla coda della tigre. La tigre morde l'uomo. Sventura. Così agisce un guerriero a nome del suo gran principe.
Nove al quarto posto: Pesta sulla coda della tigre. La cautela e la circospezione portano infine alla buona fortuna.
Nove al quinto posto: Condotta risoluta. Perseveranza con consapevolezza del pericolo.
Nove in cima: Guarda la tua condotta e pesa i segni favorevoli. Quando tutto si compie, viene la suprema buona fortuna.

11.judgment_en: The small departs, the great approaches. Good fortune. Success.
11.commentary_desc: In Thai (we see) the little gone and the great come. (It indicates that) there will be good fortune, with progress and success.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, suggests the idea of grass pulled up, and bringing with it other stalks with whose roots it is connected. Advance (on the part of its subject) will be fortunate.

The second nine, undivided, shows one who can bear with the uncultivated, will cross the Ho without a boat, does not forget the distant, and has no (selfish) friendships. Thus does he prove himself acting in accordance with the course of the due Mean.

The third nine, undivided, shows that, while there is no state of peace that is not liable to be disturbed, and no departure (of evil men) so that they shall not return, yet when one is firm and correct, as he realizes the distresses that may arise, he will commit no error. There is no occasion for sadness at the certainty (of such recurring changes); and in this mood the happiness (of the present) may be (long) enjoyed.

The fourth six, divided, shows its subject fluttering (down);-not relying on his own rich resources, but calling in his neighbors. (They all come) not as having received warning, but in the sincerity (of their hearts).
The fifth six, divided, reminds us of (king) Ti-yi's (rule about the) marriage of his younger sister. By such a course there is happiness and there will be great good fortune.

The sixth six, divided, shows us the city wall returned into the moat. It is not the time to use the army. (The subject of the line) may, indeed, announce his orders to the people of his own city; but however correct and firm he may be, he will have cause for regret.

image.image_zh: 天地交，泰。后以財成天地之道，輔相天地之宜，以左右民。
image.image_en: Heaven and earth unite: The image of Peace. Thus the ruler divides and completes the course of heaven and earth, and so aids the people.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El cielo y la tierra se encuentran: La imagen de la Paz. Así el gobernante divide y completa el curso del cielo y la tierra, y así ayuda al pueblo.
image.image_it: Il cielo e la terra si incontrano: L'immagine della Pace. Così il governatore divide e completa il corso del cielo e della terra, e così aiuta il popolo.

tuan.tuan_zh: 泰，小往大來，吉亨。則是天地交而萬物通也，上下交而其志同也。內陽而外陰，內健而外順，內君子而外小人，君子道長，小人道消也。
tuan.tuan_en: In Tai (we see) the little gone and the great come. (It indicates that) there will be good fortune, with progress and success. (We see) the natural (attributes) of heaven and earth in communication; and the result is the giving and receiving (of their influence), and the bringing into communication with each other. We see the strong (line) in the centre of the figure, and responding (to it) we have the weak; with these conditions there will be great success.
tuan.source: Tuan Zhuan (彖傳 - Commentary on the Decision), Zhou Yi (周易)

lines_zh: 初九：拔茅茹，以其彙，征吉。
九二：包荒，用馮河，不遐遺，朋亡，得尚于中行。
九三：無平不陂，無往不復，艱貞無咎。勿恤其孚，于食有福。
六四：翩翩，不富以其鄰，不戒以孚。
六五：帝乙歸妹，以祉元吉。
上六：城復于隍，勿用師，自邑告命，貞吝。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: When ribbon grass is pulled up, the sod comes with it. Each according to his kind. Undertakings bring good fortune.

Nine in the second place: Bearing with the uncultured in gentleness, fording the river with resolution, not neglecting what is distant, not regarding one's companions: thus one may manage to walk in the middle.

Nine in the third place: No plain not followed by a slope. No going not followed by a return. He who remains persevering in danger is without blame. Do not complain about this truth; enjoy the good fortune you still possess.
Six in the fourth place: He flutters down, not boasting of his wealth, together with his neighbor, guileless and sincere.
Six in the fifth place: The sovereign I gives his daughter in marriage. This brings blessing and supreme good fortune.
Six at the top: The city wall falls back into the moat. Use no army now. Make your commands known within your own town. Perseverance brings humiliation.
11.judgment_es: Lo pequeño se va, lo grande se acerca. Buena fortuna. Éxito.
11.judgment_it: Il piccolo se ne va, il grande si avvicina. Buona fortuna. Successo.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Cuando se arranca la hierba de la cinta, viene el césped con ella. Cada uno según su clase. Las empresas traen buena fortuna.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Soportar a los incultos con gentileza, vadear el río con resolución, no descuidar lo distante, no mirar a los compañeros: así uno puede lograr caminar en el medio.

Nueve en el tercer lugar: No hay llano que no sea seguido por una pendiente. No hay ir que no sea seguido por un retorno. Quien permanece perseverante en el peligro está sin culpa. No te quejes de esta verdad; disfruta la buena fortuna que aún posees.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Él desciende aleteando, no jactándose de su riqueza, junto con su vecino, sin malicia y sincero.
Seis en el quinto lugar: El soberano Yo da su hija en matrimonio. Esto trae bendición y suprema buena fortuna.
Seis en lo alto: El muro de la ciudad cae en el foso. No uses ejército ahora. Haz conocer tus órdenes dentro de tu propia ciudad. La perseverancia trae humillación.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Quando si strappa l'erba del nastro, viene il prato con essa. Ciascuno secondo il suo genere. Le imprese portano buona fortuna.
Nove al secondo posto: Sopportare gli incolti con gentilezza, guadare il fiume con risoluzione, non trascurare ciò che è lontano, non guardare i compagni: così si può riuscire a camminare nel mezzo.

Nove al terzo posto: Non c'è pianura che non sia seguita da un pendio. Non c'è andare che non sia seguito da un ritorno. Chi rimane perseverante nel pericolo è senza colpa. Non lamentarti di questa verità; goditi la buona fortuna che ancora possiedi.
Sei al quarto posto: Egli discende sbattendo le ali, non vantandosi della sua ricchezza, insieme al suo vicino, senza malizia e sincero.
Sei al quinto posto: Il sovrano Io dà sua figlia in matrimonio. Questo porta benedizione e suprema buona fortuna.
Sei in cima: Il muro della città cade nel fossato. Non usare l'esercito ora. Fai conoscere i tuoi ordini dentro la tua città. La perseveranza porta umiliazione.

12.judgment_zh: 否之匪人，不利君子貞，大往小來。
12.judgment_en: Standstill. Evil people do not further the perseverance of the superior man. The great departs; the small approaches.
12.commentary_desc: In Phi there is the want of good understanding between the (different classes of) men, and its indication is unfavorable to the firm and correct course of the superior man. We see in it the great gone and the little come.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, suggests the idea of grass pulled up, and bringing with it other stalks with whose roots it is connected. With firm correctness (on the part of its subject), there will be good fortune and progress.

The second six, divided, shows its subject patient and obedient. To the small man (comporting himself so) there will be good fortune. If the great man (comport himself) as the distress and obstruction require, he will have success.
The third six, divided, shows its subject ashamed of the purpose folded (in his breast).
The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject acting in accordance with the ordination (of Heaven), and committing no error. His companions will come and share in his happiness.

In the fifth nine, undivided, we see him who brings the distress and obstruction to a close,-the great man and fortunate. (But let him say), 'We may perish! We may perish!' (so shall the state of things become firm, as if bound to a clump of bushy mulberry trees.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows the overthrow (and removal of) the condition of distress and obstruction. Before this there was that condition. Hereafter there will be joy.

image.image_zh: 天地不交，否。君子以儉德辟難，不可榮以祿。
image.image_en: Heaven and earth do not unite: The image of Standstill. Thus the superior man falls back upon his inner worth in order to escape the difficulties. He does not permit himself to be honored with revenue.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El cielo y la tierra no se encuentran: La imagen del Estancamiento. Así el hombre superior es reservado con sus bienes, y evita la exaltación.
image.image_it: Il cielo e la terra non si incontrano: L'immagine dello Stagnamento. Così l'uomo superiore è riservato con i suoi beni, ed evita l'esaltazione.

lines_zh: 初六：拔茅茹，以其彙，貞吉亨。
六二：包承，小人吉，大人否亨。
六三：包羞。
九四：有命無咎，疇離祉。
九五：休否，大人吉，其亡其亡，繫于苞桑。
上九：傾否，先否後喜。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: When ribbon grass is pulled up, the sod comes with it. Each according to his kind. Perseverance brings good fortune and success.
Six in the second place: They bear and endure; this means good fortune for inferior people. The standstill serves to help the great man to success.
Six in the third place: They bear shame.
Nine in the fourth place: He who acts at the command of the highest remains without blame. Those of like mind partake of the blessing.
Nine in the fifth place: Standstill is giving way. Good fortune for the great man. 'What if it should fail, what if it should fail?' In this way he ties it to a cluster of mulberry shoots.
Nine at the top: The standstill comes to an end. First standstill, then good fortune.
12.judgment_es: Estancamiento. Las personas malvadas no favorecen la perseverancia del hombre superior. Lo grande se va; lo pequeño se acerca.
12.judgment_it: Stasi. Le persone malvagie non favoriscono la perseveranza dell'uomo nobile. Il grande se ne va; il piccolo si avvicina.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Cuando se arranca la hierba de la cinta, viene el césped con ella. Cada uno según su clase. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna y éxito.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Ellos soportan y resisten; esto significa buena fortuna para las personas inferiores. El estancamiento sirve para ayudar al gran hombre al éxito.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Ellos soportan vergüenza.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Quien actúa por mandato de lo más alto permanece sin culpa. Los de igual mente participan de la bendición.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: El estancamiento está cediendo. Buena fortuna para el gran hombre. '¿Y si fallara, y si fallara?' De esta manera lo ata a un manojo de brotes de morera.
Nueve en lo alto: El estancamiento llega a su fin. Primero estancamiento, luego buena fortuna.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Quando si strappa l'erba del nastro, viene il prato con essa. Ciascuno secondo il suo genere. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna e successo.
Sei al secondo posto: Essi sopportano e resistono; questo significa buona fortuna per le persone inferiori. La stasi serve ad aiutare il gran uomo al successo.
Sei al terzo posto: Essi sopportano la vergogna.
Nove al quarto posto: Chi agisce per mandato del più alto rimane senza colpa. Quelli della stessa mente partecipano della benedizione.
Nove al quinto posto: La stasi sta cedendo. Buona fortuna per il gran uomo. 'E se fallisse, e se fallisse?' In questo modo lo lega a un mazzetto di germogli di gelso.
Nove in cima: La stasi giunge alla fine. Prima stasi, poi buona fortuna.

13.judgment_zh: 同人于野，亨。利涉大川，利君子貞。
13.judgment_en: Fellowship with men in the open. Success. It furthers one to cross the great water. The perseverance of the superior man furthers.
13.commentary_desc: Thung Zan (or 'Union of men') appears here (as we find it) in the (remote districts of the) country, indicating progress and success. It will be advantageous to cross the great stream. It will be advantageous to maintain the firm correctness of the superior man.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, (shows the representative of) the union of men just issuing from his gate. There will be no error.
The second six, divided, (shows the representative of) the union of men in relation with his kindred. There will be occasion for regret.
The third nine, undivided, (shows its subject) with his arms hidden in the thick grass, and at the top of a high mound. (But) for three years he makes no demonstration.
The fourth nine, undivided, (shows its subject) mounted on the city wall; but he does not proceed to make the attack (he contemplates). There will be good fortune.
In the fifth nine, undivided, (the representative of) the union of men first wails and cries out, and then laughs. His great host conquers, and he (and the subject of the second line) meet together.
The topmost nine, undivided, (shows the representative of) the union of men in the suburbs. There will be no occasion for repentance.

image.image_zh: 天與火，同人。君子以類族辨物。
image.image_en: Heaven together with fire: The image of Fellowship with Men. Thus the superior man organizes the clans and makes distinctions between things.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El cielo junto con el fuego: La imagen de la Comunidad con los Hombres. Así el hombre superior organiza los clanes y hace distinciones entre las cosas.
image.image_it: Il cielo insieme al fuoco: L'immagine della Comunità con gli Uomini. Così l'uomo superiore organizza i clan e fa distinzioni tra le cose.

lines_zh: 初九：同人于門，無咎。
六二：同人于宗，吝。
九三：伏戎于莽，升其高陵，三歲不興。
九四：乘其墉，弗克攻，吉。
九五：同人，先號咷而後笑，大師克相遇。
上九：同人于郊，無悔。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Fellowship with men at the gate. No blame.
Six in the second place: Fellowship with men in the clan. Humiliation.
Nine in the third place: He hides weapons in the thicket; he climbs the high hill in front of it. For three years he does not rise up.
Nine in the fourth place: He climbs up on his wall; he cannot attack. Good fortune.
Nine in the fifth place: Men bound in fellowship first weep and lament, but afterward they laugh. After great struggles they succeed in meeting.
Nine at the top: Fellowship with men in the meadow. No remorse.
13.judgment_es: Compañerismo con hombres a la luz del día. Éxito. Favorece al hombre cruzar la gran agua. La perseverancia del hombre superior favorece.
13.judgment_it: Compagnia con uomini alla luce del giorno. Successo. È favorevole all'uomo attraversare la grande acqua. La perseveranza dell'uomo nobile favorisce.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Compañerismo con hombres en la puerta. Sin culpa.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Compañerismo con hombres en el clan. Humillación.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Esconde armas en el matorral; sube la colina alta delante de ella. Por tres años no se levanta.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Sube sobre su muro; no puede atacar. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Hombres unidos en compañerismo primero lloran y lamentan, pero después ríen. Después de grandes luchas logran encontrarse.
Nueve en lo alto: Compañerismo con hombres en el prado. Sin remordimiento.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Compagnia con uomini alla porta. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al secondo posto: Compagnia con uomini nel clan. Umiliazione.
Nove al terzo posto: Nasconde armi nel cespuglio; sale la collina alta davanti ad essa. Per tre anni non si alza.
Nove al quarto posto: Sale sul suo muro; non può attaccare. Buona fortuna.
Nove al quinto posto: Uomini uniti in compagnia prima piangono e si lamentano, ma poi ridono. Dopo grandi lotte riescono a incontrarsi.
Nove in cima: Compagnia con uomini nel prato. Nessun rimorso.

14.commentary_desc: Ta Yu indicates that, (under the circumstances which it implies), there will be great progress and success.
commentary_reading: In the first nine, undivided, there is no approach to what is injurious, and there is no error. Let there be a realization of the difficulty (and danger of the position), and there will be no error (to the end).
In the second nine, undivided, we have a large wagon with its load. In whatever direction advance is made, there will be no error.
The third nine, undivided, shows us a feudal prince presenting his offerings to the Son of Heaven. A small man would be unequal (to such a duty).
The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject keeping his great resources under restraint, There will be no error.
The fifth six, divided, shows the sincerity of its subject reciprocated by that of all the others (represented in the hexagram). Let him display a proper majesty, and there will be good fortune.
The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject with help accorded to him from Heaven. There will be good fortune, advantage in every respect.

image.image_zh: 火在天上，大有。君子以遏惡揚善，順天休命。
image.image_en: Fire in heaven above: The image of Possession in Great Measure. Thus the superior man curbs evil and furthers good, and thereby obeys the benevolent will of heaven.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El fuego en el cielo: La imagen de la Posesión de lo Grande. Así el hombre superior reprime el mal y fomenta el bien, obedeciendo con esto la voluntad del cielo.
image.image_it: Il fuoco nel cielo: L'immagine del Possesso del Grande. Così l'uomo superiore reprime il male e promuove il bene, obbedendo con ciò alla volontà del cielo.

lines_zh: 初九：無交害，匪咎，艱則無咎。
九二：大車以載，有攸往，無咎。
九三：公用亨于天子，小人弗克。
九四：匪其彭，無咎。
六五：厥孚交如，威如，吉。
上九：自天祐之，吉無不利。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: No relationship with what is harmful; there is no blame in this. If one remains conscious of difficulty, one remains without blame.
Nine in the second place: A large wagon for loading. One may undertake something. No blame.
Nine in the third place: A prince offers it to the Son of Heaven. A petty man cannot do this.
Nine in the fourth place: He makes a difference between himself and his neighbor. No blame.
Six in the fifth place: He whose truth is accessible, yet dignified, has good fortune.
Nine at the top: He is blessed by heaven. Good fortune. Nothing that does not further.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Ninguna relación con lo dañino; no hay culpa en esto. Si uno permanece consciente de la dificultad, permanece sin culpa.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Un carro grande para cargar. Uno puede emprender algo. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Un príncipe lo ofrece al Hijo del Cielo. Un hombre mezquino no puede hacer esto.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Hace una diferencia entre sí mismo y su vecino. Sin culpa.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Aquel cuya verdad es accesible, pero dignificada, tiene buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: Es bendecido por el cielo. Buena fortuna. Nada que no favorezca.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Nessuna relazione con ciò che è nocivo; non c'è colpa in questo. Se uno rimane consapevole della difficoltà, rimane senza colpa.
Nove al secondo posto: Un grande carro per caricare. Uno può intraprendere qualcosa. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al terzo posto: Un principe lo offre al Figlio del Cielo. Un uomo meschino non può fare questo.
Nove al quarto posto: Fa una differenza tra sé e il suo vicino. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al quinto posto: Colui la cui verità è accessibile, ma dignitosa, ha buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: È benedetto dal cielo. Buona fortuna. Nulla che non favorisca.

15.judgment_en: Success. The superior man carries things through.
15.commentary_desc: Fu indicates that there will be free course and progress (in what it denotes). (The subject of it) finds no one to distress him in his exits and entrances; friends come to him, and no error is committed. He will return and repeat his (proper) course. In seven days comes his return. There will be advantage in whatever direction movement is made.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject returning (from an error) of no great extent, which would not proceed to anything requiring repentance. There will be great good fortune.
The second six, divided, shows the admirable return (of its subject). There will be good fortune.
The third six, divided, shows one who has made repeated returns. The position is perilous, but there will be no error.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject moving right in the center (among those represented by the other divided lines), and yet returning alone (to his proper path).
The fifth six, divided, shows the noble return of its subject. There will be no ground for repentance.

The topmost six, divided, shows its subject all astray on the subject of returning. There will be evil. There will be calamities and errors. If with his views he put the hosts in motion, the end will be a great defeat, whose issues will extend to the ruler of the state. Even in ten years he will not be able to repair the disaster.

image.image_zh: 地中有山，謙。君子以裒多益寡，稱物平施。
image.image_en: Within the earth, a mountain: The image of Modesty. Thus the superior man reduces that which is too much, and augments that which is too little. He weighs things and makes them equal.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Dentro de la tierra, una montaña: La imagen de la Humildad. Así el hombre superior reduce lo que está de más y aumenta lo que está disminuido, midiendo con justicia la posesión de las cosas.
image.image_it: Dentro la terra, una montagna: L'immagine dell'Umiltà. Così l'uomo superiore riduce ciò che è in più e aumenta ciò che è diminuito, misurando con giustizia il possesso delle cose.

lines_zh: 初六：謙謙君子，用涉大川，吉。
六二：鳴謙，貞吉。
九三：勞謙君子，有終吉。
六四：無不利，撝謙。
六五：不富以其鄰，利用侵伐，無不利。
上六：鳴謙，利用行師，征邑國。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: A superior man modest about his modesty may cross the great water. Good fortune.
Six in the second place: Modesty that comes to expression. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Nine in the third place: A superior man of modesty and merit carries things to conclusion. Good fortune.
Six in the fourth place: Nothing that would not further modesty in movement.
Six in the fifth place: No boasting of wealth before one's neighbor. It is favorable to attack with force. Nothing that would not further.
Six at the top: Modesty that comes to expression. It is favorable to set armies marching to chastise one's own city and one's country.
15.judgment_es: Éxito. El hombre superior lleva las cosas a término.
15.judgment_it: Successo. L'uomo nobile porta le cose a termine.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Un hombre superior modesto sobre su modestia puede cruzar la gran agua. Buena fortuna.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Modestia que viene a expresión. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Un hombre superior de modestia y mérito lleva las cosas a conclusión. Buena fortuna.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Nada que no favoreciera la modestia en el movimiento.
Seis en el quinto lugar: No jactarse de la riqueza ante el vecino. Es favorable atacar con fuerza. Nada que no favoreciera.
Seis en lo alto: Modestia que viene a expresión. Es favorable poner ejércitos en marcha para castigar a la propia ciudad y al propio país.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Un uomo nobile modesto riguardo alla sua modestia può attraversare la grande acqua. Buona fortuna.
Sei al secondo posto: Modestia che viene a espressione. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.
Nove al terzo posto: Un uomo nobile di modestia e merito porta le cose a conclusione. Buona fortuna.
Sei al quarto posto: Nulla che non favorisca la modestia nel movimento.
Sei al quinto posto: Non vantarsi della ricchezza davanti al vicino. È favorevole attaccare con forza. Nulla che non favorisca.
Sei in cima: Modestia che viene a espressione. È favorevole mettere eserciti in marcia per castigare la propria città e il proprio paese.

16.judgment_en: It furthers one to install helpers and to set armies marching.
16.commentary_desc: Po indicates that (in the state which it symbolizes) it will not be advantageous to make a movement in any direction whatever.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows one overturning the couch by injuring its legs. (The injury will go on to) the destruction of (all) firm correctness, and there will be evil.
The second six, divided, shows one overthrowing the couch by injuring its frame. (The injury will go on to) the destruction of (all) firm correctness, and there will be evil.
The third six, divided, shows its subject among the overthrowers; but there will be no error.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject having overthrown the couch, and (going to injure) the skin (of him who lies on it). There will be evil.

The fifth six, divided, shows (its subject leading on the others like) a string of fishes, and (obtaining for them) the favor that lights on the inmates of the palace. There will be advantage in every way.

The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject (as) a great fruit which has not been eaten. The superior man finds (the people again) as a chariot carrying him. The small men (by their course) overthrow their own dwellings.

image.image_zh: 雷出地奮，豫。先王以作樂崇德，殷薦之上帝，以配祖考。
image.image_en: Thunder comes resounding out of the earth: The image of Enthusiasm. Thus the ancient kings made music in order to honor merit, and offered it with splendor to the Supreme Deity, inviting their ancestors to be present.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El trueno sale de la tierra: La imagen del Entusiasmo. Así los reyes antiguos hacían música para honrar los méritos, y la presentaban con gloria a Dios, invitando así a sus antepasados a participar.
image.image_it: Il tuono esce dalla terra: L'immagine dell'Entusiasmo. Così i re antichi facevano musica per onorare i meriti, e la presentavano con gloria a Dio, invitando così i loro antenati a partecipare.

lines_zh: 初六：鳴豫，凶。
六二：介于石，不終日，貞吉。
六三：盱豫，悔，遲有悔。
九四：由豫，大有得，勿疑，朋盍簪。
六五：貞疾，恆不死。
上六：冥豫，成有渝，無咎。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Enthusiasm that expresses itself brings misfortune.
Six in the second place: Firm as a rock. Not a whole day. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Six in the third place: Enthusiasm that looks upward creates remorse. Hesitation brings remorse.
Nine in the fourth place: The source of enthusiasm. He achieves great things. Doubt not. You gather friends around you as a hair clasp gathers the hair.
Six in the fifth place: Persistently ill, and still does not die.
Six at the top: Deluded enthusiasm. But if after completion one changes, there is no blame.
16.judgment_es: Favorece al hombre instalar ayudantes y poner ejércitos en marcha.
16.judgment_it: È favorevole all'uomo installare aiutanti e mettere eserciti in marcia.
lines_es: Seis al principio: El entusiasmo que se expresa trae desgracia.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Firme como una roca. Ni un día entero. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.
Seis en el tercer lugar: El entusiasmo que mira hacia arriba crea remordimiento. La vacilación trae remordimiento.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: La fuente del entusiasmo. Él logra grandes cosas. No dudes. Reúnes amigos a tu alrededor como una pinza de pelo reúne el pelo.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Persistentemente enfermo, y aún no muere.
Seis en lo alto: Entusiasmo ilusorio. Pero si después de completarlo uno cambia, no hay culpa.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: L'entusiasmo che si esprime porta sventura.
Sei al secondo posto: Fermo come una roccia. Nemmeno un giorno intero. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.
Sei al terzo posto: L'entusiasmo che guarda verso l'alto crea rimorso. L'esitazione porta rimorso.
Nove al quarto posto: La fonte dell'entusiasmo. Egli ottiene grandi cose. Non dubitare. Raduni amici intorno a te come una pinza per capelli raccoglie i capelli.
Sei al quinto posto: Persistentemente malato, e ancora non muore.
Sei in cima: Entusiasmo illusorio. Ma se dopo averlo completato uno cambia, non c'è colpa.

17.judgment_en: Supreme success. Perseverance furthers. No blame.
17.commentary_desc: Kien suggests to us the marriage of a young lady, and the good fortune (attending it). There will be advantage in being firm and correct.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows the wild geese gradually approaching the shore. A young officer (in similar circumstances) will be in a position of danger, and be spoken against; but there will be no error.
The second six, divided, shows the geese gradually approaching the large rocks, where they eat and drink joyfully and at ease. There will be good fortune.

The third nine, undivided, shows them gradually advanced to the dry plains. (It suggests also the idea of) a husband who goes on an expedition from which he does not return, and of a wife who is pregnant, but will not nourish her child. There will be evil. (The case symbolized) might be advantageous in resisting plunderers.
The fourth six, divided, shows the geese gradually advanced to the trees. They may light on the flat branches. There will be no error.

The fifth nine, undivided, shows the geese gradually advanced to the high mound. (It suggests the idea of) a wife who for three years does not become pregnant; but in the end the natural issue cannot be prevented. There will be good fortune.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows the geese gradually advanced to the large heights (beyond). Their feathers can be used as ornaments. There will be good fortune.

image.image_zh: 澤中有雷，隨。君子以嚮晦入宴息。
image.image_en: Thunder in the middle of the lake: The image of Following. Thus the superior man at nightfall goes indoors for rest and recuperation.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: En el lago, el trueno: La imagen de la Adaptación. Así el hombre superior cuando está en reposo se prepara, y cuando está en movimiento lo decide.
image.image_it: Nel lago, il tuono: L'immagine dell'Adattamento. Così l'uomo superiore quando è in riposo si prepara, e quando è in movimento lo decide.

lines_zh: 初九：官有渝，貞吉，出門交有功。
六二：係小子，失丈夫。
六三：係丈夫，失小子，隨有求得，利居貞。
九四：隨有獲，貞凶，有孚在道，以明，何咎。
九五：孚于嘉，吉。
上六：拘係之，乃從維之，王用亨于西山。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: The standard is changing. Perseverance brings good fortune. To go out of the door in fellowship produces deeds.
Six in the second place: If one clings to the little boy, one loses the strong man.
Six in the third place: If one clings to the strong man, one loses the little boy. Through following one finds what one seeks. It furthers one to remain persevering.
Nine in the fourth place: Following creates success. Perseverance brings misfortune. To go one's way with sincerity brings clarity. What could there be to blame?
Nine in the fifth place: Sincere in the good. Good fortune.
Six at the top: He meets with firm allegiance and is still more bound. The king introduces him to the Western Mountain.
17.judgment_es: Supremo éxito. La perseverancia favorece. Sin culpa.
17.judgment_it: Supremo successo. La perseveranza favorisce. Nessuna colpa.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: El estándar está cambiando. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. Salir por la puerta en compañerismo produce obras.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Si te aferras al niño pequeño, pierdes al hombre fuerte.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Si te aferras al hombre fuerte, pierdes al niño pequeño. A través de seguir encuentras lo que buscas. Favorece al hombre permanecer perseverante.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Seguir crea éxito. La perseverancia trae desgracia. Ir por tu camino con sinceridad trae claridad. ¿Qué podría haber que culpar?
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Sincero en el bien. Buena fortuna.
Seis en lo alto: Encuentra lealtad firme y está aún más atado. El rey lo presenta a la Montaña Occidental.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Lo standard sta cambiando. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Uscire dalla porta in compagnia produce opere.
Sei al secondo posto: Se ti aggrappi al bambino piccolo, perdi l'uomo forte.
Sei al terzo posto: Se ti aggrappi all'uomo forte, perdi il bambino piccolo. Attraverso il seguire trovi ciò che cerchi. È favorevole all'uomo rimanere perseverante.
Nove al quarto posto: Seguire crea successo. La perseveranza porta sventura. Andare per la propria strada con sincerità porta chiarezza. Cosa potrebbe esserci da biasimare?
Nove al quinto posto: Sincero nel bene. Buona fortuna.
Sei in cima: Incontra lealtà ferma ed è ancora più legato. Il re lo presenta alla Montagna Occidentale.

18.name_es: El Trabajo en lo Echado a Perder
18.judgment_zh: 元亨，利涉大川。先甲三日，後甲三日。
18.judgment_en: Supreme success. It furthers one to cross the great water. Before the starting point, three days. After the starting point, three days.
18.commentary_desc: Kwei Mei indicates that (under the conditions which it denotes) action will be evil, and in no wise advantageous.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows the younger sister married off in a position ancillary to the real wife. (It suggests the idea of) a person lame on one leg who yet manages to tramp along. Going forward will be fortunate.
The second nine, undivided, shows her blind of one eye, and yet able to see. There will be advantage in her maintaining the firm correctness of a solitary widow.
