The third six, divided, shows the younger sister who was to be married off in a mean position. She returns and accepts an ancillary position.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows the younger sister who is to be married off protracting the time. She may be late in being married, but the time will come.

The fifth six, divided, reminds us of the marrying of the younger sister of (king) Ti-yi, when the sleeves of her the princess were not equal to those of the (still) younger sister who accompanied her in an inferior capacity. (The case suggests the thought oo the moon almost full. There will be good fortune.

The sixth six, divided, shows the young lady bearing the basket, but without anything in it, and the gentleman slaughtering the sheep, but without blood flowing from it. There will be no advantage in any way.

image.image_zh: 山下有風，蠱。君子以振民育德。
image.image_en: The wind blows low on the mountain: The image of Decay. Thus the superior man stirs up the people and strengthens their spirit.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Sobre la montaña, el viento: La imagen del Trabajo en lo Corrompido. Así el hombre superior agita al pueblo y fortalece su espíritu.
image.image_it: Sulla montagna, il vento: L'immagine del Lavoro nel Corrotto. Così l'uomo superiore agita il popolo e fortifica il suo spirito.

lines_zh: 初六：幹父之蠱，有子，考無咎，厲終吉。
九二：幹母之蠱，不可貞。
九三：幹父之蠱，小有悔，無大咎。
六四：裕父之蠱，往見吝。
六五：幹父之蠱，用譽。
上九：不事王侯，高尚其事。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Setting right what has been spoiled by the father. If there is a son, no blame rests upon the departed father. Danger. In the end good fortune.
Nine in the second place: Setting right what has been spoiled by the mother. One must not be too persevering.
Nine in the third place: Setting right what has been spoiled by the father. There will be a little remorse. No great blame.
Six in the fourth place: Tolerating what has been spoiled by the father. In continuing one sees humiliation.
Six in the fifth place: Setting right what has been spoiled by the father. One meets with praise.
Nine at the top: He does not serve kings and princes. He sets himself higher goals.
18.judgment_es: Supremo éxito. Favorece al hombre cruzar la gran agua. Antes del punto de partida, tres días. Después del punto de partida, tres días.
18.judgment_it: Supremo successo. È favorevole all'uomo attraversare la grande acqua. Prima del punto di partenza, tre giorni. Dopo il punto di partenza, tre giorni.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Corregir lo que ha sido estropeado por el padre. Si hay un hijo, no recae culpa sobre el padre fallecido. Peligro. Al final buena fortuna.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Corregir lo que ha sido estropeado por la madre. No debe ser demasiado perseverante.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Corregir lo que ha sido estropeado por el padre. Habrá un poco de remordimiento. Ninguna gran culpa.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Tolerar lo que ha sido estropeado por el padre. Al continuar se ve humillación.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Corregir lo que ha sido estropeado por el padre. Uno encuentra alabanza.
Nueve en lo alto: No sirve a reyes y príncipes. Se fija metas más altas.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Correggere ciò che è stato guastato dal padre. Se c'è un figlio, non ricade colpa sul padre defunto. Pericolo. Alla fine buona fortuna.
Nove al secondo posto: Correggere ciò che è stato guastato dalla madre. Non deve essere troppo perseverante.
Nove al terzo posto: Correggere ciò che è stato guastato dal padre. Ci sarà un po' di rimorso. Nessuna grande colpa.
Sei al quarto posto: Tolerare ciò che è stato guastato dal padre. Nel continuare si vede umiliazione.
Sei al quinto posto: Correggere ciò che è stato guastato dal padre. Si incontra lode.
Nove in cima: Non serve re e principi. Si fissa mete più alte.

19.judgment_zh: 元亨，利貞。至于八月有凶。
19.judgment_en: Great success. Perseverance furthers. When the eighth month comes, there will be misfortune.
19.commentary_desc: Shang indicates that (under its conditions) there will be great progress and success. Seeking by (the qualities implied in it) to meet with the great man, its subject need have no anxiety. Advance to the south will be fortunate.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject advancing upwards with the welcome (of those above him). There will be great good fortune.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject with that sincerity which will make even the (small) offerings of the vernal sacrifice acceptable. There will be no error.
The third nine, undivided, shows its subject ascending upwards (as into) an empty city.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject employed by the king to present his offerings on mount Khi. There will be good fortune; there will be no mistake.
The fifth six, divided, shows its subject firmly correct, and therefore enjoying good fortune. He ascends the stairs (with all due ceremony).
The sixth six, divided, shows its subject advancing upwards blindly. Advantage will be found in a ceaseless maintenance of firm correctness.

image.image_zh: 澤上有地，臨。君子以教思無窮，容保民無疆。
image.image_en: The earth above the lake: The image of Approach. Thus the superior man is inexhaustible in his will to teach, and without limits in his tolerance and protection of the people.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Sobre la tierra, el lago: La imagen de la Cercanía. Así el hombre superior es instruido y diligente, en consideración a todas las cosas.
image.image_it: Sulla terra, il lago: L'immagine della Vicinanza. Così l'uomo superiore è istruito e diligente, in considerazione a tutte le cose.

lines_zh: 初九：咸臨，貞吉。
九二：咸臨，吉，無不利。
六三：甘臨，無攸利，既憂之，無咎。
六四：至臨，無咎。
六五：知臨，大君之宜，吉。
上六：敦臨，吉，無咎。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Joint approach. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Nine in the second place: Joint approach. Good fortune. Everything furthers.
Six in the third place: Comfortable approach. Nothing that would further. If one is induced to grieve over it, one becomes free of blame.
Six in the fourth place: Complete approach. No blame.
Six in the fifth place: Wise approach. This is right for a great prince. Good fortune.
Six at the top: Greathearted approach. Good fortune. No blame.
19.judgment_es: Gran éxito. La perseverancia favorece. Cuando llegue el octavo mes, habrá desgracia.
19.judgment_it: Gran successo. La perseveranza favorisce. Quando arriverà l'ottavo mese, ci sarà sventura.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Aproximación conjunta. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Aproximación conjunta. Buena fortuna. Todo favorece.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Aproximación cómoda. Nada que favoreciera. Si uno es inducido a lamentarlo, se libera de culpa.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Aproximación completa. Sin culpa.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Aproximación sabia. Esto es correcto para un gran príncipe. Buena fortuna.
Seis en lo alto: Aproximación magnánima. Buena fortuna. Sin culpa.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Avvicinamento congiunto. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.
Nove al secondo posto: Avvicinamento congiunto. Buona fortuna. Tutto favorisce.
Sei al terzo posto: Avvicinamento comodo. Nulla che favorisca. Se uno è indotto a lamentarsene, si libera da colpa.
Sei al quarto posto: Avvicinamento completo. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al quinto posto: Avvicinamento saggio. Questo è corretto per un gran principe. Buona fortuna.
Sei in cima: Avvicinamento magnanimo. Buona fortuna. Nessuna colpa.

20.judgment_en: The ablution has been made, but not yet the offering. Full of trust they look up to him.
20.commentary_desc: In (the state denoted by) Tsui, the king will repair to his ancestral temple. It will be advantageous (also) to meet with the great man; and then there will be progress and success, though the advantage must come through firm correctness. The use of great victims will conduce to good fortune; and in whatever direction movement is made, it will be advantageous.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject with a sincere desire (for union), but unable to carry it out, so that disorder is brought into the sphere of his union. If he cry out (for help to his proper correlate), all at once (his tears) will give place to smiles. He need not mind (the temporary difficulty); as he goes forward, there will be no error.

The second six, divided, shows its subject led forward (by his correlate). There will be good fortune, and freedom from error. There is entire sincerity, and in that case (even the small offerings of) the vernal sacrifice are acceptable.

The third six, divided, shows its subject striving after union and seeming to sigh, yet nowhere finding any advantage. If he go forward, he will not err, though there may be some small cause for regret.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject in such a state that, if he be greatly fortunate, he will receive no blame.

The fifth nine, undivided, shows the union (of all) under its subject in the place of dignity. There will be no error. If any do not have confidence in him, let him see to it that (his virtue) be great, long continued, and firmly correct, and all occasion for repentance will disappear.
The topmost six, divided, shows its subject sighing and weeping; but there will be no error.

image.image_zh: 風行地上，觀。先王以省方觀民設教。
image.image_en: The wind blows over the earth: The image of Contemplation. Thus the kings of old visited the regions of the world, contemplated the people, and gave them instruction.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El viento sopla sobre la tierra: La imagen de la Contemplación. Así los reyes antiguos visitaban las regiones del mundo, contemplaban al pueblo y daban instrucciones.
image.image_it: Il vento soffia sulla terra: L'immagine della Contemplazione. Così i re antichi visitavano le regioni del mondo, contemplavano il popolo e davano istruzioni.

lines_zh: 初六：童觀，小人無咎，君子吝。
六二：闚觀，利女貞。
六三：觀我生，進退。
六四：觀國之光，利用賓于王。
九五：觀我生，君子無咎。
上九：觀其生，君子無咎。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Boylike contemplation. For an inferior man, no blame. For a superior man, humiliation.
Six in the second place: Contemplation through the crack of the door. Furthering to the perseverance of a woman.
Six in the third place: Contemplation of my life decides the choice between advance and retreat.
Six in the fourth place: Contemplation of the light of the kingdom. It furthers one to exert influence as the guest of a king.
Nine in the fifth place: Contemplation of my life. The superior man is without blame.
Nine at the top: Contemplation of his life. The superior man is without blame.
20.judgment_es: La ablución ha sido hecha, pero aún no la ofrenda. Llenos de confianza le miran a él.
20.judgment_it: L'abluzione è stata fatta, ma non ancora l'offerta. Pieni di fiducia lo guardano.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Contemplación de niño. Para un hombre inferior, sin culpa. Para un hombre superior, humillación.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Contemplación a través de la rendija de la puerta. Favorecedor para la perseverancia de una mujer.
Seis en el tercer lugar: La contemplación de mi vida decide la elección entre avanzar y retroceder.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Contemplación de la luz del reino. Favorece al hombre ejercer influencia como huésped de un rey.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Contemplación de mi vida. El hombre superior está sin culpa.
Nueve en lo alto: Contemplación de su vida. El hombre superior está sin culpa.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Contemplazione da bambino. Per un uomo inferiore, nessuna colpa. Per un uomo nobile, umiliazione.
Sei al secondo posto: Contemplazione attraverso la fessura della porta. Favorevole per la perseveranza di una donna.
Sei al terzo posto: La contemplazione della mia vita decide la scelta tra avanzare e retrocedere.
Sei al quarto posto: Contemplazione della luce del regno. È favorevole all'uomo esercitare influenza come ospite di un re.
Nove al quinto posto: Contemplazione della mia vita. L'uomo nobile è senza colpa.
Nove in cima: Contemplazione della sua vita. L'uomo nobile è senza colpa.

21.judgment_en: Success. It is favorable to let justice be administered.
21.commentary_desc: Lu intimates that (in the condition which it denotes) there may be some little attainment and progress. If the stranger or traveler be firm and correct as he ought to be, there will be good fortune.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows the stranger mean and meanly occupied. It is thus that hebrings on himself (further) calamity.
The second six, divided, shows the stranger, occupying his lodging-house, carrying with him his means of livelihood, and provided with good and trusty servants.
The third nine, undivided, shows the stranger, burning his lodging-house, and having lost his servants. However firm and correct he (try to) be, he will be in peril.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows the traveler in a resting-place, having (also) the means of livelihood and the axe, (but still saying),'I am not at ease in my mind.'
The fifth six, divided, shows its subject shooting a pheasant. He will lose his arrow, but in the end he will obtain praise and a (high) charge.

The sixth nine, undivided, suggests the idea of a bird burning its nest. The stranger, (thus represented), first laughs and then cries out. He has lost his ox(-like docility) too readily and easily. There will be evil.

image.image_zh: 雷電噬嗑。先王以明罰敕法。
image.image_en: Thunder and lightning: The image of Biting Through. Thus the kings of old made firm the laws through clearly defined penalties.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El trueno y el relámpago: La imagen de la Mordedura. Así los reyes antiguos establecían las penas para aclarar las leyes.
image.image_it: Il tuono e il fulmine: L'immagine del Morso. Così i re antichi stabilivano le pene per chiarire le leggi.

lines_zh: 初九：屨校滅趾，無咎。
六二：噬膚滅鼻，無咎。
六三：噬腊肉，遇毒，小吝，無咎。
九四：噬乾胏，得金矢，利艱貞，吉。
六五：噬乾肉，得黃金，貞厲，無咎。
上九：何校滅耳，凶。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: His feet are fastened in the stocks, so that his toes disappear. No blame.
Six in the second place: Bites through tender meat, so that his nose disappears. No blame.
Six in the third place: Bites on old dried meat and strikes on something poisonous. Slight humiliation. No blame.
Nine in the fourth place: Bites on dried gristly meat. Receives metal arrows. It furthers one to be mindful of difficulties and to be persevering. Good fortune.
Six in the fifth place: Bites on dried lean meat. Receives yellow gold. Firmly aware of danger. No blame.
Nine at the top: His neck is fastened in the wooden cangue, so that his ears disappear. Misfortune.
21.judgment_es: Éxito. Es favorable dejar que se administre justicia.
21.judgment_it: Successo. È favorevole lasciare che venga amministrata giustizia.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Sus pies están sujetos en el cepo, de modo que sus dedos desaparecen. Sin culpa.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Muerde carne tierna, de modo que su nariz desaparece. Sin culpa.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Muerde carne seca vieja y golpea algo venenoso. Ligera humillación. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Muerde carne seca cartilaginosa. Recibe flechas metálicas. Favorece al hombre ser consciente de las dificultades y ser perseverante. Buena fortuna.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Muerde carne magra seca. Recibe oro amarillo. Firmemente consciente del peligro. Sin culpa.
Nueve en lo alto: Su cuello está sujeto en el cangue de madera, de modo que sus orejas desaparecen. Desgracia.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: I suoi piedi sono legati nelle gogne, in modo che le sue dita spariscano. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al secondo posto: Morde carne tenera, in modo che il suo naso sparisca. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al terzo posto: Morde carne secca vecchia e colpisce qualcosa di velenoso. Leggera umiliazione. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al quarto posto: Morde carne secca cartilaginea. Riceve frecce metalliche. È favorevole all'uomo essere consapevole delle difficoltà e essere perseverante. Buona fortuna.
Sei al quinto posto: Morde carne magra secca. Riceve oro giallo. Fermamente consapevole del pericolo. Nessuna colpa.
Nove in cima: Il suo collo è legato nella gogna di legno, in modo che le sue orecchie spariscano. Sventura.

22.judgment_en: Success. In small matters it is favorable to undertake something.
22.commentary_desc: Fang intimates progress and development. When a king has reached the point (which the name denotes there is no occasion to be anxious (through fear of a change). Let him be as the sun at noon.,
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject meeting with his mate. Though they are both of the same character, there will be no error. Advance will call forth approval.

The second six, divided, shows its subject surrounded by screens so large and t ' hick that at midday he can see from them the constellation of the Bushel. If he go (and try to enlighten his ruler who is thus emblemed), he will make himself to be viewed with suspicion and dislike. Let him cherish his feeling of sincere devotion that he may thereby move (his ruler's mind), and there will be good fortune.

The third nine, undivided, shows its subject with an (additional) screen of a large and thick banner, through which at midday he can see (the small) Mei star. (In the darkness) he breaks his right arm; but there will be no error.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject' in a tent so large and thick that at midday he can see from it the constellation of the Bushel. But he meets with the subject of the (first) line, undivided like himself. There will be good fortune.
The fifth six, divided, shows its subject bringing around him the men of brilliant ability. There will be occasion for congratulation and praise. There will be good fortune.

The topmost six, divided, shows its subject with his house made large, but only serving as a screen to his household. When he looks at his door, it is still, and there is nobody about it. For three years no one is to be seen. There will be evil.

image.image_zh: 山下有火，賁。君子以明庶政，無敢折獄。
image.image_en: Fire at the foot of the mountain: The image of Grace. Thus does the superior man proceed when clearing up current affairs. But he dare not decide controversial issues in this way.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Bajo la montaña, el fuego: La imagen de la Gracia. Así el hombre superior ilumina los asuntos del país, pero no se atreve a juzgar con claridad los asuntos de las cortes.
image.image_it: Sotto la montagna, il fuoco: L'immagine della Grazia. Così l'uomo superiore illumina gli affari del paese, ma non osa giudicare con chiarezza gli affari delle corti.

lines_zh: 初九：賁其趾，舍車而徒。
六二：賁其須。
九三：賁如濡如，永貞吉。
六四：賁如皤如，白馬翰如，匪寇婚媾。
六五：賁于丘園，束帛戔戔，吝，終吉。
上九：白賁，無咎。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: He lends grace to his toes, leaves the carriage, and walks.
Six in the second place: Lends grace to the beard on his chin.
Nine in the third place: Graceful and moist. Constant perseverance brings good fortune.
Six in the fourth place: Grace or simplicity? A white horse comes as if on wings. He is not a robber, he will woo at the right time.
Six in the fifth place: Grace in hills and gardens. The roll of silk is meager and small. Humiliation, but in the end good fortune.
Nine at the top: Simple grace. No blame.
22.judgment_es: Éxito. En asuntos pequeños es favorable emprender algo.
22.judgment_it: Successo. In questioni piccole è favorevole intraprendere qualcosa.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Presta gracia a sus dedos de los pies, deja el carro, y camina.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Presta gracia a la barba en su mentón.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Gracioso y húmedo. Perseverancia constante trae buena fortuna.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: ¿Gracia o sencillez? Un caballo blanco viene como si tuviera alas. No es un ladrón, cortejará en el momento adecuado.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Gracia en colinas y jardines. El rollo de seda es escaso y pequeño. Humillación, pero al final buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: Gracia sencilla. Sin culpa.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Presta grazia alle sue dita dei piedi, lascia il carro, e cammina.
Sei al secondo posto: Presta grazia alla barba sul suo mento.
Nove al terzo posto: Grazioso e umido. Perseveranza costante porta buona fortuna.
Sei al quarto posto: Grazia o semplicità? Un cavallo bianco viene come se avesse ali. Non è un ladro, corteggerà al momento opportuno.
Sei al quinto posto: Grazia in colline e giardini. Il rotolo di seta è scarso e piccolo. Umiliazione, ma alla fine buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: Grazia semplice. Nessuna colpa.

23.judgment_en: It does not further one to go anywhere.
23.commentary_desc: Yu indicates that, (in the state which it implies), feudal princes may be set up, and the hosts put in motion, with advantage.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject proclaiming his pleasure and satisfaction. There will be evil.
The second six, divided, shows one who is firm as a rock. (He sees a thing) without waiting till it has come to pass; with his firm correctness there will be good fortune.

The third six, divided, shows one looking up, (for favors), while he indulges the feeling of pleasure and satisfaction. If he would understand! -- If he be late in doing so, there will indeed be occasion for repentance.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows him from whom the harmony and satisfaction come. Great is the success which he obtains. Let him not allow suspicions to enter his mind, and thus friends will gather around him.
The fifth six, divided, shows one with a chronic complaint, but who lives on without dying.

The topmost six, divided, shows its subject with darkened mind devoted to the pleasure and satisfaction (of the time); but if he change his course even when (it may be considered as) completed, there will be no error.

image.image_zh: 山附於地，剝。上以厚下安宅。
image.image_en: The mountain rests on the earth: The image of Splitting Apart. Thus those above can ensure their position only by giving generously to those below.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: La montaña descansa sobre la tierra: La imagen del Desgaste. Así los superiores aseguran su posición favoreciendo a los inferiores.
image.image_it: La montagna riposa sulla terra: L'immagine dello Sfaldamento. Così i superiori assicurano la loro posizione favorendo gli inferiori.

lines_zh: 初六：剝床以足，蔑貞凶。
六二：剝床以辨，蔑貞凶。
六三：剝之，無咎。
六四：剝床以膚，凶。
六五：貫魚，以宮人寵，無不利。
上九：碩果不食，君子得輿，小人剝廬。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: The leg of the bed is split. Those who persevere are destroyed. Misfortune.
Six in the second place: The bed is split at the edge. Those who persevere are destroyed. Misfortune.
Six in the third place: He splits with them. No blame.
Six in the fourth place: The bed is split up to the skin. Misfortune.
Six in the fifth place: A shoal of fishes. Favor comes through the court ladies. Everything acts to further.
Nine at the top: There is a large fruit still uneaten. The superior man receives a carriage. The house of the inferior man is split apart.
23.judgment_es: No favorece al hombre ir a ninguna parte.
23.judgment_it: Non è favorevole all'uomo andare da nessuna parte.
lines_es: Seis al principio: La pata de la cama está partida. Aquellos que perseveran son destruidos. Desgracia.
Seis en el segundo lugar: La cama está partida en el borde. Aquellos que perseveran son destruidos. Desgracia.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Él se separa con ellos. Sin culpa.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: La cama está partida hasta la piel. Desgracia.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Un cardumen de peces. El favor viene a través de las damas de la corte. Todo actúa para favorecer.
Nueve en lo alto: Hay una fruta grande aún no comida. El hombre superior recibe un carro. La casa del hombre inferior se parte.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: La gamba del letto è spaccata. Coloro che perseverano sono distrutti. Sventura.
Sei al secondo posto: Il letto è spaccato sul bordo. Coloro che perseverano sono distrutti. Sventura.
Sei al terzo posto: Egli si separa con loro. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al quarto posto: Il letto è spaccato fino alla pelle. Sventura.
Sei al quinto posto: Un banco di pesci. Il favore viene attraverso le dame di corte. Tutto agisce per favorire.
Nove in cima: C'è un frutto grande ancora non mangiato. L'uomo nobile riceve un carro. La casa dell'uomo inferiore si spacca.

24.judgment_zh: 亨。出入無疾，朋來無咎。反復其道，七日來復，利有攸往。
24.judgment_en: Success. Going out and coming in without error. Friends come without blame. To and fro goes the way. On the seventh day comes return. It furthers one to have somewhere to go.
24.commentary_desc: Khien indicates progress and success. The superior man, (being humble as it implies), will have a (good) issue (to his undertakings).
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows us the superior man who adds humility to humility. (Even) the great stream may be crossed with this, and there will be good fortune.
The second six, divided, shows us humility that has made itself recognized. With firm correctness there will be good fortune.
The third nine, undivided, shows the superior man of (acknowledged) merit. He will maintain his success to the end, and have good fortune.
The fourth six, divided, shows one, whose action would be in every way advantageous, stirring up (the more) his humility.
The fifth six, divided, shows one who, without being rich, is able to employ his neighbors. He may advantageously use the force of arms. All his movements will be advantageous.
The sixth six, divided, shows us humility that has made itself recognized. The subject of it will with advantage put his hosts in motion; but (he will only) punish his own towns and state.

image.image_zh: 雷在地中，復。先王以至日閉關，商旅不行，后不省方。
image.image_en: Thunder within the earth: The image of the Turning Point. Thus the kings of old closed the passes at the time of solstice. Merchants and strangers did not go about, and the ruler did not travel through the provinces.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El trueno dentro de la tierra: La imagen del Retorno. Así los reyes de antaño cerraban los pasos en los momentos de solsticio, y los mercaderes viajeros no salían, y el gobernante no visitaba las regiones.
image.image_it: Il tuono dentro la terra: L'immagine del Ritorno. Così i re di un tempo chiudevano i passi nei momenti di solstizio, e i mercanti viaggiatori non uscivano, e il governatore non visitava le regioni.

lines_zh: 初九：不遠復，無祇悔，元吉。
六二：休復，吉。
六三：頻復，厲，無咎。
六四：中行獨復。
六五：敦復，無悔。
上六：迷復，凶，有災眚。用行師，終有大敗，以其國君，凶，至于十年不克征。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Return from a short distance. No need for remorse. Great good fortune.
Six in the second place: Quiet return. Good fortune.
Six in the third place: Repeated return. Danger. No blame.
Six in the fourth place: Walking in the midst of others, one returns alone.
Six in the fifth place: Noblehearted return. No remorse.

Six at the top: Missing the return. Misfortune. Terror from within and without. If armies are set in motion, one will in the end suffer a great defeat, disastrous for the ruler of the country. For ten years it will not be possible to attack again.
24.judgment_es: Éxito. Salir y entrar sin error. Los amigos vienen sin culpa. De aquí para allá va el camino. Al séptimo día viene el retorno. Favorece al hombre tener adónde ir.
24.judgment_it: Successo. Uscire ed entrare senza errore. Gli amici vengono senza colpa. Di qua e di là va il cammino. Al settimo giorno viene il ritorno. È favorevole all'uomo avere dove andare.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Retorno desde una distancia corta. No hay necesidad de remordimiento. Gran buena fortuna.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Retorno tranquilo. Buena fortuna.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Retorno repetido. Peligro. Sin culpa.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Caminando en medio de otros, uno regresa solo.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Retorno de corazón noble. Sin remordimiento.

Seis en lo alto: Perder el retorno. Desgracia. Terror de dentro y de fuera. Si se ponen en movimiento ejércitos, uno sufrirá al final una gran derrota, desastrosa para el gobernante del país. Por diez años no será posible atacar de nuevo.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Ritorno da una distanza corta. Non c'è bisogno di rimorso. Gran buona fortuna.
Sei al secondo posto: Ritorno tranquillo. Buona fortuna.
Sei al terzo posto: Ritorno ripetuto. Pericolo. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al quarto posto: Camminando in mezzo agli altri, uno ritorna solo.
Sei al quinto posto: Ritorno di cuore nobile. Nessun rimorso.

Sei in cima: Perdere il ritorno. Sventura. Terrore di dentro e di fuori. Se si mettono in moto eserciti, uno soffrirà alla fine una grande sconfitta, disastrosa per il governante del paese. Per dieci anni non sarà possibile attaccare di nuovo.

25.judgment_zh: 元亨，利貞。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。
25.judgment_en: Supreme success. Perseverance furthers. If someone is not as he should be, he has misfortune. It does not further one to undertake anything.
25.commentary_desc: Thun indicates successful progress (in its circumstances). To a small extent it will (still) be advantageous to be firm and correct.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows a retiring tail. The position is perilous. No movement in any direction should be made.
The second six, divided, shows its subject holding (his purpose) fast as if by a (thong made from the) hide of a yellow ox, which cannot be broken.
The third nine, undivided, shows one retiring but bound,-to his distress and peril. (If he were to deal with his binders as in) nourishing a servant or concubine, it would be fortunate for him.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject retiring notwithstanding his likings. In a superior man this will lead to good fortune; a small man cannot attain to this.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject retiring in an admirable way. With firm correctness there will be good fortune.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows its subject retiring in a noble way. It will be advantageous in ev ery respect.

image.image_zh: 天下雷行，無妄。先王以茂對時育萬物。
image.image_en: Under heaven thunder rolls: The image of Innocence. Thus the kings of old, rich in virtue, and in harmony with the time, fostered and nourished all beings.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Bajo el cielo, el trueno: La imagen de la Inocencia. Así el hombre superior se conduce sin discusión, y en su alimentación no busca el disfrute excesivo.
image.image_it: Sotto il cielo, il tuono: L'immagine dell'Innocenza. Così l'uomo superiore si conduce senza discussione, e nel suo nutrimento non cerca il godimento eccessivo.

lines_zh: 初九：無妄，往吉。
六二：不耕穫，不菑畬，則利有攸往。
六三：無妄之災，或繫之牛，行人之得，邑人之災。
九四：可貞，無咎。
九五：無妄之疾，勿藥有喜。
上九：無妄，行有眚，無攸利。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Innocent behavior. Good fortune.
Six in the second place: If one does not count on the harvest while plowing, nor on the use of the ground while clearing it, it furthers one to undertake something.
Six in the third place: Undeserved misfortune. The cow that was tethered by someone is the wanderer's gain, the citizen's loss.
Nine in the fourth place: He who can be persevering remains without blame.
Nine in the fifth place: Use no medicine in an illness incurred through no fault of your own. It will pass of itself.
Nine at the top: Innocent action brings misfortune. Nothing that would further.
25.judgment_es: Supremo éxito. La perseverancia favorece. Si alguien no es como debería ser, tiene desgracia. No favorece al hombre emprender nada.
25.judgment_it: Supremo successo. La perseveranza favorisce. Se qualcuno non è come dovrebbe essere, ha sventura. Non è favorevole all'uomo intraprendere nulla.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Conducta inocente. Buena fortuna.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Si uno no cuenta con la cosecha mientras ara, ni con el uso del suelo mientras lo limpia, favorece al hombre emprender algo.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Desgracia inmerecida. La vaca que fue atada por alguien es la ganancia del caminante, la pérdida del ciudadano.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Quien puede ser perseverante permanece sin culpa.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: No uses medicina en una enfermedad contraída sin culpa tuya. Pasará por sí misma.
Nueve en lo alto: La acción inocente trae desgracia. Nada que favoreciera.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Condotta innocente. Buona fortuna.
Sei al secondo posto: Se uno non conta sul raccolto mentre ara, né sull'uso del terreno mentre lo pulisce, è favorevole all'uomo intraprendere qualcosa.
Sei al terzo posto: Sventura immeritata. La mucca che fu legata da qualcuno è il guadagno del viandante, la perdita del cittadino.
Nove al quarto posto: Chi può essere perseverante rimane senza colpa.
Nove al quinto posto: Non usare medicina in una malattia contratta senza colpa tua. Passerà da sé.
Nove in cima: L'azione innocente porta sventura. Nulla che favorisca.

26.name_es: La Fuerza Domesticadora de lo Grande
26.judgment_zh: 利貞，不家食吉，利涉大川。
26.judgment_en: Perseverance furthers. Not eating at home brings good fortune. It furthers one to cross the great water.
26.commentary_desc: Ta Kwang indicates that (under the conditions which it symbolizes) it will be advantageous to be firm and correct.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject manifesting his strength in his toes. But advance will lead to evil, -most certainly.
The second nine, undivided, shows that with firm correctness there will be good fortune.

The third nine, undivided, shows, in the case of a small man, one using all his strength; and in the case of a superior man, one whose rule is not to do so. Even with firm correctness the position would be perilous. (The exercise of strength in it might be compared to the case of) a ram butting against a fence, and getting his horns entangled.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows (a case in which) firm correctness leads to good fortune, and occasion for repentance disappears. (We see) the fence opened without the horns being entangled. The strength is like that in the wheel-spokes of a large wagon.
The fifth six, divided, shows one who loses his ram (-like strength) in the ease of his position. (But) there will be no occasion for repentance.

The sixth six, divided, shows (one who may be compared to) the ram butting against the fence, and unable either to retreat, or to advance as he would fain do. There will not be advantage in any respect; but if he realize the difficulty (of his position), there will be good fortune.

image.image_zh: 天在山中，大畜。君子以多識前言往行，以畜其德。
image.image_en: Heaven within the mountain: The image of the Taming Power of the Great. Thus the superior man acquaints himself with many sayings of antiquity and many deeds of the past, in order to strengthen his character thereby.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El cielo dentro de la montaña: La imagen del Poder de lo Grande. Así el hombre superior aprende de múltiples ejemplos de lo pasado para así fortalecer su carácter.
image.image_it: Il cielo dentro la montagna: L'immagine del Potere del Grande. Così l'uomo superiore impara da molteplici esempi del passato per così fortificare il suo carattere.

lines_zh: 初九：有厲，利已。
九二：輿說輹。
九三：良馬逐，利艱貞。曰閑輿衛，利有攸往。
六四：童牛之牿，元吉。
六五：豶豕之牙，吉。
上九：何天之衢，亨。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Danger is at hand. It furthers one to desist.
Nine in the second place: The axletrees are taken from the wagon.
Nine in the third place: A good horse that follows others. Awareness of danger, with perseverance, furthers. Practice chariot driving and armed defense daily. It furthers one to have somewhere to go.
Six in the fourth place: The headboard of a young bull. Great good fortune.
Six in the fifth place: The tusk of a gelded boar. Good fortune.
Nine at the top: One attains the way of heaven. Success.
26.judgment_es: La perseverancia favorece. No comer en casa trae buena fortuna. Favorece al hombre cruzar la gran agua.
26.judgment_it: La perseveranza favorisce. Non mangiare in casa porta buona fortuna. È favorevole all'uomo attraversare la grande acqua.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: El peligro está a la mano. Favorece al hombre desistir.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Los ejes son quitados del carro.

Nueve en el tercer lugar: Un buen caballo que sigue a otros. Conciencia del peligro, con perseverancia, favorece. Practica el manejo del carro y la defensa armada diariamente. Favorece al hombre tener adónde ir.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: La cabecera de un toro joven. Gran buena fortuna.
Seis en el quinto lugar: El colmillo de un jabalí castrado. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: Uno alcanza el camino del cielo. Éxito.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Il pericolo è a portata di mano. È favorevole all'uomo desistere.
Nove al secondo posto: Gli assi sono tolti dal carro.

Nove al terzo posto: Un buon cavallo che segue gli altri. Consapevolezza del pericolo, con perseveranza, favorisce. Pratica la guida del carro e la difesa armata quotidianamente. È favorevole all'uomo avere dove andare.
Sei al quarto posto: La testiera di un toro giovane. Gran buona fortuna.
Sei al quinto posto: La zanna di un cinghiale castrato. Buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: Si raggiunge la via del cielo. Successo.

27.judgment_en: Perseverance brings good fortune. Pay heed to the providing of nourishment and to what a man seeks to fill his own mouth with.
27.commentary_desc: Hsiao Kwo indicates that (in the circumstances which it implies) there will be progress and attainment. But it will be advantageous to be firm and correct. (What the name denotes) may be done in small affairs, but not in great affairs. (It is like) the notes that come down from a bird on the wing;-to descend is better than to ascend. There will (in this way) be great good fortune.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, suggests (the idea of) a bird flying, (and ascending) till the issue is evil.

The second six, divided, shows its subject passing by his grandfather, and meeting with his grandmother; not attempting anything against his ruler, but meeting him as his minister. There will be no error.
The third nine, undivided, shows its subject taking no extraordinary precautions against danger; and some in consequence finding opportunity to assail and injure him. There will be evil.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject falling into no error, but meeting (the exigency of his situation), without exceeding (in his natural course). If he go forward, there will be peril, and he must be cautious. There is no occasion to be using firmness perpetually.
The fifth six, divided, (suggests the idea) of dense clouds, but no rain, coming from our borders in the west. It also (shows) the prince shooting his arrow, and taking the bird in a cave.

The sixth six, divided, shows its subject not meeting (the exigency of his situation), and exceeding (his proper course). (It suggests the idea of) a bird flying far aloft. There will be evil. The case is what is called one of calamity and self produced injury.

image.image_zh: 山下有雷，頤。君子以慎言語，節飲食。
image.image_en: At the foot of the mountain, thunder: The image of Providing Nourishment. Thus the superior man is careful of his words and temperate in eating and drinking.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El trueno bajo la montaña: La imagen de la Alimentación. Así el hombre superior es cuidadoso con sus palabras y moderado en su alimentación y bebida.
image.image_it: Il tuono sotto la montagna: L'immagine del Nutrire. Così l'uomo superiore è cauto con le sue parole e moderato nel suo nutrimento e bevanda.

lines_zh: 初九：舍爾靈龜，觀我朵頤，凶。
六二：顛頤，拂經，于丘頤，征凶。
六三：拂頤，貞凶，十年勿用，無攸利。
六四：顛頤，吉，虎視眈眈，其欲逐逐，無咎。
六五：拂經，居貞吉，不可涉大川。
上九：由頤，厲吉，利涉大川。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: You let your magic tortoise go, and look at me with the corners of your mouth drooping. Misfortune.
Six in the second place: Turning to the summit for nourishment, deviating from the path. To seek nourishment from the hill. Continuing to do this brings misfortune.
Six in the third place: Turning away from nourishment. Perseverance brings misfortune. Do not act thus for ten years. Nothing serves to further.
Six in the fourth place: Turning to the summit for provision brings good fortune. Spying about with sharp eyes like a tiger with insatiable craving. No blame.
Six in the fifth place: Turning away from the path. To remain persevering brings good fortune. One should not cross the great water.
Nine at the top: The source of nourishment. Awareness of danger brings good fortune. It furthers one to cross the great water.
27.judgment_es: La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. Presta atención al proporcionar sustento y a lo que el hombre busca para llenar su propia boca.
27.judgment_it: La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Presta attenzione al fornire sostentamento e a ciò che l'uomo cerca per riempire la propria bocca.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Dejas ir tu tortuga mágica, y me miras con las comisuras de tu boca caídas. Desgracia.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Volviéndose a la cumbre para sustento, desviándose del camino. Buscar sustento de la colina. Continuar haciendo esto trae desgracia.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Apartándose del sustento. La perseverancia trae desgracia. No actúes así por diez años. Nada sirve para favorecer.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Volviéndose a la cumbre para provisión trae buena fortuna. Espiando con ojos afilados como un tigre con anhelo insaciable. Sin culpa.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Apartándose del camino. Permanecer perseverante trae buena fortuna. No debe cruzar la gran agua.
Nueve en lo alto: La fuente del sustento. Conciencia del peligro trae buena fortuna. Favorece al hombre cruzar la gran agua.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Lasci andare la tua tartaruga magica, e mi guardi con le commissure della bocca cadenti. Sventura.
Sei al secondo posto: Rivolgendosi alla cima per sostentamento, deviandosi dal cammino. Cercare sostentamento dalla collina. Continuare a farlo porta sventura.
Sei al terzo posto: Allontanandosi dal sostentamento. La perseveranza porta sventura. Non agire così per dieci anni. Nulla serve a favorire.
Sei al quarto posto: Rivolgendosi alla cima per provvigione porta buona fortuna. Spiano con occhi affilati come una tigre con brama insaziabile. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al quinto posto: Allontanandosi dal cammino. Rimanere perseverante porta buona fortuna. Non deve attraversare la grande acqua.
Nove in cima: La fonte del sostentamento. Consapevolezza del pericolo porta buona fortuna. È favorevole all'uomo attraversare la grande acqua.

28.judgment_en: The ridgepole sags to the breaking point. It furthers one to have somewhere to go. Success.
28.commentary_desc: Kung Fu (moves even) pigs and fish, and leads to good fortune. There will be advantage in crossing the great stream. There will be advantage in being firm and correct.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject resting (in himself). There will be good fortune. If he sought to any other, he would not find rest.

The second nine, undivided, shows its subject (like) the crane crying out in her hidden retirement, and her young ones responding to her. (It is as if it were said), ' I have a cup of good spirits,' (and the response were), 'I will partake of it with you.'
The third six, divided, shows its subject having met with his mate. Now he beats his drum, and now he leaves off. Now he weeps, and now he sings.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject (like) the moon nearly full, and (like) a horse (in a chariot) whose fellow disappears. There will be no error.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject perfectly sincere, and linking (others) to him in closest union. There will be no error.
The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject in chanticleer (trying to) mount to heaven. Even with firm correctness there will be evil.

image.image_zh: 澤滅木，大過。君子以獨立不懼，遯世無悶。
image.image_en: The lake rises above the trees: The image of Preponderance of the Great. Thus the superior man, when he stands alone, is unconcerned, and if he has to renounce the world, he is undaunted.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El lago sube sobre los árboles: La imagen de la Preponderancia de lo Grande. Así el hombre superior cuando está solo no tiene temor, y cuando tiene que renunciar al mundo no se entristece.
image.image_it: Il lago sale sugli alberi: L'immagine della Preponderanza del Grande. Così l'uomo superiore quando è solo non ha timore, e quando deve rinunciare al mondo non si rattrista.

lines_zh: 初六：藉用白茅，無咎。
九二：枯楊生稊，老夫得其女妻，無不利。
九三：棟橈，凶。
九四：棟隆，吉，有它吝。
九五：枯楊生華，老婦得其士夫，無咎無譽。
上六：過涉滅頂，凶，無咎。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: To place white rushes underneath. No blame.
Nine in the second place: A dry poplar sprouts at the root. An older man takes a young wife. Everything furthers.
Nine in the third place: The ridgepole sags to the breaking point. Misfortune.
Nine in the fourth place: The ridgepole is braced. Good fortune. If there are ulterior motives, it is humiliating.
Nine in the fifth place: A withered poplar puts forth flowers. An older woman takes a husband. No blame. No praise.
Six at the top: One must go through the water. It goes over one's head. Misfortune. No blame.
28.judgment_es: La viga del techo se comba hasta el punto de ruptura. Favorece al hombre tener adónde ir. Éxito.
28.judgment_it: La trave del tetto si incurva fino al punto di rottura. È favorevole all'uomo avere dove andare. Successo.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Poner juncos blancos debajo. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Un álamo seco brota en la raíz. Un hombre mayor toma una esposa joven. Todo favorece.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: La viga del techo se comba hasta el punto de ruptura. Desgracia.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: La viga del techo está apuntalada. Buena fortuna. Si hay motivos ocultos, es humillante.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Un álamo marchito produce flores. Una mujer mayor toma un esposo. Sin culpa. Sin alabanza.
Seis en lo alto: Debe pasar por el agua. Le va por encima de la cabeza. Desgracia. Sin culpa.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Mettere giunchi bianchi sotto. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al secondo posto: Un pioppo secco germoglia alla radice. Un uomo anziano prende una moglie giovane. Tutto favorisce.
Nove al terzo posto: La trave del tetto si incurva fino al punto di rottura. Sventura.
Nove al quarto posto: La trave del tetto è puntellata. Buona fortuna. Se ci sono motivi nascosti, è umiliante.
Nove al quinto posto: Un pioppo appassito produce fiori. Una donna anziana prende un marito. Nessuna colpa. Nessuna lode.
Sei in cima: Deve passare per l'acqua. Gli va sopra la testa. Sventura. Nessuna colpa.

29.judgment_zh: 習坎，有孚，維心亨，行有尚。
29.judgment_en: The Abysmal repeated. If you are sincere, you have success in your heart, and whatever you do succeeds.
29.commentary_desc: Khan, here repeated, shows the possession of sincerity, through which the mind is penetrating. Action (in accordance with this) will be of high value.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject in the double defile, and (yet) entering a cavern within it. There will be evil.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject in all the peril of the defile. He will, however, get a little (of the deliverance) that he seeks.

The third six, divided, shows its subject, whether he comes or goes (=descends or ascends), confronted by a defile. All is peril to him and unrest. (His endeavors) will lead him into the cavern of the pit. There should be no action (in such a case).

The fourth six, divided, shows its subject (at a feast), with (simply) a bottle of spirits, and a subsidiary basket of rice, while (the cups and bowls) are (only) of earthenware. He introduces his important lessons (as his ruler's) intelligence admits. There will in the end be no error.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows the water of the defile not yet full, (so that it might flow away); but order will (soon) be brought about. There will be no error.

The topmost six, divided, shows its subject bound with cords of three strands or two strands, and placed in the thicket of thorns. But in three years he does not learn the course for him to pursue. There will be evil.

image.image_zh: 水洊至，習坎。君子以常德行，習教事。
image.image_en: Water flows on uninterruptedly: The image of the Abysmal repeated. Thus the superior man walks in lasting virtue and carries on the business of teaching.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El agua fluye hacia abajo incesantemente: La imagen de lo Abismal. Así el hombre superior mantiene constante su virtud, y practica la enseñanza con diligencia.
image.image_it: L'acqua scorre verso il basso incessantemente: L'immagine dell'Abissale. Così l'uomo superiore mantiene costante la sua virtù, e pratica l'insegnamento con diligenza.

lines_zh: 初六：習坎，入于坎窞，凶。
九二：坎有險，求小得。
六三：來之坎坎，險且枕，入于坎窞，勿用。
六四：樽酒簋貳，用缶，納約自牖，終無咎。
九五：坎不盈，祗既平，無咎。
上六：係用徽纆，寘于叢棘，三歲不得，凶。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Repetition of the Abysmal. In the abyss one falls into a pit. Misfortune.
Nine in the second place: The abyss is dangerous. One should strive to attain small things only.
Six in the third place: Forward and backward, abyss on abyss. In danger like this, pause at first and wait, otherwise you will fall into a pit in the abyss. Do not act this way.
Six in the fourth place: A jug of wine, a bowl of rice with it; earthen vessels simply handed in through the window. There is certainly no blame in this.
Nine in the fifth place: The abyss is not filled to overflowing, it is filled only to the rim. No blame.
Six at the top: Bound with cords and ropes, shut in between thorn-hedged prison walls: for three years one does not find the way. Misfortune.
29.judgment_es: Lo Abismal repetido. Si eres sincero, tienes éxito en tu corazón, y todo lo que haces tiene éxito.
29.judgment_it: L'Abissale ripetuto. Se sei sincero, hai successo nel tuo cuore, e tutto ciò che fai ha successo.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Repetición de lo Abismal. En el abismo uno cae en un hoyo. Desgracia.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: El abismo es peligroso. Uno debe esforzarse por lograr solo cosas pequeñas.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Hacia adelante y hacia atrás, abismo sobre abismo. En peligro como este, pausa primero y espera, de lo contrario caerás en un hoyo en el abismo. No actúes de esta manera.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Una jarra de vino, un cuenco de arroz con ella; vasijas de tierra simplemente pasadas por la ventana. Ciertamente no hay culpa en esto.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: El abismo no se llena hasta desbordarse, se llena solo hasta el borde. Sin culpa.
Seis en lo alto: Atado con cuerdas y sogas, encerrado entre muros de prisión de setos espinosos: por tres años uno no encuentra el camino. Desgracia.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Ripetizione dell'Abissale. Nell'abisso uno cade in un pozzo. Sventura.
Nove al secondo posto: L'abisso è pericoloso. Uno deve sforzarsi di ottenere solo cose piccole.
Sei al terzo posto: Avanti e indietro, abisso su abisso. In pericolo come questo, pausa prima e aspetta, altrimenti cadrai in un pozzo nell'abisso. Non agire in questo modo.
Sei al quarto posto: Un brocca di vino, una ciotola di riso con essa; vasellame di terra semplicemente passato attraverso la finestra. Certamente non c'è colpa in questo.
Nove al quinto posto: L'abisso non si riempie fino a traboccare, si riempie solo fino all'orlo. Nessuna colpa.
Sei in cima: Legato con corde e funi, rinchiuso tra muri di prigione di siepi spinose: per tre anni uno non trova la via. Sventura.

30.judgment_en: Perseverance furthers. It brings success. Care of the cow brings good fortune.
30.commentary_desc: Li indicates that, (in regard to what it denotes), it will be advantageous to be firm and correct, and that thus there will be free course and success. Let (its subject) also nourish (a docility like that of) the cow, and there will be good fortune.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows one ready to move with confused steps. But he treads at the same time reverently, and there will be no mistake.
The second six, divided, shows its subject in his place in yellow. There will be great good fortune.

The third nine, undivided, shows its subject in a position like that of the declining sun. Instead of playing on his instrument of earthenware, and singing to it, he utters the groans of an old man of eighty. There will be evil.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows the manner of its subject's coming. How abrupt it is, as with fire, with death, to be rejected (by all)!
The fifth six, divided, shows its subject as one with tears flowing in torrents, and groaning in sorrow. There will be good fortune.

The topmost nine, undivided, shows the king employing its subject in his punitive expeditions. Achieving admirable (merit), he breaks (only) the chiefs (of the rebels). Where his prisoners were not their associates, he does not punish. There will be no error.

image.image_zh: 明兩作，離。大人以繼明照于四方。
image.image_en: That which is bright rises twice: The image of Fire. Thus the great man, by perpetuating this brightness, illumines the four quarters of the world.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: La luminosidad aparece doble: La imagen de lo Adherente. Así el gran hombre fomenta la claridad de la cultura y la luz.
image.image_it: La luminosità appare doppia: L'immagine dell'Aderente. Così il grande uomo promuove la chiarezza della cultura e la luce.

lines_zh: 初九：履錯然，敬之無咎。
六二：黃離，元吉。
九三：日昃之離，不鼓缶而歌，則大耋之嗟，凶。
九四：突如其來如，焚如，死如，棄如。
六五：出涕沱若，戚嗟若，吉。
上九：王用出征，有嘉折首，獲匪其醜，無咎。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: The footprints run crisscross. If one is seriously intent, no blame.
Six in the second place: Yellow light. Supreme good fortune.
Nine in the third place: In the light of the setting sun, men either beat the pot and sing or loudly bewail the approach of old age. Misfortune.
Nine in the fourth place: Its coming is sudden; it flames up, dies down, is thrown away.
Six in the fifth place: Tears in floods, sighing and lamenting. Good fortune.
Nine at the top: The king uses him to march forth and chastise. Then it is best to kill the leaders and take captive the followers. No blame.
30.judgment_es: La perseverancia favorece. Trae éxito. El cuidado de la vaca trae buena fortuna.
30.judgment_it: La perseveranza favorisce. Porta successo. La cura della mucca porta buona fortuna.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Las huellas corren cruzadas. Si uno está seriamente intencionado, sin culpa.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Luz amarilla. Suprema buena fortuna.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: A la luz del sol poniente, los hombres o golpean la olla y cantan o lloran en voz alta la llegada de la vejez. Desgracia.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Su llegada es repentina; llamea, se apaga, es desechada.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Lágrimas en inundaciones, suspiros y lamentos. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: El rey lo usa para marchar y castigar. Entonces es mejor matar a los líderes y tomar cautivos a los seguidores. Sin culpa.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Le impronte corrono incrociate. Se uno è seriamente intenzionato, nessuna colpa.
Sei al secondo posto: Luce gialla. Suprema buona fortuna.
Nove al terzo posto: Alla luce del sole al tramonto, gli uomini o battono la pentola e cantano o piangono ad alta voce l'arrivo della vecchiaia. Sventura.
Nove al quarto posto: Il suo arrivo è repentino; fiammeggia, si spegne, è gettata via.
Sei al quinto posto: Lacrime in inondazioni, sospiri e lamenti. Buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: Il re lo usa per marciare e castigare. Allora è meglio uccidere i leader e prendere prigionieri i seguaci. Nessuna colpa.

31.judgment_en: Success. Perseverance furthers. To take a maiden to wife brings good fortune.
31.commentary_desc: Yî indicates that (in the state which it denotes) there will be advantage in every movement which shall be undertaken, that it will be advantageous (even) to cross the great stream.
commentary_reading: The first [bottom line] nine, undivided, shows that it will be advantageous for its subject in his position to make a great movement. If it be greatly fortunate, no blame will be imputed to him.

The second six, divided, shows parties adding to the stores of its subject ten pairs of tortoise shells whose oracles cannot be opposed. Let him persevere in being firm and correct, and there will be good fortune. Let the king, (having the virtues thus distinguished), employ them in presenting his offerings to God, and there will be good fortune.

The third six, divided, shows increase given to its subject by means of what is evil, so that he shall (be led to good), and be without blame. Let him be sincere and pursue the path of the Mean, (so shall he secure the recognition of the ruler, like) an officer who announces himself to his prince by the symbol of his rank.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject pursuing the due course. His advice to his prince is followed. He can with advantage be relied on in such a movement as that of removing the capital.

The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject with sincere heart seeking to benefit (all below). There need be no question about it; the result will be great good fortune. (All below) will with sincere heart acknowledge his goodness.
In the sixth nine, undivided, we see one to whose increase none will contribute, while many will seek to assail him. He observes no regular rule in the ordering of his heart. There will be evil.

image.image_zh: 山上有澤，咸。君子以虛受人。
image.image_en: A lake on the mountain: The image of Influence. Thus the superior man encourages people to approach him by his readiness to receive them.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Sobre la montaña, el lago: La imagen de la Influencia. Así el hombre superior abre su corazón para escuchar las palabras de los demás.
image.image_it: Sulla montagna, il lago: L'immagine dell'Influenza. Così l'uomo superiore apre il suo cuore per ascoltare le parole degli altri.

lines_zh: 初六：咸其拇。
六二：咸其腓，凶，居吉。
九三：咸其股，執其隨，往吝。
九四：貞吉，悔亡，憧憧往來，朋從爾思。
九五：咸其脢，無悔。
上六：咸其輔頰舌。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: The influence shows itself in the big toe.
Six in the second place: The influence shows itself in the calves of the legs. Misfortune. Tarrying brings good fortune.
Nine in the third place: The influence shows itself in the thighs. Holds to that which follows it. To continue is humiliating.

Nine in the fourth place: Perseverance brings good fortune. Remorse disappears. If a man's mind is hesitant, going and coming, only those friends to whom he directs his conscious thoughts will follow.
Nine in the fifth place: The influence shows itself in the back of the neck. No remorse.
Six at the top: The influence shows itself in the jaws, cheeks, and tongue.
31.judgment_es: Éxito. La perseverancia favorece. Tomar a una doncella como esposa trae buena fortuna.
31.judgment_it: Successo. La perseveranza favorisce. Prendere una fanciulla come moglie porta buona fortuna.
lines_es: Seis al principio: La influencia se muestra en el dedo gordo del pie.
Seis en el segundo lugar: La influencia se muestra en las pantorrillas. Desgracia. La demora trae buena fortuna.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: La influencia se muestra en los muslos. Se aferra a lo que le sigue. Continuar es humillante.

Nueve en el cuarto lugar: La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. El remordimiento desaparece. Si la mente de un hombre es vacilante, yendo y viniendo, solo aquellos amigos a quienes dirige sus pensamientos conscientes lo seguirán.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: La influencia se muestra en la nuca. Sin remordimiento.
Seis en lo alto: La influencia se muestra en las mandíbulas, mejillas y lengua.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: L'influenza si mostra nel dito grosso del piede.
Sei al secondo posto: L'influenza si mostra nei polpacci. Sventura. L'indugio porta buona fortuna.
Nove al terzo posto: L'influenza si mostra nelle cosce. Si aggrappa a ciò che la segue. Continuare è umiliante.

Nove al quarto posto: La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Il rimorso svanisce. Se la mente di un uomo è esitante, andando e venendo, solo quegli amici a cui dirige i suoi pensieri coscienti lo seguiranno.
Nove al quinto posto: L'influenza si mostra nella nuca. Nessun rimorso.
Sei in cima: L'influenza si mostra nelle mascelle, guance e lingua.

32.judgment_en: Success. No blame. Perseverance furthers. It furthers one to have somewhere to go.
32.commentary_desc: In (what is denoted by) Sun, if there be sincerity (in him who employs it), there will be great good fortune: - freedom from error; firmness and correctness that can be maintained; and advantage in every movement that shall be made. In what shall this (sincerity in the exercise of Sun) be employed? (Even) in sacrifice two baskets of grain, (though there be nothing else), may be presented.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject suspending his own affairs, and hurrying, away (to help the subject of the fourth line). He will commit no error, but let him consider how far he should contribute of what is his (for the other).

The second nine, undivided, shows that it will be advantageous for its subject to maintain a firm correctness, and that action on his part will be evil. He can give increase (to his correlate) without taking from himself
The third six, divided, shows how of three men walking together, the number is diminished by one; and how one, walking, finds his friend.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject diminishing the ailment under which he labors by making (the subject of the first line) hasten (to his help), and make him glad. There will be no error.
The fifth six, divided, shows parties adding to (the stores of) its subject ten pairs of tortoise shells, and accepting no refusal. There will be great good fortune.

The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject giving increase to others without taking from himself. There will be no error. With firm correctness there will be good fortune. There will be advantage in every movement that shall be made. He will find ministers more than can be counted by their clans.

image.image_zh: 雷風恆。君子以立不易方。
image.image_en: Thunder and wind: The image of Duration. Thus the superior man stands firm and does not change his direction.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El trueno y el viento: La imagen de la Duración. Así el hombre superior permanece y no cambia su camino.
image.image_it: Il tuono e il vento: L'immagine della Durata. Così l'uomo superiore permane e non cambia il suo cammino.

lines_zh: 初六：浚恆，貞凶，無攸利。
九二：悔亡。
九三：不恆其德，或承之羞，貞吝。
九四：田無禽。
六五：恆其德，貞，婦人吉，夫子凶。
上六：振恆，凶。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Seeking duration too hastily brings misfortune persistently. Nothing that would further.
Nine in the second place: Remorse disappears.
Nine in the third place: He who does not give duration to his character meets with disgrace. Persistent humiliation.
Nine in the fourth place: No game in the field.
Six in the fifth place: Giving duration to one's character through perseverance. This is good fortune for a woman, misfortune for a man.
Six at the top: Restlessness as an enduring condition brings misfortune.
32.judgment_es: Éxito. Sin culpa. La perseverancia favorece. Favorece al hombre tener adónde ir.
32.judgment_it: Successo. Nessuna colpa. La perseveranza favorisce. È favorevole all'uomo avere dove andare.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Buscar duración demasiado apresuradamente trae desgracia persistentemente. Nada que favoreciera.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: El remordimiento desaparece.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Quien no da duración a su carácter encuentra desgracia. Humillación persistente.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: No hay presa en el campo.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Dando duración al carácter a través de la perseverancia. Esto es buena fortuna para una mujer, desgracia para un hombre.
Seis en lo alto: La inquietud como condición duradera trae desgracia.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Cercare durata troppo frettolosamente porta sventura persistentemente. Nulla che favorisca.
Nove al secondo posto: Il rimorso svanisce.
Nove al terzo posto: Chi non dà durata al suo carattere incontra disgrazia. Umiliazione persistente.
Nove al quarto posto: Non c'è preda nel campo.
Sei al quinto posto: Dare durata al carattere attraverso la perseveranza. Questo è buona fortuna per una donna, sventura per un uomo.
Sei in cima: L'inquietudine come condizione durevole porta sventura.

33.judgment_en: Success. In what is small, perseverance furthers.
33.commentary_desc: Wu Wang indicates great progress and success, while there will be advantage in being firm and correct. If (its subject and his action) be not correct, he will fall into errors, and it will not be advantageous for him to move in any direction.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject free from all insincerity. His advance will be accompanied with good fortune.

The second six, divided, shows one who reaps without having ploughed (that he might reap), and gathers the produce of his third year's fields without having cultivated them the first year for that end. To such a one there will be advantage in whatever direction he may move.

The third six, divided, shows calamity happening to one who is free from insincerity;-as in the case of an ox that has been tied up. A passer by finds it (and carries it off), while the people in the neighborhood have the calamity (of being accused and apprehended).
The fourth nine, undivided, shows (a case) in which, if its subject can remain firm and correct, there will be no error.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows one who is free from insincerity, and yet has fallen ill. Let him not use medicine, and he will have occasion for joy (in his recovery).
The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject free from insincerity, yet sure to fall into error, if he take action. (His action) will not be advantageous in any way.

image.image_zh: 天下有山，遯。君子以遠小人，不惡而嚴。
image.image_en: Mountain under heaven: The image of Retreat. Thus the superior man keeps the inferior man at a distance, not angrily but with reserve.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El cielo sobre la montaña: La imagen del Retiro. Así el hombre superior mantiene lejos al hombre inferior, pero no con odio, sino con dignidad.
image.image_it: Il cielo sopra la montagna: L'immagine del Ritiro. Così l'uomo superiore tiene lontano l'uomo inferiore, ma non con odio, bensì con dignità.

lines_zh: 初六：遯尾，厲，勿用有攸往。
六二：執之用黃牛之革，莫之勝說。
九三：係遯，有疾厲，畜臣妾，吉。
九四：好遯，君子吉，小人否。
九五：嘉遯，貞吉。
上九：肥遯，無不利。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: At the tail in retreat. This is dangerous. One must not wish to undertake anything.
Six in the second place: He holds him fast with yellow oxhide. No one can tear him loose.
Nine in the third place: A halted retreat is nerve-wracking and dangerous. To retain people as men- and maidservants brings good fortune.
Nine in the fourth place: Voluntary retreat brings good fortune to the superior man and downfall to the inferior man.
Nine in the fifth place: Friendly retreat. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Nine at the top: Cheerful retreat. Everything serves to further.
33.judgment_es: Éxito. En lo que es pequeño, la perseverancia favorece.
33.judgment_it: Successo. In ciò che è piccolo, la perseveranza favorisce.
lines_es: Seis al principio: En la cola en retirada. Esto es peligroso. No debe desear emprender nada.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Él lo sujeta fuerte con piel de buey amarilla. Nadie puede arrancarlo.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Una retirada detenida es desgastante y peligrosa. Retener personas como sirvientes trae buena fortuna.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: La retirada voluntaria trae buena fortuna al hombre superior y caída al hombre inferior.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Retirada amigable. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: Retirada alegre. Todo sirve para favorecer.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Nella coda in ritirata. Questo è pericoloso. Non deve desiderare intraprendere nulla.
Sei al secondo posto: Egli lo tiene stretto con pelle di bue gialla. Nessuno può strapparlo.
Nove al terzo posto: Una ritirata fermata è snervante e pericolosa. Trattenere persone come servitori porta buona fortuna.
Nove al quarto posto: La ritirata volontaria porta buona fortuna all'uomo nobile e rovina all'uomo inferiore.
Nove al quinto posto: Ritirata amichevole. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: Ritirata allegra. Tutto serve a favorire.

34.commentary_desc: Under the conditions of Ta Khu it will be advantageous to be firm and correct. (If its subject do not seek to) enjoy his revenues in his own family (without taking service at court), there will be good fortune. It will be advantageous for him to cross the great stream.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject in a position of peril. It will be advantageous for him to stop his advance.
The second nine, undivided, shows a carriage with the strap under it removed.

The third nine, undivided, shows its subject urging his way with good horses. It will be advantageous for him to realize the difficulty (of his course), and to be firm and correct, exercising himself daily in his charioteering and methods of defense; then there will be advantage in whatever direction he may advance.
The fourth six, divided, shows the young bull, (and yet) having the piece of wood over his horns. There will be great good fortune.
The fifth six, divided, shows the teeth of a castrated hog. There will be good fortune.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows its subject (as) in command of the firmament of heaven. There will be progress.

image.image_zh: 雷在天上，大壯。君子以非禮弗履。
image.image_en: Thunder in heaven above: The image of the Power of the Great. Thus the superior man does not tread upon paths that do not accord with established order.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El trueno en el cielo: La imagen del Poder de lo Grande. Así el hombre superior no sigue un curso que no conduce a ninguna parte.
image.image_it: Il tuono nel cielo: L'immagine del Potere del Grande. Così l'uomo superiore non segue un corso che non conduce da nessuna parte.

lines_zh: 初九：壯于趾，征凶，有孚。
九二：貞吉。
九三：小人用壯，君子用罔，貞厲。羝羊觸藩，羸其角。
九四：貞吉，悔亡，藩決不羸，壯于大輿之輹。
六五：喪羊于易，無悔。
上六：羝羊觸藩，不能退，不能遂，無攸利，艱則吉。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Power in the toes. Continuing brings misfortune. This is certainly true.
Nine in the second place: Perseverance brings good fortune.
Nine in the third place: The inferior man works through power. The superior man does not act thus. To continue is dangerous. A goat butts against a hedge and gets its horns entangled.
Nine in the fourth place: Perseverance brings good fortune. Remorse disappears. The hedge opens; there is no entanglement. Power depends upon the axle of a big cart.
Six in the fifth place: Loses the goat with ease. No remorse.
Six at the top: A goat butts against a hedge. It cannot go backward, it cannot go forward. Nothing serves to further. If one notes the difficulty, this brings good fortune.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Poder en los dedos de los pies. Continuar trae desgracia. Esto es ciertamente cierto.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: El hombre inferior trabaja a través del poder. El hombre superior no actúa así. Continuar es peligroso. Una cabra embiste contra un seto y se enreda los cuernos.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. El remordimiento desaparece. El seto se abre; no hay enredo. El poder depende del eje de un carro grande.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Pierde la cabra con facilidad. Sin remordimiento.
Seis en lo alto: Una cabra embiste contra un seto. No puede ir hacia atrás, no puede ir hacia adelante. Nada sirve para favorecer. Si uno nota la dificultad, esto trae buena fortuna.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Potere nelle dita dei piedi. Continuare porta sventura. Questo è certamente vero.
Nove al secondo posto: La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.
Nove al terzo posto: L'uomo inferiore lavora attraverso il potere. L'uomo nobile non agisce così. Continuare è pericoloso. Una capra cozza contro una siepe e si impiglia le corna.
Nove al quarto posto: La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Il rimorso svanisce. La siepe si apre; non c'è impiccio. Il potere dipende dall'asse di un grande carro.
Sei al quinto posto: Perde la capra con facilità. Nessun rimorso.
Sei in cima: Una capra cozza contro una siepe. Non può andare indietro, non può andare avanti. Nulla serve a favorire. Se uno nota la difficoltà, questo porta buona fortuna.

35.judgment_zh: 康侯用錫馬蕃庶，晝日三接。
35.judgment_en: The powerful prince is honored with horses in large numbers. In a single day he is granted audience three times.
35.commentary_desc: Chin we see a prince who secures the tranquillity (of the people) presented on that account with numerous horses (by the king), and three times in a day received at interviews.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows one wishing to advance, and (at the same time) kept back. Let him be firm and correct, and there will be good fortune. If trust be not reposed in him, let him maintain a large and generous mind, and there will be no error.

The second six, divided, show. its subject with the appearance of advancing, and yet of being sorrowful. If he be firm and correct, there will be good fortune. He will receive this great blessing from his grandmother.
The third six, divided, shows its subject trusted by all (around him). All occasion for repentance will disappear.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject with the appearance of advancing, but like a marmot. However firm and correct he may be, the position is one of peril.

The fifth six, divided, shows how all occasion for repentance disappears (from its subject). (But) let him not concern himself about whether he shall fail or succeed. To advance will be fortunate, and in every way advantageous.

The topmost nine undivided, shows one advancing his horns. But he only uses them to punish the (rebellious people of his own) city. The position is perilous, but there will be good fortune. (Yet) however firm and correct he may be, there will be occasion for regret.

image.image_zh: 明出地上，晉。君子以自昭明德。
image.image_en: The sun rises over the earth: The image of Progress. Thus the superior man himself brightens his bright virtue.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El sol sale sobre la tierra: La imagen del Progreso. Así el hombre superior hace brillante su virtud propia.
image.image_it: Il sole sorge sulla terra: L'immagine del Progresso. Così l'uomo superiore rende luminosa la sua virtù propria.

lines_zh: 初六：晉如摧如，貞吉。罔孚，裕無咎。
六二：晉如愁如，貞吉。受茲介福，于其王母。
六三：眾允，悔亡。
九四：晉如鼫鼠，貞厲。
六五：悔亡，失得勿恤，往吉，無不利。
上九：晉其角，維用伐邑，厲吉，無咎，貞吝。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Progressing, but turned back. Perseverance brings good fortune. If one meets with no confidence, one should remain calm. No blame.
Six in the second place: Progressing, but in sorrow. Perseverance brings good fortune. Then one obtains great happiness from one's ancestress.
Six in the third place: All are in accord. Remorse disappears.
Nine in the fourth place: Progress like a hamster. Perseverance brings danger.
Six in the fifth place: Remorse disappears. Take not gain and loss to heart. Undertakings bring good fortune. Everything serves to further.

Nine at the top: Making progress with the horns is permissible only for the purpose of punishing one's own city. To be conscious of danger brings good fortune. No blame. Perseverance brings humiliation.
35.judgment_es: El príncipe poderoso es honrado con caballos en gran número. En un solo día se le concede audiencia tres veces.
35.judgment_it: Il principe potente è onorato con cavalli in gran numero. In un solo giorno gli è concessa udienza tre volte.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Progresando, pero devuelto. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. Si uno encuentra sin confianza, debe permanecer calmado. Sin culpa.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Progresando, pero en pesar. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. Entonces uno obtiene gran felicidad de su abuela.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Todos están de acuerdo. El remordimiento desaparece.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Progreso como un hámster. La perseverancia trae peligro.
Seis en el quinto lugar: El remordimiento desaparece. No tomes ganancia y pérdida a corazón. Las empresas traen buena fortuna. Todo sirve para favorecer.

Nueve en lo alto: Hacer progreso con los cuernos es permisible solo con el propósito de castigar a la propia ciudad. Ser consciente del peligro trae buena fortuna. Sin culpa. La perseverancia trae humillación.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Progredendo, ma rispedito indietro. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Se uno incontra senza fiducia, deve rimanere calmo. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al secondo posto: Progredendo, ma nel dolore. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Allora uno ottiene gran felicità dalla nonna.
Sei al terzo posto: Tutti sono d'accordo. Il rimorso svanisce.
Nove al quarto posto: Progresso come un criceto. La perseveranza porta pericolo.
Sei al quinto posto: Il rimorso svanisce. Non prendere guadagno e perdita a cuore. Le imprese portano buona fortuna. Tutto serve a favorire.
Nove in cima: Fare progresso con le corna è permesso solo allo scopo di punire la propria città. Essere consapevoli del pericolo porta buona fortuna. Nessuna colpa. La perseveranza porta umiliazione.

36.judgment_en: In adversity it furthers one to be persevering.
36.commentary_desc: Ming I indicates that (in the circumstances which it denotes) it will be advantageous to realize the difficulty (of the position), and maintain firm correctness.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject, (in the condition indicated by) Ming I, flying, but with drooping wings. When the superior man (is revolving) his going away, he may be for three days without eating. Wherever he goes, the people there may speak (derisively of him).
The second six, divided, shows its subject, (in the condition indicated by) Ming I, wounded in the left thigh. He saves himself by the strength of a (swift) horse; and is fortunate.

The third nine, undivided, shows its subject, (in the condition indicated by) Ming I, hunting in the south, and taking the great chief (of the darkness). He should not be eager to make (all) correct (at once).

The fourth six, divided, shows its subject (just) entered into the left side of the belly (of the dark land). (But) he is able to carry out the mind appropriate (in the condition indicated by) Ming I, quitting the gate and courtyard (of the lord of darkness).
The fifth six, divided, shows how the count of Ki fulfilled the condition indicated by Ming I. It will be advantageous to be firm and correct.
The sixth six, divided, shows the case where there is no light, but (only) obscurity. (Its subject) had at first ascended to (the top of) the sky; his future shall be to go into the earth.

image.image_zh: 明入地中，明夷。君子以蒞眾用晦而明。
image.image_en: The light has sunk into the earth: The image of Darkening of the Light. Thus does the superior man live with the great mass: He veils his light, yet still shines.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: La luz se hunde en la tierra: La imagen del Oscurecimiento de la Luz. Así el hombre superior en momentos de adversidad administra sus asuntos.
image.image_it: La luce si sprofonda nella terra: L'immagine dell'Offuscamento della Luce. Così l'uomo superiore in momenti di avversità amministra i suoi affari.

lines_zh: 初九：明夷于飛，垂其翼。君子于行，三日不食。有攸往，主人有言。
六二：明夷，夷于左股，用拯馬壯，吉。
九三：明夷于南狩，得其大首，不可疾貞。
六四：入于左腹，獲明夷之心，于出門庭。
六五：箕子之明夷，利貞。
上六：不明晦，初登于天，後入于地。
