lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Darkening of the light during flight. He lowers his wings. The superior man does not eat for three days on his wanderings. But he has somewhere to go. The host has occasion to gossip about him.
Six in the second place: Darkening of the light injures him in the left thigh. He gives aid with the strength of a horse. Good fortune.
Nine in the third place: Darkening of the light during the hunt in the south. Their great leader is captured. One must not expect perseverance too soon.
Six in the fourth place: He penetrates the left side of the belly. One gets at the very heart of the darkening of the light, and leaves gate and courtyard.
Six in the fifth place: Darkening of the light as with Prince Chi. Perseverance furthers.
Six at the top: Not light but darkness. First he climbed up to heaven, then he plunged into the depths of the earth.
36.judgment_es: En la adversidad favorece al hombre ser perseverante.
36.judgment_it: Nell'avversità è favorevole all'uomo essere perseverante.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Oscurecimiento de la luz durante el vuelo. Él baja sus alas. El hombre superior no come por tres días en sus andanzas. Pero tiene adónde ir. El anfitrión tiene ocasión de chismear sobre él.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Oscurecimiento de la luz le hiere en el muslo izquierdo. Él da ayuda con la fuerza de un caballo. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Oscurecimiento de la luz durante la caza en el sur. Su gran líder es capturado. No debe esperarse perseverancia demasiado pronto.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Él penetra el lado izquierdo del vientre. Uno llega al corazón mismo del oscurecimiento de la luz, y deja la puerta y el patio.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Oscurecimiento de la luz como con el Príncipe Chi. La perseverancia favorece.
Seis en lo alto: No luz sino oscuridad. Primero subió al cielo, luego se sumergió en las profundidades de la tierra.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Offuscamento della luce durante il volo. Egli abbassa le ali. L'uomo nobile non mangia per tre giorni nelle sue peregrinazioni. Ma ha dove andare. L'ospite ha occasione di sparlare di lui.
Sei al secondo posto: Offuscamento della luce lo ferisce nella coscia sinistra. Egli dà aiuto con la forza di un cavallo. Buona fortuna.
Nove al terzo posto: Offuscamento della luce durante la caccia nel sud. Il loro gran leader è catturato. Non deve aspettarsi perseveranza troppo presto.
Sei al quarto posto: Egli penetra il lato sinistro della pancia. Si arriva al cuore stesso dell'offuscamento della luce, e si lasciano porta e cortile.
Sei al quinto posto: Offuscamento della luce come con il Principe Chi. La perseveranza favorisce.
Sei in cima: Non luce ma oscurità. Prima salì in cielo, poi si immerse nelle profondità della terra.

37.judgment_en: The perseverance of the woman furthers.
37.commentary_desc: (What takes place as indicated by) Ko is believed in only after it has been accomplished. There will be great progress and success. Advantage will come from being firm and correct. (In that case) occasion for repentance will disappear.,
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject (as if he were) bound with the skin of a yellow ox.
The second six, divided, shows its subject making his changes after some time has passed. Action taken will be fortunate. There will be no error.

The third nine, undivided, shows that action taken by its subject will be evil. Though he be firm and correct, his position is perilous. If the change (he contemplates) have been three times fully discussed, he will be believed in.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows occasion for repentance disappearing (from its subject). Let him be believed in; and though he change (existing) ordinances, there will be good fortune.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows the great man (producing his changes) as the tiger (does when he) changes (his stripes). Before he divines (and proceeds to action), faith has been reposed in him.

The sixth six, divided, shows the superior man producing his changes as the leopard (does when he) changes (his spots), while small men change their faces (and show their obedience). To go forward (now) would lead to evil, but there will be good fortune in abiding firm and correct.

image.image_zh: 風自火出，家人。君子以言有物而行有恆。
image.image_en: Wind comes forth from fire: The image of the Family. Thus the superior man has substance in his words and duration in his way of life.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El viento brota del fuego: La imagen de la Casa del Hombre. Así el hombre superior tiene sustancia en sus palabras, y en su forma de vida constancia.
image.image_it: Il vento spira dal fuoco: L'immagine della Casa dell'Uomo. Così l'uomo superiore ha sostanza nelle sue parole, e nel suo modo di vita costanza.

lines_zh: 初九：閑有家，悔亡。
六二：無攸遂，在中饋，貞吉。
九三：家人嗃嗃，悔厲吉，婦子嘻嘻，終吝。
六四：富家，大吉。
九五：王假有家，勿恤，往吉。
上九：有孚威如，終吉。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Firm seclusion within the family. Remorse disappears.
Six in the second place: She should not follow her whims. She must attend within to the food. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Nine in the third place: When tempers flare up in the family, too great severity brings remorse. Good fortune nonetheless. When woman and child dally and laugh, it leads in the end to humiliation.
Six in the fourth place: She is the treasure of the house. Great good fortune.
Nine in the fifth place: As a king he approaches his family. Fear not. Good fortune.
Nine at the top: His work commands respect. In the end good fortune comes.
37.judgment_es: La perseverancia de la mujer favorece.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Reclusión firme dentro de la familia. El remordimiento desaparece.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Ella no debe seguir sus caprichos. Debe atender dentro a la comida. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.

Nueve en el tercer lugar: Cuando los temperamentos se encienden en la familia, demasiada severidad trae remordimiento. Buena fortuna de todos modos. Cuando mujer y niño juegan y ríen, lleva al final a humillación.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Ella es el tesoro de la casa. Gran buena fortuna.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Como rey se acerca a su familia. No temas. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: Su trabajo merece respeto. Al final viene la buena fortuna.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Reclusione ferma dentro la famiglia. Il rimorso svanisce.
Sei al secondo posto: Lei non deve seguire i suoi capricci. Deve attendere dentro al cibo. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.

Nove al terzo posto: Quando i temperamenti si accendono nella famiglia, troppa severità porta rimorso. Buona fortuna comunque. Quando donna e bambino scherzano e ridono, porta alla fine all'umiliazione.
Sei al quarto posto: Lei è il tesoro della casa. Gran buona fortuna.
Nove al quinto posto: Come re si avvicina alla sua famiglia. Non temere. Buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: Il suo lavoro merita rispetto. Alla fine viene la buona fortuna.

38.commentary_desc: Ting gives the intimation of great progress and success.,
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows the caldron overthrown and its feet turned up. (But) there will be advantage in its getting rid of what was bad in it. (Or it shows us) the concubine (whose position is improved) by means of her son. There will be no error.
The second nine, undivided, shows the caldron with the things (to be cooked) in it. (If its subject can say), 'My enemy dislikes me, but he cannot approach me,' there will be good fortune.

The third nine, undivided, shows the caldron with (the places of) its ears changed. The progress (of its subject) is (thus) stopped. The fat flesh of the pheasant (which is in the caldron) will not be eaten. But the (genial) rain will come, and the grounds for repentance will disappear. There will be good fortune in the end.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows the caldron with its feet broken; and its contents, designed for the ruler's use, overturned and spilt. Its subject will be made to blush for shame. There will be evil.
The fifth six, divided, shows the caldron with yellow ears and rings of metal in them. There will be advantage through being firm and correct.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows the caldron with rings of jade. There will be great good fortune, and all action taken will be in every way advantageous.

image.image_zh: 上火下澤，睽。君子以同而異。
image.image_en: Above, fire; below, the lake: The image of Opposition. Thus amid all fellowship the superior man retains his individuality.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El fuego sobre el lago: La imagen de la Diversidad. Así el hombre superior busca la unidad en las diferencias.
image.image_it: Il fuoco sul lago: L'immagine della Diversità. Così l'uomo superiore cerca l'unità nelle differenze.

lines_zh: 初九：悔亡，喪馬勿逐，自復，見惡人，無咎。
九二：遇主于巷，無咎。
六三：見輿曳，其牛掣，其人天且劓，無初有終。
九四：睽孤，遇元夫，交孚，厲無咎。
六五：悔亡，厥宗噬膚，往何咎。
上九：睽孤，見豕負塗，載鬼一車，先張之弧，後說之弧，匪寇婚媾，往遇雨則吉。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Remorse disappears. If you lose your horse, do not run after it; it will come back of its own accord. When you see evil people, guard yourself against mistakes.
Nine in the second place: One meets his lord in a narrow street. No blame.
Six in the third place: One sees the wagon dragged back, the oxen halted, a man's hair and nose cut off. Not a good beginning, but a good end.
Nine in the fourth place: Isolated through opposition. One meets a like-minded man with whom one can associate in good faith. Despite the danger, no blame.
Six in the fifth place: Remorse disappears. The companion bites his way through the wrappings. If one goes to him, how could it be a mistake?

Nine at the top: Isolated through opposition. One sees one's companion as a pig covered with dirt, as a wagon full of devils. First one draws a bow against him, then one lays the bow aside. He is not a robber; he will woo at the right time. As one goes, rain falls; then good fortune comes.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: El remordimiento desaparece. Si pierdes tu caballo, no corras tras él; volverá por sí mismo. Cuando veas personas malvadas, guárdate de cometer errores.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Uno encuentra a su señor en una calle estrecha. Sin culpa.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Uno ve el carro arrastrado hacia atrás, los bueyes detenidos, el pelo y la nariz de un hombre cortados. No es un buen comienzo, pero un buen fin.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Aislado a través de la oposición. Uno encuentra a un hombre de igual mente con quien puede asociarse de buena fe. A pesar del peligro, sin culpa.
Seis en el quinto lugar: El remordimiento desaparece. El compañero muerde su camino a través de los envoltorios. Si uno va a él, ¿cómo podría ser un error?

Nueve en lo alto: Aislado a través de la oposición. Uno ve a su compañero como un cerdo cubierto de suciedad, como un carro lleno de demonios. Primero arma un arco contra él, luego deja el arco a un lado. No es un ladrón; cortejará en el momento adecuado. Al ir, cae la lluvia; entonces viene la buena fortuna.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Il rimorso svanisce. Se perdi il tuo cavallo, non corrergli dietro; tornerà da sé. Quando vedi persone malvagie, guardati dal commettere errori.
Nove al secondo posto: Si incontra il proprio signore in una strada stretta. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al terzo posto: Si vede il carro trascinato indietro, i buoi fermi, i capelli e il naso di un uomo tagliati. Non è un buon inizio, ma una buona fine.
Nove al quarto posto: Isolato attraverso l'opposizione. Si incontra un uomo della stessa mente con cui si può associarsi in buona fede. Nonostante il pericolo, nessuna colpa.
Sei al quinto posto: Il rimorso svanisce. Il compagno morde il suo cammino attraverso gli involucri. Se uno va da lui, come potrebbe essere un errore?

Nove in cima: Isolato attraverso l'opposizione. Si vede il proprio compagno come un maiale coperto di sporcizia, come un carro pieno di demoni. Prima arma un arco contro di lui, poi posa l'arco da parte. Non è un ladro; corteggerà al momento opportuno. Nell'andare, cade la pioggia; allora viene la buona fortuna.

39.judgment_zh: 利西南，不利東北；利見大人，貞吉。
39.judgment_en: The southwest furthers. The northeast does not further. It furthers one to see the great man. Perseverance brings good fortune.
39.commentary_desc: Kun (indicates that in the case which it presupposes) there will be great progress and success, and the advantage will come from being correct and firm. (But) any movement in advance should not be (lightly) undertaken. There will be advantage in appointing feudal princes.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows the difficulty (its subject has) in advancing. It will be advantageous for him to abide correct and firm; advantageous (also) to be made a feudal ruler.

The second six, divided, shows (its subject) distressed and obliged to return; (even) the horses of her chariot (also) seem to be retreating. (But) not by a spoiler (is she assailed), but by one who seeks her to be his wife. The young lady maintains her firm correctness, and declines a union. After ten years she will be united, and have children.

The third six, divided, shows one following the deer without (the guidance of) the forester, and only finding himself in the midst of the forest. The superior man, acquainted with the secret risks, thinks it better to give up the chase. If he went forward, he would regret it.

The fourth six, divided, shows (its subject as a lady), the horses of whose chariot appear in retreat. She seeks, however, (the help of) him who seeks her to be his wife. Advance will be fortunate; all will turn out advantageously.

The fifth nine, undivided, shows the difficulties in the way of (its subject's) dispensing the rich favors that might be expected from him. With firmness and correctness there will be good fortune in small things; (even) with them in great things there will be evil.
The topmost six, divided, shows (its subject) with the horses of his chariot obliged to retreat, and weeping tears of blood in streams.

image.image_zh: 山上有水，蹇。君子以反身修德。
image.image_en: Water on the mountain: The image of Obstruction. Thus the superior man turns his attention to himself and molds his character.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El agua sobre la montaña: La imagen de las Dificultades. Así el hombre superior se vuelve a sí mismo para cultivar su virtud.
image.image_it: L'acqua sulla montagna: L'immagine delle Difficoltà. Così l'uomo superiore si volge a sé stesso per coltivare la sua virtù.

lines_zh: 初六：往蹇來譽。
六二：王臣蹇蹇，匪躬之故。
九三：往蹇來反。
六四：往蹇來連。
九五：大蹇朋來。
上六：往蹇來碩，吉，利見大人。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Going leads to obstructions, coming meets with praise.
Six in the second place: The king's servant is beset by obstruction upon obstruction, but it is not his own fault.
Nine in the third place: Going leads to obstructions; hence he returns.
Six in the fourth place: Going leads to obstructions, coming leads to union.
Nine in the fifth place: In the midst of the greatest obstructions, friends come.
Six at the top: Going leads to obstructions, coming leads to great good fortune. It furthers one to see the great man.
39.judgment_es: El suroeste favorece. El noreste no favorece. Favorece al hombre ver al gran hombre. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.
39.judgment_it: Il sud-ovest favorisce. Il nord-est non favorisce. È favorevole all'uomo vedere il grande uomo. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Ir conduce a obstrucciones, venir encuentra alabanza.
Seis en el segundo lugar: El sirviente del rey es asediado por obstrucción sobre obstrucción, pero no es culpa suya.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Ir conduce a obstrucciones; por tanto regresa.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Ir conduce a obstrucciones, venir conduce a unión.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: En medio de las mayores obstrucciones, vienen amigos.
Seis en lo alto: Ir conduce a obstrucciones, venir conduce a gran buena fortuna. Favorece al hombre ver al gran hombre.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Andare conduce a ostruzioni, venire incontra lode.
Sei al secondo posto: Il servo del re è assediato da ostruzione su ostruzione, ma non è colpa sua.
Nove al terzo posto: Andare conduce a ostruzioni; quindi ritorna.
Sei al quarto posto: Andare conduce a ostruzioni, venire conduce a unione.
Nove al quinto posto: In mezzo alle maggiori ostruzioni, vengono amici.
Sei in cima: Andare conduce a ostruzioni, venire conduce a gran buona fortuna. È favorevole all'uomo vedere il grande uomo.

40.judgment_zh: 利西南，無所往，其來復吉。有攸往，夙吉。
40.judgment_en: The southwest furthers. If there is no longer anything where one has to go, return brings good fortune. If there is still something where one has to go, hastening brings good fortune.
40.commentary_desc: Mang (indicates that in the case which it presupposes) there will be progress and success. I do not (go and) seek the youthful and inexperienced, but he comes and seeks me. When he shows (the sincerity that marks) the first recourse to divination, I instruct him. If he apply a second and third time, that is troublesome; and I do not instruct the troublesome. There will be advantage in being firm and correct.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, (has respect to) the dispelling of ignorance. It will be advantageous to use punishment (for that purpose), and to remove the shackles (from the mind). But going on in that way (of punishment) will give occasion for regret.

The second nine, undivided, (shows its subject) exercising forbearance with the ignorant, in which there will be good fortune; and admitting (even the goodness of women, which will also be fortunate. (He may be described also as) a son able to (sustain the burden of) his family.

The third six, divided, (seems to say) that one should not marry a woman whose emblem it might be, for that, when she sees a man of wealth, she will not keep her person from him, and in no wise will advantage come from her.
The fourth six, divided, (shows its subject as io bound in chains of ignorance. There will be occasion for regret.
The fifth six, divided, shows its subject as a simple lad without experience. There will be good fortune.
In the topmost nine, undivided, we see one smiting the ignorant (youth). But no advantage will come from doing him an injury. Advantage would come from warding off injury from him.

image.image_zh: 雷雨作，解。君子以赦過宥罪。
image.image_en: Thunder and rain set in: The image of Deliverance. Thus the superior man pardons mistakes and forgives misdeeds.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El trueno sobre el agua: La imagen de la Liberación. Así el hombre superior perdona los errores y condona las transgresiones.
image.image_it: Il tuono sull'acqua: L'immagine della Liberazione. Così l'uomo superiore perdona gli errori e condona le trasgressioni.

lines_zh: 初六：無咎。
九二：田獲三狐，得黃矢，貞吉。
六三：負且乘，致寇至，貞吝。
九四：解而拇，朋至斯孚。
六五：君子維有解，吉，有孚于小人。
上六：公用射隼于高墉之上，獲之，無不利。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Without blame.
Nine in the second place: One kills three foxes in the field and receives a yellow arrow. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Six in the third place: If a man carries a burden on his back and nonetheless rides in a carriage, he thereby encourages robbers to draw near. Perseverance leads to humiliation.
Nine in the fourth place: Deliver yourself from your great toe. Then the companion comes, and him you can trust.
Six in the fifth place: If only the superior man can deliver himself, it brings good fortune. Thus he proves to inferior men that he is in earnest.
Six at the top: The prince shoots at a hawk on a high wall. He kills it. Everything serves to further.
40.judgment_es: El suroeste favorece. Si ya no hay nada adónde uno tenga que ir, el retorno trae buena fortuna. Si aún hay algo adónde uno tenga que ir, la prisa trae buena fortuna.
40.judgment_it: Il sud-ovest favorisce. Se non c'è più nulla dove uno debba andare, il ritorno porta buona fortuna. Se c'è ancora qualcosa dove uno debba andare, la fretta porta buona fortuna.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Sin culpa.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Uno mata tres zorros en el campo y recibe una flecha amarilla. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Si un hombre lleva una carga sobre su espalda y sin embargo monta en un carruaje, así alienta a los ladrones a acercarse. La perseverancia conduce a humillación.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Libérate de tu dedo gordo del pie. Entonces viene el compañero, y a él puedes confiar.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Si solo el hombre superior puede liberarse, trae buena fortuna. Así demuestra a los hombres inferiores que es serio.
Seis en lo alto: El príncipe dispara a un halcón en un muro alto. Lo mata. Todo sirve para favorecer.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Nessuna colpa.
Nove al secondo posto: Si uccidono tre volpi nel campo e si riceve una freccia gialla. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.
Sei al terzo posto: Se un uomo porta un carico sulla sua schiena e ciononostante cavalca in carrozza, così incoraggia i ladri ad avvicinarsi. La perseveranza conduce all'umiliazione.
Nove al quarto posto: Liberati dal tuo dito grosso del piede. Poi viene il compagno, e a lui puoi fidarti.
Sei al quinto posto: Se solo l'uomo nobile può liberarsi, porta buona fortuna. Così dimostra agli uomini inferiori che è serio.
Sei in cima: Il principe spara a un falco su un muro alto. Lo uccide. Tutto serve a favorire.

41.judgment_zh: 有孚，元吉，無咎，可貞，利有攸往。曷之用，二簋可用享。
41.judgment_en: Decrease combined with sincerity brings about supreme good fortune without blame. One may be persevering in this. It furthers one to undertake something. How is this to be carried out? One may use two small bowls for the sacrifice.
41.commentary_desc: Hang indicates successful progress and no error (in what it denotes). But the advantage will come from being firm and correct; and movement in any direction whatever will be advantageous.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject deeply (desirous) of long continuance. Even with firm correctness there will be evil; there will be no advantage in any way.
The second nine, undivided, shows all occasion for repentance disappearing.
The third nine, undivided, shows one who does not continuously maintain his virtue. There are those who will impute this to him as a disgrace. However firm he may be, there will be ground for regret.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows a field where there is no game.
The fifth six, divided, shows its subject continuously maintaining the virtue indicated by it. In a wife this will be fortunate; in a husband, evil.
The topmost six, divided, shows its subject exciting himself to long continuance. There will be evil.

image.image_zh: 山下有澤，損。君子以懲忿窒欲。
image.image_en: At the foot of the mountain, the lake: The image of Decrease. Thus the superior man controls his anger and restrains his instincts.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El lago sobre la montaña: La imagen de la Disminución. Así el hombre superior reprime su ira y reprime sus deseos.
image.image_it: Il lago sulla montagna: L'immagine della Diminuzione. Così l'uomo superiore reprime la sua ira e reprime i suoi desideri.

lines_zh: 初九：已事遄往，無咎，酌損之。
九二：利貞，征凶，弗損益之。
六三：三人行，則損一人，一人行，則得其友。
六四：損其疾，使遄有喜，無咎。
六五：或益之十朋之龜，弗克違，元吉。
上九：弗損益之，無咎，貞吉，利有攸往，得臣無家。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Going quickly when one's tasks are finished is without blame. But one must reflect on how much one may decrease others.
Nine in the second place: Perseverance furthers. To undertake something brings misfortune. Without decreasing oneself, one is able to bring increase to others.
Six in the third place: When three people journey together, their number decreases by one. When one man journeys alone, he finds a companion.
Six in the fourth place: If a man decreases his faults, it makes the other hasten to come and rejoice. No blame.
Six in the fifth place: Someone does indeed increase him. Ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it. Supreme good fortune.

Nine at the top: If one is increased without others being decreased, there is no blame. Perseverance brings good fortune. It furthers one to undertake something. One obtains servants but no longer has a separate home.
41.judgment_es: La disminución combinada con sinceridad trae suprema buena fortuna sin culpa. Uno puede ser perseverante en esto. Favorece al hombre emprender algo. ¿Cómo debe llevarse esto a cabo? Uno puede usar dos pequeños cuencos para el sacrificio.
41.judgment_it: La diminuzione combinata con sincerità porta suprema buona fortuna senza colpa. Si può essere perseveranti in questo. È favorevole all'uomo intraprendere qualcosa. Come deve essere portato a termine? Si possono usare due piccole coppe per il sacrificio.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Ir rápidamente cuando las tareas están terminadas es sin culpa. Pero uno debe reflexionar sobre cuánto puede disminuir a otros.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: La perseverancia favorece. Emprender algo trae desgracia. Sin disminuirse a sí mismo, uno es capaz de traer aumento a otros.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Cuando tres personas viajan juntas, su número disminuye en uno. Cuando un hombre viaja solo, encuentra un compañero.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Si un hombre disminuye sus faltas, hace que el otro se apresure a venir y regocijarse. Sin culpa.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Alguien de hecho lo aumenta. Diez pares de tortugas no pueden oponerse. Suprema buena fortuna.

Nueve en lo alto: Si uno es aumentado sin que otros sean disminuidos, no hay culpa. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. Favorece al hombre emprender algo. Uno obtiene sirvientes pero ya no tiene un hogar separado.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Andare velocemente quando i compiti sono finiti è senza colpa. Ma uno deve riflettere su quanto può diminuire gli altri.
Nove al secondo posto: La perseveranza favorisce. Intraprendere qualcosa porta sventura. Senza diminuire se stesso, uno è capace di portare incremento ad altri.
Sei al terzo posto: Quando tre persone viaggiano insieme, il loro numero diminuisce di uno. Quando un uomo viaggia solo, trova un compagno.
Sei al quarto posto: Se un uomo diminuisce le sue colpe, fa sì che l'altro si affretti a venire e rallegrarsi. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al quinto posto: Qualcuno di fatto lo aumenta. Dieci paia di tartarughe non possono opporsi. Suprema buona fortuna.

Nove in cima: Se uno è aumentato senza che altri siano diminuiti, non c'è colpa. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. È favorevole all'uomo intraprendere qualcosa. Si ottengono servitori ma non si ha più una casa separata.

42.judgment_en: It furthers one to undertake something. It furthers one to cross the great water.
42.commentary_desc: Hsien indicates that, (on the fulfillment of the conditions implied in it), there will be free course and success. Its advantageousness will depend on the being firm and correct, (as) in marrying a young lady. There will be good fortune.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows one moving his great toes.
The second six, divided, shows one moving the calves of his leg. There will be evil. If he abide (quiet in his place), there will be good fortune.
The third nine, undivided, shows one moving his thighs, and keeping close hold of those whom he follows. Going forward (in this way) will cause regret.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows that firm correctness which will lead to good fortune, and prevent all occasion for repentance. If its subject be unsettled in his movements, (only) his friends will follow his purpose.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows one moving the flesh along the spine above the heart. There will be no occasion for repentance.
The sixth six, divided, shows one -.moving his jaws and tongue.

image.image_zh: 風雷益。君子以見善則遷，有過則改。
image.image_en: Wind and thunder: The image of Increase. Thus the superior man: If he sees good, he imitates it; If he has faults, he rids himself of them.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El truero y el viento: La imagen del Aumento. Así el hombre superior cuando ve el bien lo imita, y cuando tiene errores los corrige.
image.image_it: Il tuono e il vento: L'immagine dell'Aumento. Così l'uomo superiore quando vede il bene lo imita, e quando ha errori li corregge.

lines_zh: 初九：利用為大作，元吉，無咎。
六二：或益之十朋之龜，弗克違，永貞吉。王用享于帝，吉。
六三：益之用凶事，無咎。有孚中行，告公用圭。
六四：中行，告公從，利用為依遷國。
九五：有孚惠心，勿問元吉。有孚惠我德。
上九：莫益之，或擊之，立心勿恆，凶。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: It furthers one to accomplish great deeds. Supreme good fortune. No blame.
Six in the second place: Someone does indeed increase him; ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it. Constant perseverance brings good fortune. The king presents him before God. Good fortune.
Six in the third place: One is enriched through unfortunate events. No blame, if you are sincere and walk in the middle, and report with a seal to the prince.
Six in the fourth place: If you walk in the middle and report to the prince, he will follow. It furthers one to be used in the removal of the capital.
Nine in the fifth place: If in truth you have a kind heart, ask not. Supreme good fortune. Truly, confidence will approach your virtue.
Nine at the top: He brings increase to no one. Indeed, someone even strikes him. He does not keep his heart constantly steady. Misfortune.
42.judgment_es: Favorece al hombre emprender algo. Favorece al hombre cruzar la gran agua.
42.judgment_it: È favorevole all'uomo intraprendere qualcosa. È favorevole all'uomo attraversare la grande acqua.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Favorece al hombre realizar grandes obras. Suprema buena fortuna. Sin culpa.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Alguien de hecho lo aumenta; diez pares de tortugas no pueden oponerse. Perseverancia constante trae buena fortuna. El rey lo presenta ante Dios. Buena fortuna.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Uno se enriquece a través de eventos desafortunados. Sin culpa, si eres sincero y caminas en el medio, e informas con un sello al príncipe.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Si caminas en el medio e informas al príncipe, él seguirá. Favorece al hombre ser usado en el traslado de la capital.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Si en verdad tienes un corazón bondadoso, no preguntes. Suprema buena fortuna. Verdaderamente, la confianza se acercará a tu virtud.
Nueve en lo alto: Él no trae aumento a nadie. De hecho, alguien incluso lo golpea. Él no mantiene su corazón constantemente firme. Desgracia.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: È favorevole all'uomo realizzare grandi opere. Suprema buona fortuna. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al secondo posto: Qualcuno di fatto lo aumenta; dieci paia di tartarughe non possono opporsi. Perseveranza costante porta buona fortuna. Il re lo presenta davanti a Dio. Buona fortuna.
Sei al terzo posto: Si arricchisce attraverso eventi sfortunati. Nessuna colpa, se sei sincero e cammini nel mezzo, e informi con un sigillo al principe.
Sei al quarto posto: Se cammini nel mezzo e informi il principe, lui seguirà. È favorevole all'uomo essere usato nello spostamento della capitale.
Nove al quinto posto: Se in verità hai un cuore gentile, non chiedere. Suprema buona fortuna. Veramente, la fiducia si avvicinerà alla tua virtù.
Nove in cima: Egli non porta incremento a nessuno. Di fatto, qualcuno perfino lo colpisce. Egli non mantiene il suo cuore costantemente fermo. Sventura.

43.judgment_zh: 揚于王庭，孚號，有厲。告自邑，不利即戎，利有攸往。
43.judgment_en: One must resolutely make the matter known at the court of the king. It must be announced truthfully. Danger. It is necessary to notify one's own city. It does not further to resort to arms. It furthers one to undertake something.
43.commentary_desc: Hsiao Khu indicates that (under its conditions) there will be progress and success. (We see) dense clouds, but no rain coming from our borders in the west.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject returning and pursuing his own course. What mistake should he fall into? There will be good fortune.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject, by the attraction (of the former line), returning (to the proper course). There will be good fortune.
The third nine, undivided, suggests the idea of a carriage, the strap beneath which has been removed, or of a husband and wife looking on each other with averted eyes.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject possessed of sincerity. The danger of bloodshed is thereby averted, and his (ground for) apprehension dismissed. There will be no mistake.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject possessed of sincerity, and drawing others to unite with him. Rich in resources, he employs his neighbors (in the same cause with himself).

The topmost nine, undivided, shows how the rain has fallen, and the (onward progress) is stayed; -(so) must we value the full accumulation of the virtue (represented by the upper trigram). But a wife (exercising restraint), however firm and correct she may be, is in a position of peril, (and like) the moon approaching to the full. If the superior man prosecute his measures (in such circumstances), there will be evil.

image.image_zh: 澤上於天，夬。君子以施祿及下，居德則忌。
image.image_en: The lake has risen up to heaven: The image of Break-through. Thus the superior man dispenses riches downward and refrains from resting on his virtue.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El lago sobre el cielo: La imagen del Desbordamiento. Así el hombre superior distribuye la abundancia a los que ocupan posiciones inferiores, y vigila contra la insolvencia.
image.image_it: Il lago sul cielo: L'immagine dello Straripamento. Così l'uomo superiore distribuisce l'abbondanza a coloro che occupano posizioni inferiori, e vigila contro l'insolvenza.

lines_zh: 初九：壯于前趾，往不勝，為咎。
九二：惕號，莫夜有戎，勿恤。
九三：壯于頄，有凶。君子夬夬獨行，遇雨若濡，有慍無咎。
九四：臀無膚，其行次且，牽羊悔亡，聞言不信。
九五：莧陸夬夬，中行無咎。
上六：無號，終有凶。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Mighty in the forward-striding toes. When one goes and is not equal to the task, one makes a mistake.
Nine in the second place: A cry of alarm. Arms at evening and at night. Fear nothing.

Nine in the third place: To be powerful in the cheekbones brings misfortune. The superior man is firmly resolved. He walks alone and is caught in the rain. He is bespattered, and people murmur against him. No blame.

Nine in the fourth place: There is no skin on his thighs, and walking comes hard. If a man were to let himself be led like a sheep, remorse would disappear. But if these words are heard they will not be believed.
Nine in the fifth place: In dealing with weeds, firm resolution is necessary. Walking in the middle remains free of blame.
Six at the top: No cry. In the end misfortune comes.
43.judgment_es: Uno debe resueltamente hacer saber el asunto en la corte del rey. Debe ser anunciado verazmente. Peligro. Es necesario notificar a la propia ciudad. No favorece recurrir a las armas. Favorece al hombre emprender algo.
43.judgment_it: Si deve risolutamente far conoscere la questione alla corte del re. Deve essere annunciata veracemente. Pericolo. È necessario notificare la propria città. Non favorisce ricorrere alle armi. È favorevole all'uomo intraprendere qualcosa.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Poderoso en los dedos de los pies que avanzan. Cuando uno va y no es igual a la tarea, comete un error.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Un grito de alarma. Armas en la tarde y en la noche. No temas nada.

Nueve en el tercer lugar: Ser poderoso en los pómulos trae desgracia. El hombre superior está firmemente resuelto. Camina solo y es atrapado por la lluvia. Es salpicado, y la gente murmura contra él. Sin culpa.

Nueve en el cuarto lugar: No hay piel en sus muslos, y caminar es difícil. Si un hombre se dejara guiar como una oveja, el remordimiento desaparecería. Pero si estas palabras son oídas no serán creídas.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Al lidiar con malezas, es necesaria resolución firme. Caminar en el medio permanece libre de culpa.
Seis en lo alto: No hay grito. Al final viene la desgracia.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Potente nelle dita dei piedi che avanzano. Quando uno va e non è all'altezza del compito, commette un errore.
Nove al secondo posto: Un grido d'allarme. Armi alla sera e di notte. Non temere nulla.

Nove al terzo posto: Essere potente nelle guance porta sventura. L'uomo nobile è fermamente risoluto. Cammina solo ed è colto dalla pioggia. È schizzato, e la gente mormora contro di lui. Nessuna colpa.

Nove al quarto posto: Non c'è pelle sulle sue cosce, e camminare è difficile. Se un uomo si lasciasse guidare come una pecora, il rimorso svanirebbe. Ma se queste parole sono udite non saranno credute.
Nove al quinto posto: Nel trattare con erbacce, è necessaria risoluzione ferma. Camminare nel mezzo rimane libero da colpa.
Sei in cima: Non c'è grido. Alla fine viene la sventura.

44.judgment_en: The maiden is powerful. One should not marry such a maiden.
44.commentary_desc: (Li suggests the idea of) one treading on the tail of a tiger, which does not bite him. 'I'here will be progress and success.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject treading his accustomed path. If he go forward, there will be no error.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject treading the path that is level and easy;-a quiet and solitary man, to whom, if he be firm and correct, there will be good fortune.

The third six, divided, shows a one-eyed man (Who thinks he) can see; a lame man (who thinks he) can walk well; one who treads on the tail of a tiger and is bitten. (All this indicates) ill fortune. We have a (mere) bravo acting the part of a great ruler.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject treading on the tail of a tiger. He becomes full of apprehensive caution, and in the end there will be good fortune.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows the resolute tread of its subject. Though he be firm and correct, there will be peril.
The sixth nine, undivided, tells us to look at (the whole course) that is trodden, and examine the presage which that gives. If it be complete and without failure, there will be great good fortune.

image.image_zh: 天下有風，姤。后以施命誥四方。
image.image_en: Under heaven, wind: The image of Coming to Meet. Thus does the prince act when disseminating his commands and proclaiming them to the four quarters of heaven.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El cielo sobre el lago: La imagen del Acoplamiento. Así el hombre superior proclama sus instrucciones cuando llega el momento, y así evita males.
image.image_it: Il cielo sopra il lago: L'immagine dell'Accoppiamento. Così l'uomo superiore proclama le sue istruzioni quando arriva il momento, e così evita mali.

lines_zh: 初六：繫于金柅，貞吉。有攸往，見凶，羸豕孚躑躅。
九二：包有魚，無咎，不利賓。
九三：臀無膚，其行次且，厲，無大咎。
九四：包無魚，起凶。
九五：以杞包瓜，含章，有隕自天。
上九：姤其角，吝，無咎。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: It must be checked with a brake of bronze. Perseverance brings good fortune. If one lets it take its course, one experiences misfortune. Even a lean pig has it in him to rage around.
Nine in the second place: There is a fish in the tank. No blame. Does not further guests.
Nine in the third place: There is no skin on his thighs, and walking comes hard. If one is mindful of the danger, no great mistake is made.
Nine in the fourth place: No fish in the tank. This leads to misfortune.
Nine in the fifth place: A melon covered with willow leaves. Hidden lines. Then it drops down to one from heaven.
Nine at the top: He comes to meet with his horns. Humiliation. No blame.
44.judgment_es: La doncella es poderosa. No debe casarse con tal doncella.
44.judgment_it: La fanciulla è potente. Non si deve sposare tale fanciulla.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Debe ser frenado con un freno de bronce. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. Si uno lo deja seguir su curso, experimenta desgracia. Incluso un cerdo flaco tiene en sí para enfurecerse.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Hay un pez en el tanque. Sin culpa. No favorece huéspedes.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: No hay piel en sus muslos, y caminar es difícil. Si uno es consciente del peligro, no se comete gran error.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: No hay pez en el tanque. Esto conduce a desgracia.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Un melón cubierto con hojas de sauce. Líneas ocultas. Entonces cae a uno desde el cielo.
Nueve en lo alto: Viene a encontrar con sus cuernos. Humillación. Sin culpa.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Deve essere frenato con un freno di bronzo. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Se uno lo lascia seguire il suo corso, sperimenta sventura. Perfino un maiale magro ha in sé da infuriarsi.
Nove al secondo posto: C'è un pesce nel bacino. Nessuna colpa. Non favorisce ospiti.
Nove al terzo posto: Non c'è pelle sulle sue cosce, e camminare è difficile. Se uno è consapevole del pericolo, non si commette gran errore.
Nove al quarto posto: Non c'è pesce nel bacino. Questo conduce a sventura.
Nove al quinto posto: Un melone coperto con foglie di salice. Linee nascoste. Allora cade a uno dal cielo.
Nove in cima: Viene ad incontrare con le sue corna. Umiliazione. Nessuna colpa.

45.judgment_zh: 亨。王假有廟，利見大人，亨，利貞。用大牲吉，利有攸往。
45.judgment_en: Success. The king approaches his temple. It furthers one to see the great man. This brings success. Perseverance furthers. To bring great offerings creates good fortune. It furthers one to undertake something.
45.commentary_desc: Kwan shows (how he whom it represents should be like) the worshipper who has washed his hands, but not (yet) presented his offerings; -- with sincerity and an appearance of dignity (commanding reverent regard).
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows the looking of a lad; -- not blamable in men of inferior rank, but matter for regret in superior men.
The second six, divided, shows one peeping out from a door. It would be advantageous if it were (merely) the firm correctness of a female.
The third six, divided, shows one looking at (the course of) his own life, to advance or recede (accordingly).
The fourth six, divided, shows one contemplating the glory of the kingdom. It will be advantageous for him, being such as he is, (to seek) to be a guest of the king.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject contemplating his own life(-course). A superior man, he will (thus) fall into no error.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows its subject contemplating his character to see if it be indeed that of a superior man. He will not fall into error.

image.image_zh: 澤上於地，萃。君子以除戎器，戒不虞。
image.image_en: The lake over the earth: The image of Gathering Together. Thus the superior man renews his weapons in order to meet the unforeseen.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El lago sobre la tierra: La imagen de la Reunión. Así el hombre superior arregla sus armas para guardar contra ataques inesperados.
image.image_it: Il lago sulla terra: L'immagine della Riunione. Così l'uomo superiore sistema le sue armi per guardarsi contro attacchi inaspettati.

lines_zh: 初六：有孚不終，乃亂乃萃，若號，一握為笑，勿恤，往無咎。
六二：引吉，無咎，孚乃利用禴。
六三：萃如嗟如，無攸利，往無咎，小吝。
九四：大吉，無咎。
九五：萃有位，無咎，匪孚，元永貞，悔亡。
上六：齎咨涕洟，無咎。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: If you are sincere, but not to the end, there will sometimes be confusion, sometimes gathering together. If you call out, then after one grasp of the hand you can laugh again. Regret not. Going is without blame.
Six in the second place: Letting oneself be drawn brings good fortune and remains blameless. If one is sincere, it furthers one to bring even a small offering.
Six in the third place: Gathering together amid sighs. Nothing that would further. Going is without blame. Slight humiliation.
Nine in the fourth place: Great good fortune. No blame.

Nine in the fifth place: If in gathering together one has position, this brings no blame. If there are some who are not yet sincerely in the work, sublime and enduring perseverance is needed. Then remorse disappears.
Six at the top: Lamenting and sighing, floods of tears. No blame.
45.judgment_es: Éxito. El rey se acerca a su templo. Favorece al hombre ver al gran hombre. Esto trae éxito. La perseverancia favorece. Traer grandes ofrendas crea buena fortuna. Favorece al hombre emprender algo.
45.judgment_it: Successo. Il re si avvicina al suo tempio. È favorevole all'uomo vedere il grande uomo. Questo porta successo. La perseveranza favorisce. Portare grandi offerte crea buona fortuna. È favorevole all'uomo intraprendere qualcosa.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Si eres sincero, pero no hasta el final, habrá a veces confusión, a veces reunión. Si llamas, entonces después de un apretón de manos puedes reír de nuevo. No te arrepientas. Ir es sin culpa.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Dejarse llevar trae buena fortuna y permanece sin culpa. Si uno es sincero, favorece al hombre traer incluso una pequeña ofrenda.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Reunión entre suspiros. Nada que favoreciera. Ir es sin culpa. Ligera humillación.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Gran buena fortuna. Sin culpa.

Nueve en el quinto lugar: Si al reunirse uno tiene posición, esto no trae culpa. Si hay algunos que aún no están sinceramente en el trabajo, se necesita perseverancia sublime y duradera. Entonces el remordimiento desaparece.
Seis en lo alto: Lamentándose y suspirando, torrentes de lágrimas. Sin culpa.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Se sei sincero, ma non fino in fondo, ci sarà a volte confusione, a volte riunione. Se chiami, allora dopo una stretta di mano puoi ridere di nuovo. Non pentirti. Andare è senza colpa.
Sei al secondo posto: Lasciarsi trascinare porta buona fortuna e rimane senza colpa. Se uno è sincero, è favorevole all'uomo portare anche una piccola offerta.
Sei al terzo posto: Riunione tra sospiri. Nulla che favorisca. Andare è senza colpa. Leggera umiliazione.
Nove al quarto posto: Gran buona fortuna. Nessuna colpa.

Nove al quinto posto: Se nel riunirsi uno ha posizione, questo non porta colpa. Se ci sono alcuni che non sono ancora sinceramente nel lavoro, è necessaria perseveranza sublime e duratura. Allora il rimorso svanisce.
Sei in cima: Lamentarsi e sospirare, torrenti di lacrime. Nessuna colpa.

46.judgment_zh: 元亨，用見大人，勿恤，南征吉。
46.judgment_en: Supreme success. One must see the great man. Fear not. Departure toward the south brings good fortune.
46.commentary_desc: Lin (indicates that under the conditions supposed in it) there will be great progress and success, while it will be advantageous to be firmly correct. In the eighth month there will be evil.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject advancing in company (with the subject of the second line). Through his firm correctness there will be good fortune.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject advancing in company (with the subject of the first line). There will be good fortune; (advancing) will be in every way advantageous.
The third six, divided, shows one well pleased (indeed) to advance, (but whose action) will be in no way advantageous. If he become anxious about it (however), there will be no error.
The fourth six, divided, shows one advancing )n the highest mode. There will be no error.
The fifth six, divided, shows the advance of wisdom, such as befits the great ruler. There will be good fortune.
The sixth six, divided, shows the advance of honesty and generosity. There will be good fortune, and no error.

image.image_zh: 地中生木，升。君子以順德，積小以高大。
image.image_en: Within the earth, wood grows: The image of Pushing Upward. Thus the superior man of devoted character heaps up small things in order to achieve something high and great.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El agua dentro de la tierra: La imagen del Ascenso. Así el hombre superior, por medio del respeto, se dedica con todo su corazón a cuidar a las masas.
image.image_it: L'acqua dentro la terra: L'immagine dell'Ascesa. Così l'uomo superiore, mediante il rispetto, si dedica con tutto il cuore a prendersi cura delle masse.

lines_zh: 初六：允升，大吉。
九二：孚乃利用禴，無咎。
九三：升虛邑。
六四：王用亨于岐山，吉，無咎。
六五：貞吉，升階。
上六：冥升，利于不息之貞。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Pushing upward that meets with confidence brings great good fortune.
Nine in the second place: If one is sincere, it furthers one to bring even a small offering. No blame.
Nine in the third place: One pushes upward into an empty city.
Six in the fourth place: The king offers him Mount Ch'i. Good fortune. No blame.
Six in the fifth place: Perseverance brings good fortune. One pushes upward by steps.
Six at the top: Pushing upward in the dark. It furthers one to be unremittingly persevering.
46.judgment_es: Supremo éxito. Uno debe ver al gran hombre. No temas. La partida hacia el sur trae buena fortuna.
46.judgment_it: Supremo successo. Si deve vedere il grande uomo. Non temere. La partenza verso sud porta buona fortuna.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Empujar hacia arriba que encuentra confianza trae gran buena fortuna.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Si uno es sincero, favorece al hombre traer incluso una pequeña ofrenda. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Uno empuja hacia arriba en una ciudad vacía.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: El rey le ofrece el Monte Ch'i. Buena fortuna. Sin culpa.
Seis en el quinto lugar: La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. Uno empuja hacia arriba por pasos.
Seis en lo alto: Empujar hacia arriba en la oscuridad. Favorece al hombre ser incansablemente perseverante.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Spingere verso l'alto che trova fiducia porta gran buona fortuna.
Nove al secondo posto: Se uno è sincero, è favorevole all'uomo portare anche una piccola offerta. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al terzo posto: Si spinge verso l'alto in una città vuota.
Sei al quarto posto: Il re gli offre il Monte Ch'i. Buona fortuna. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al quinto posto: La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Si spinge verso l'alto per passi.
Sei in cima: Spingere verso l'alto nell'oscurità. È favorevole all'uomo essere instancabilmente perseverante.

47.judgment_zh: 亨，貞，大人吉，無咎，有言不信。
47.judgment_en: Success. Perseverance. The great man brings about good fortune. No blame. When one has something to say, it is not believed.
47.commentary_desc: Hwan intimates that (under its conditions) there will be progress and success. The king goes to his ancestral temple; and it will be advantageous to cross the great stream. It will be advantageous to be firm and correct.,
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject engaged in rescuing (from the impending evil) and having (the assistance of) a strong horse. There will be good fortune.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject, amid the dispersion, hurrying to his contrivance (for security). All occasion for repentance will disappear.
The third six, divided, shows its subject discarding any regard to his own person. There will be no occasion for repentance.

The fourth six, divided, shows its subject scattering the (different) parties (in the state); which leads to great good fortune. From the dispersion (he collects again good men standing out, a crowd) like a mound, which is what ordinary men would not have thought of

The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject amidst the dispersion issuing his great announcements as the perspiration (flows from his body). He scatters abroad (also) the accumulations in the royal granaries. There will be no error.
The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject disposing of (what may be called) its bloody wounds, and going and separating himself from its anxious fears. There will be no error.

image.image_zh: 澤無水，困。君子以致命遂志。
image.image_en: There is no water in the lake: The image of Exhaustion. Thus the superior man stakes his life on following his will.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El lago sobre el agua: La imagen de la Angustia. Así el hombre superior consume su propia vida para realizar su voluntad.
image.image_it: Il lago sull'acqua: L'immagine dell'Angoscia. Così l'uomo superiore consuma la sua propria vita per realizzare la sua volontà.

lines_zh: 初六：臀困于株木，入于幽谷，三歲不覿。
九二：困于酒食，朱紱方來，利用享祀，征凶，無咎。
六三：困于石，據于蒺藜，入于其宮，不見其妻，凶。
九四：來徐徐，困于金車，吝，有終。
九五：劓刖，困于赤紱，乃徐有說，利用祭祀。
上六：困于葛藟，于臲卼，曰動悔有悔，征吉。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: One sits oppressed under a bare tree and strays into a gloomy valley. For three years one sees nothing.
Nine in the second place: One is oppressed while at meat and drink. The man with the scarlet knee bands is just coming. It furthers one to offer sacrifice. To set forth brings misfortune. No blame.
Six in the third place: A man permits himself to be oppressed by stone, and leans on thorns and thistles. He enters his house and does not see his wife. Misfortune.
Nine in the fourth place: He comes very quietly, oppressed in a golden carriage. Humiliation, but the end is reached.
Nine in the fifth place: His nose and feet are cut off. Oppression at the hands of the man with the purple knee bands. Joy comes softly. It furthers one to make offerings and libations.
Six at the top: He is oppressed by creeping vines. He moves insecurely and says, 'Movement brings remorse.' If one feels remorse over this and makes a start, good fortune comes.
47.judgment_es: Éxito. Perseverancia. El gran hombre trae buena fortuna. Sin culpa. Cuando uno tiene algo que decir, no es creído.
47.judgment_it: Successo. Perseveranza. Il gran uomo porta buona fortuna. Nessuna colpa. Quando uno ha qualcosa da dire, non è creduto.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Uno se sienta oprimido bajo un árbol desnudo y se extravía en un valle sombrío. Por tres años uno no ve nada.

Nueve en el segundo lugar: Uno es oprimido mientras come y bebe. El hombre con las bandas rojizas de la rodilla acaba de venir. Favorece al hombre ofrecer sacrificio. Empezar trae desgracia. Sin culpa.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Un hombre se permite ser oprimido por la piedra, y se apoya en espinas y cardos. Entra en su casa y no ve a su esposa. Desgracia.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Él viene muy silenciosamente, oprimido en un carruaje dorado. Humillación, pero el fin es alcanzado.

Nueve en el quinto lugar: Su nariz y pies están cortados. Opresión a manos del hombre con las bandas púrpuras de la rodilla. La alegría viene suavemente. Favorece al hombre hacer ofrendas y libaciones.

Seis en lo alto: Él es oprimido por enredaderas trepadoras. Se mueve inseguro y dice: 'El movimiento trae remordimiento.' Si uno siente remordimiento por esto y hace un comienzo, viene la buena fortuna.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Si siede oppresso sotto un albero nudo e si smarrisce in una valle ombrosa. Per tre anni uno non vede nulla.

Nove al secondo posto: Si è oppressi mentre si mangia e si beve. L'uomo con le fasce rossicce del ginocchio sta proprio arrivando. È favorevole all'uomo offrire sacrificio. Iniziare porta sventura. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al terzo posto: Un uomo si permette di essere oppresso dalla pietra, e si appoggia su spine e cardi. Entra in casa sua e non vede sua moglie. Sventura.
Nove al quarto posto: Egli viene molto silenziosamente, oppresso in un carro dorato. Umiliazione, ma la fine è raggiunta.

Nove al quinto posto: Il suo naso e i piedi sono tagliati. Oppressione per mano dell'uomo con le fasce porporine del ginocchio. La gioia viene dolcemente. È favorevole all'uomo fare offerte e libagioni.
Sei in cima: Egli è oppresso da viti rampicanti. Si muove insicuro e dice: 'Il movimento porta rimorso.' Se uno sente rimorso per questo e fa un inizio, viene la buona fortuna.

48.judgment_zh: 改邑不改井，無喪無得，往來井井。汔至，亦未繘井，羸其瓶，凶。
48.judgment_en: The town may be changed, but the well cannot be changed. It neither decreases nor increases. They come and go and draw from the well. If one gets down almost to the water and the rope does not go all the way, or the jug breaks, it brings misfortune.
48.commentary_desc: Kieh intimates that (under its conditions) there will be progress and attainment. (But) if the regulations (which it prescribes) be severe and difficult, they cannot be permanent.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject not quitting the courtyard outside his door. There will be no error.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject not quitting the courtyard inside his gate. There will be evil.
The third six, divided, shows its subject with no appearance of observing the (proper) regulations, in which case we shall see him lamenting. But there will be no one to blame (but himself).
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject quietly and naturally (attentive to all) regulations. There will be progress and success.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject sweetly and acceptably enacting his regulations. There will be good fortune. The onward progress with them will afford ground for admiration.

The topmost six, divided, shows its subject enacting regulations severe and difficult. Even with firmness and correctness there will be evil. But though there will be cause for repentance, it will (by and by) disappear.

image.image_zh: 木上有水，井。君子以勞民勸相。
image.image_en: Water over wood: The image of the Well. Thus the superior man encourages the people at their work, and exhorts them to help one another.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El agua sobre el madera: La imagen del Pozo. Así el hombre superior anima al pueblo en su trabajo y los exhorta a ayudarse mutuamente.
image.image_it: L'acqua sul legno: L'immagine del Pozzo. Così l'uomo superiore anima il popolo nel suo lavoro e li esorta ad aiutarsi a vicenda.

lines_zh: 初六：井泥不食，舊井無禽。
九二：井谷射鮒，甕敝漏。
九三：井渫不食，為我心惻，可用汲，王明並受其福。
六四：井甃，無咎。
九五：井冽，寒泉食。
上六：井收勿幕，有孚元吉。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: One does not drink the mud of the well. No animals come to an old well.
Nine in the second place: At the wellhole one shoots fishes. The jug is broken and leaks.
Nine in the third place: The well is cleaned, but no one drinks from it. This is my heart's sorrow, for one might draw from it. If the king were clear-minded, good fortune might be enjoyed in common.
Six in the fourth place: The well is being lined. No blame.
Nine in the fifth place: In the well there is a clear, cold spring from which one can drink.
Six at the top: One draws from the well without hindrance. It is dependable. Supreme good fortune.
48.judgment_es: El pueblo puede ser cambiado, pero el pozo no puede ser cambiado. Ni disminuye ni aumenta. Vienen y van y extraen del pozo. Si uno baja casi hasta el agua y la cuerda no llega todo el camino, o el cántaro se rompe, trae desgracia.
48.judgment_it: Il paese può essere cambiato, ma il pozzo non può essere cambiato. Né diminuisce né aumenta. Vanno e vengono e attingono dal pozzo. Se uno scende quasi fino all'acqua e la corda non arriva fino in fondo, o il brocca si rompe, porta sventura.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Uno no bebe el lodo del pozo. Ningún animal viene a un pozo viejo.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: En la boca del pozo uno dispara peces. El cántaro está roto y gotea.

Nueve en el tercer lugar: El pozo está limpio, pero nadie bebe de él. Esta es la tristeza de mi corazón, pues podría extraerse de él. Si el rey fuera de mente clara, la buena fortuna podría disfrutarse en común.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: El pozo está siendo revestido. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: En el pozo hay un manantial claro y frío del que uno puede beber.
Seis en lo alto: Uno extrae del pozo sin impedimento. Es confiable. Suprema buena fortuna.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Non si beve il fango del pozzo. Nessun animale viene a un pozzo vecchio.
Nove al secondo posto: Alla bocca del pozzo si sparano pesci. La brocca è rotta e gocciola.

Nove al terzo posto: Il pozzo è pulito, ma nessuno beve da esso. Questa è la tristezza del mio cuore, poiché si potrebbe attingere da esso. Se il re fosse di mente chiara, la buona fortuna potrebbe essere goduta in comune.
Sei al quarto posto: Il pozzo viene rivestito. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al quinto posto: Nel pozzo c'è una sorgente chiara e fredda dalla quale si può bere.
Sei in cima: Si attinge dal pozzo senza impedimento. È affidabile. Suprema buona fortuna.

49.judgment_zh: 巳日乃孚，元亨利貞，悔亡。
49.judgment_en: On your own day you are believed. Supreme success, furthering through perseverance. Remorse disappears.
49.commentary_desc: For (the realization of what is taught in) Kia Zan, (or for the regulation of the family), what is most advantageous is that the wife be firm and correct.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject establishing restrictive regulations in his household. Occasion for repentance will disappear.
The second six, divided, shows its subject taking nothing on herself, but in her central place attending to the preparation of the food. Through her firm correctness there will be good fortune.

The third nine, undivided, shows its subject (treating) the members of the household with stern severity. There will be occasion for repentance, there will be peril, (but) there will (also) be good fortune. If the wife and children were to be smirking and chattering, in the end there would be occasion for regret.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject enriching the family. There will be great good fortune.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows the influence of the king extending to his family. There need be no anxiety; there will be good fortune.
The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject possessed of sincerity and arrayed in majesty. In the end there will be good fortune.

image.image_zh: 澤中有火，革。君子以治曆明時。
image.image_en: Fire in the lake: The image of Revolution. Thus the superior man sets the calendar in order and makes the seasons clear.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El lago sobre el fuego: La imagen de la Revolución. Así el hombre superior hace el calendario y clarifica las estaciones.
image.image_it: Il lago sul fuoco: L'immagine della Rivoluzione. Così l'uomo superiore fa il calendario e chiarisce le stagioni.

lines_zh: 初九：鞏用黃牛之革。
六二：己日乃革之，征吉，無咎。
九三：征凶，貞厲，革言三就，有孚。
九四：悔亡，有孚改命，吉。
九五：大人虎變，未占有孚。
上六：君子豹變，小人革面，征凶，居貞吉。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Wrapped in the hide of a yellow cow.
Six in the second place: When one's own day comes, one may create revolution. Starting brings good fortune. No blame.
Nine in the third place: Starting brings misfortune. Perseverance brings danger. When talk of revolution has gone the rounds three times, one may commit himself, and men will believe him.
Nine in the fourth place: Remorse disappears. Men believe him. Changing the form of government brings good fortune.
Nine in the fifth place: The great man changes like a tiger. Even before he questions the oracle he is believed.
Six at the top: The superior man changes like a panther. The inferior man molts in the face. Starting brings misfortune. To remain persevering brings good fortune.
49.judgment_es: En tu propio día eres creído. Supremo éxito, favoreciendo a través de la perseverancia. El remordimiento desaparece.
49.judgment_it: Nel tuo giorno sei creduto. Supremo successo, favorendo attraverso la perseveranza. Il rimorso svanisce.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Envuelto en la piel de una vaca amarilla.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Cuando viene el propio día de uno, uno puede crear revolución. Comenzar trae buena fortuna. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Comenzar trae desgracia. La perseverancia trae peligro. Cuando la charla de revolución ha dado tres vueltas, uno puede comprometerse, y los hombres lo creerán.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: El remordimiento desaparece. Los hombres lo creen. Cambiar la forma de gobierno trae buena fortuna.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: El gran hombre cambia como un tigre. Incluso antes de que consulte el oráculo es creído.
Seis en lo alto: El hombre superior cambia como una pantera. El hombre inferior muda in faccia. Comenzar trae desgracia. Permanecer perseverante trae buena fortuna.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Avvolto nella pelle di una vacca gialla.
Sei al secondo posto: Quando viene il proprio giorno di uno, si può creare rivoluzione. Iniziare porta buona fortuna. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al terzo posto: Iniziare porta sventura. La perseveranza porta pericolo. Quando il chiacchiericcio di rivoluzione ha fatto tre giri, ci si può impegnare, e gli uomini lo crederanno.
Nove al quarto posto: Il rimorso svanisce. Gli uomini lo credono. Cambiare la forma di governo porta buona fortuna.
Nove al quinto posto: Il gran uomo cambia come una tigre. Anche prima che consulti l'oracolo è creduto.
Sei in cima: L'uomo nobile cambia come una pantera. L'uomo inferiore muta in faccia. Iniziare porta sventura. Rimanere perseverante porta buona fortuna.

50.commentary_desc: Khwei indicates that, (notwithstanding the condition of things which it denotes), in small matters there will (still) be good success.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows that (to its subject) occasion for repentance will disappear. He has lost his horses, but let him not seek for them; -they will return of themselves. Should he meet with bad men, he will not err (in communicating with them).
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject happening to meet with his lord in a bye-passage. There will be no error.

In the third six, divided, we see one whose carriage is dragged back, while the oxen in it are pushed back, and he is himself subjected to the shaving of his head and the cutting off of his nose. There is no good beginning, but there will be a good end.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject solitary amidst the (prevailing) disunion. (But) he meets with the good man (represented by the first line), and they blend their sincere desires together. The position is one of peril, but there will be no mistake.

The fifth six, divided, shows that (to its subject) occasion for repentance will disappear. With his relative (and minister he unites closely and readily) as if he were biting through a piece of skin. When he goes forward (with this help), what error can there be?

The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject solitary amidst the (prevailing) disunion. (In the subject of the third line, he seems to) see a pig bearing on its back a load of mud, (or fancies) there is a carriage full of ghosts. He first bends his bow against him, and afterwards unbends it, (for he discovers) that he is not an assailant to injure, but a near relative. Going forward, he shall meet with (genial) rain, and there will be good fortune.

image.image_zh: 木上有火，鼎。君子以正位凝命。
image.image_en: Fire over wood: The image of the Caldron. Thus the superior man consolidates his fate by making his position correct.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El fuego sobre el madera: La imagen del Caldero. Así el hombre superior consolida su posición para asegurar el destino.
image.image_it: Il fuoco sul legno: L'immagine del Calderone. Così l'uomo superiore consolida la sua posizione per assicurare il destino.

lines_zh: 初六：鼎顛趾，利出否，得妾以其子，無咎。
九二：鼎有實，我仇有疾，不我能即，吉。
九三：鼎耳革，其行塞，雉膏不食，方雨虧悔，終吉。
九四：鼎折足，覆公餗，其形渥，凶。
六五：鼎黃耳金鉉，利貞。
上九：鼎玉鉉，大吉，無不利。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: A ting with legs upturned. Furthers removal of stagnating stuff. One takes a concubine for the sake of her son. No blame.
Nine in the second place: There is food in the ting. My comrades are envious, but they cannot harm me. Good fortune.
Nine in the third place: The handle of the ting is altered. One is impeded in his way of life. The fat of the pheasant is not eaten. Once rain falls, remorse is spent. Good fortune comes in the end.
Nine in the fourth place: The legs of the ting are broken. The prince's meal is spilled and his person is soiled. Misfortune.
Six in the fifth place: The ting has yellow handles, golden carrying rings. Perseverance furthers.
Nine at the top: The ting has rings of jade. Great good fortune. Nothing that would not further.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Un ting con las patas vueltas hacia arriba. Favorece la remoción de cosas estancadas. Uno toma una concubina por el bien de su hijo. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Hay comida en el ting. Mis camaradas son envidiosos, pero no pueden hacerme daño. Buena fortuna.

Nueve en el tercer lugar: El asa del ting está alterada. Uno es impedido en su modo de vida. La grasa del faisán no se come. Una vez que cae la lluvia, el remordimiento se gasta. La buena fortuna viene al final.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Las patas del ting están rotas. La comida del príncipe se derrama y su persona se ensucia. Desgracia.
Seis en el quinto lugar: El ting tiene asas amarillas, anillos dorados para llevar. La perseverancia favorece.
Nueve en lo alto: El ting tiene anillos de jade. Gran buena fortuna. Nada que no favoreciera.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Un ting con le gambe rivolte verso l'alto. Favorisce la rimozione di cose stagnanti. Si prende una concubina per il bene di suo figlio. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al secondo posto: C'è cibo nel ting. I miei compagni sono invidiosi, ma non possono farmi male. Buona fortuna.

Nove al terzo posto: Il manico del ting è alterato. Si è impediti nel proprio modo di vita. Il grasso del fagiano non si mangia. Una volta che cade la pioggia, il rimorso si consuma. La buona fortuna viene alla fine.
Nove al quarto posto: Le gambe del ting sono rotte. Il pasto del principe si rovescia e la sua persona si sporca. Sventura.
Sei al quinto posto: Il ting ha manici gialli, anelli dorati per portare. La perseveranza favorisce.
Nove in cima: Il ting ha anelli di giada. Gran buona fortuna. Nulla che non favorisca.

51.judgment_zh: 亨。震來虩虩，笑言啞啞。震驚百里，不喪匕鬯。
51.judgment_en: Success. Thunder comes—Loss! Loss! Laughing words—Loss! Loss! Thunder terrifies for a hundred miles, and he does not let fall the sacrificial spoon and chalice.
51.commentary_desc: When one's resting is like that of the back, and he loses all consciousness of self; when he walks in his courtyard, and does not see any (of the persons) in it,-there will be no error.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject keeping his toes at rest. There will be no error; but it will be advantageous for him to be persistently firm and correct.
The second six, divided, shows its subject keeping the calves of his legs at rest. He cannot help (the subject of the line. above) whom he follows, and is dissatisfied in his mind.
The third nine, undivided, shows its subject keeping his loins at rest, and separating the ribs (from the body below). The situation is perilous, and the heart glows with suppressed excitement.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject keeping his trunk at rest. There will be no error.
The fifth six, divided, shows its Subject keeping his jawbones at rest, sb that his words are (all) orderly. Occasion for repentance will disappear.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows its subject devotedly maintaining his restfulness. There will be good fortune.

image.image_zh: 洊雷震。君子以恐懼修省。
image.image_en: Thunder repeated: The image of Shock. Thus in fear and trembling the superior man sets his life in order and examines himself.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El trueno se repite: La imagen del Trueno. Así el hombre superior en su temor se pone en guardia y se examina.
image.image_it: Il tuono si ripete: L'immagine del Tuono. Così l'uomo superiore nel suo timore si mette in guardia e si esamina.

lines_zh: 初九：震來虩虩，後笑言啞啞，吉。
六二：震來厲，億喪貝，躋于九陵，勿逐，七日得。
六三：震蘇蘇，震行無眚。
九四：震遂泥。
六五：震往來厲，億無喪有事。
上六：震索索，視矍矍，征凶。震不于其躬，于其鄰，無咎。婚媾有言。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Shock comes-oh, oh! Then follow laughing words-ha, ha! Good fortune.

Six in the second place: Shock comes bringing danger. A hundred thousand times you lose your treasures and must climb the nine hills. Do not go in pursuit of them. After seven days you will get them back again.
Six in the third place: Shock comes and makes one distraught. If shock spurs to action one remains free of misfortune.
Nine in the fourth place: Shock is bogged down.
Six in the fifth place: Shock goes hither and thither. Danger. However, nothing at all is lost. Yet there are things to be done.

Six at the top: Shock brings ruin and terrified gazing around. Going ahead brings misfortune. If it has not yet touched one's own body but has reached one's neighbor first, there is no blame. One's comrades have something to talk about.
51.judgment_es: Éxito. Viene el trueno —¡Pérdida! ¡Pérdida! Palabras riendo —¡Pérdida! ¡Pérdida! El trueno aterroriza por cien millas, y él no deja caer la cuchara y el cáliz sacrificiales.
51.judgment_it: Successo. Arriva il tuono —Perdita! Perdita! Parole ridendo —Perdita! Perdita! Il tuono terrorizza per cento miglia, e egli non lascia cadere il cucchiaio e il calice sacrificale.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Viene el shock —¡oh, oh! Luego siguen palabras riendo —¡ja, ja! Buena fortuna.
Seis en el segundo lugar: El shock viene trayendo peligro. Cien mil veces pierdes tus tesoros y debes subir las nueve colinas. No vayas en su búsqueda. Después de siete días los recuperarás.
Seis en el tercer lugar: El shock viene y vuelve a uno distraught. Si el shock estimula a la acción uno permanece libre de desgracia.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: El shock está atascado.
Seis en el quinto lugar: El shock va de acá para allá. Peligro. Sin embargo, nada en absoluto se pierde. Aún así hay cosas que hacer.

Seis en lo alto: El shock trae ruina y miradas aterrorizadas alrededor. Ir adelante trae desgracia. Si aún no ha tocado el propio cuerpo pero ha alcanzado primero al vecino, no hay culpa. Los compañeros tienen algo de qué hablar.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Arriva lo shock —oh, oh! Poi seguono parole ridendo —ha, ha! Buona fortuna.
Sei al secondo posto: Lo shock arriva portando pericolo. Centomila volte perdi i tuoi tesori e devi salire le nove colline. Non andare in loro ricerca. Dopo sette giorni li recupererai.
Sei al terzo posto: Lo shock arriva e rende uno distrutto. Se lo shock stimola all'azione uno rimane libero da sventura.
Nove al quarto posto: Lo shock è bloccato.
Sei al quinto posto: Lo shock va di qua e di là. Pericolo. Tuttavia, nulla affatto si perde. Eppure ci sono cose da fare.

Sei in cima: Lo shock porta rovina e sguardi terrorizzati intorno. Andare avanti porta sventura. Se non ha ancora toccato il proprio corpo ma ha raggiunto prima il vicino, non c'è colpa. I compagni hanno qualcosa di cui parlare.

52.judgment_zh: 艮其背，不獲其身，行其庭，不見其人，無咎。
52.judgment_en: Keeping his back still so that he no longer feels his body. He goes into his courtyard and does not see his people. No blame.
52.commentary_desc: Cheng gives the intimation of ease and development. When (the time of) movement (which it indicates) comes, (the subject of the hexagram) will be found looking out with apprehension, and yet smiling and talking cheerfully. When the movement (like a crash of thunder) terrifies all within a hundred li, he will be (like the sincere worshipper) who is not (startled into) letting go his ladle and (cup of) sacrificial spirits.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject, when the movement approaches, looking out and around with apprehension, and afterwards smiling and talking cheerfully. There will be good fortune.

The second six, divided, shows its subject, when the movement approaches, in a position of peril. He judges it better to let go the articles (in his possession), and to ascend a very lofty height. There is no occasion for him to pursue after (the things he has let go); in seven days he will find them.
The third six, divided, shows its subject distraught amid the startling movements going on. If those movements excite him to (right) action, there will be no mistake.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject, amid the startling movements, supinely sinking (deeper) in the mud.

The fifth six, divided, shows its subject going and coming amidst the startling movements (of the time), and always in peril; but perhaps he will not incur loss, and find business (which he can accomplish).

The topmost six, divided, shows its subject, amidst the startling movements (of the time), in breathless dismay and looking round him with trembling apprehension. If he take action, there will be evil. If, while the startling movements have not reached his own person and his neighborhood, (he were to take precautions), there would be no error, though his relatives might (still) speak against him.

image.image_zh: 兼山艮。君子以思不出其位。
image.image_en: Mountains standing close together: The image of Keeping Still. Thus the superior man does not permit his thoughts to go beyond his situation.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: La montaña se mantiene quieta: La imagen de la Inmovilidad. Así el hombre superior no piensa en ir más allá de su posición.
image.image_it: La montagna rimane ferma: L'immagine dell'Immobilità. Così l'uomo superiore non pensa di andare oltre la sua posizione.

lines_zh: 初六：艮其趾，無咎，利永貞。
六二：艮其腓，不拯其隨，其心不快。
九三：艮其限，列其夤，厲薰心。
六四：艮其身，無咎。
六五：艮其輔，言有序，悔亡。
上九：敦艮，吉。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: Keeping his toes still. No blame. Continued perseverance furthers.
Six in the second place: Keeping his calves still. He cannot rescue him whom he follows. His heart is not glad.
Nine in the third place: Keeping his hips still. Making his sacrum stiff. Dangerous. The heart suffocates.
Six in the fourth place: Keeping his trunk still. No blame.
Six in the fifth place: Keeping his jaws still. The words have order. Remorse disappears.
Nine at the top: Noblehearted keeping still. Good fortune.
52.judgment_es: Manteniendo su espalda quieta de modo que ya no siente su cuerpo. Él entra en su patio y no ve a su gente. Sin culpa.
52.judgment_it: Tenendo la sua schiena ferma in modo che non senta più il suo corpo. Egli entra nel suo cortile e non vede la sua gente. Nessuna colpa.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Manteniendo sus dedos de los pies quietos. Sin culpa. Continuada perseverancia favorece.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Manteniendo sus pantorrillas quietas. No puede rescatar a quien sigue. Su corazón no está alegre.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Manteniendo sus caderas quietas. Haciendo su sacro rígido. Peligrooso. El corazón se ahoga.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Manteniendo su tronco quieto. Sin culpa.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Manteniendo sus mandíbulas quietas. Las palabras tienen orden. El remordimiento desaparece.
Nueve en lo alto: Manteniendo quieto de corazón noble. Buena fortuna.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Tenendo le dita dei piedi ferme. Nessuna colpa. Continuata perseveranza favorisce.
Sei al secondo posto: Tenendo i polpacci fermi. Non può salvare chi segue. Il suo cuore non è allegro.
Nove al terzo posto: Tenendo i fianchi fermi. Rendendo il sacro rigido. Pericoloso. Il cuore soffoca.
Sei al quarto posto: Tenendo il tronco fermo. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al quinto posto: Tenendo le mascelle ferme. Le parole hanno ordine. Il rimorso svanisce.
Nove in cima: Tenendo fermo di cuore nobile. Buona fortuna.

53.judgment_en: The maiden is given in marriage. Good fortune. Perseverance furthers.
53.commentary_desc: Sui indicates that (under its conditions) there will be great progress and success. But it will be advantageous to be firm and correct. There will (then) be no error.,
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows us one changing the object of his pursuit; but if he be firm and correct, there will be good fortune. Going beyond (his own) gate to find associates, he will achieve merit.
The second six, divided, shows us one who cleaves to the little boy, and lets go the man of age and experience.

The third six, divided, shows us one who cleaves to the man of age and experience, and lets go the little boy. Such following will get what it seeks; but it will be advantageous to adhere to what is firm and correct.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows us one followed and obtaining (adherents). Though he be firm and correct, there will be evil. If he be sincere (however) in his course, and make that evident, into what error will he fall?
