The fifth nine, undivided, shows us (the ruler) sincere in (fostering all) that is excellent. There will be good fortune.
The topmost six, divided, shows us (that sincerity) firmly held and clung to, yea, and bound fast. (We see) the king with it presenting his offerings on the western mountain.

image.image_zh: 山上有木，漸。君子以居賢德善俗。
image.image_en: On the mountain, a tree: The image of Development. Thus the superior man abides in dignity and virtue, in order to improve the mores.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Sobre la montaña hay un árbol: La imagen del Desarrollo. Así el hombre superior vive una vida virtuosa y mejora sus modales.
image.image_it: Sulla montagna c'è un albero: L'immagine dello Sviluppo. Così l'uomo superiore vive una vita virtuosa e migliora i suoi modi.

lines_zh: 初六：鴻漸于干，小子厲，有言，無咎。
六二：鴻漸于磐，飲食衎衎，吉。
九三：鴻漸于陸，夫征不復，婦孕不育，凶。利禦寇。
六四：鴻漸于木，或得其桷，無咎。
九五：鴻漸于陵，婦三歲不孕，終莫之勝，吉。
上九：鴻漸于陸，其羽可用為儀，吉。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: The wild goose gradually draws near the shore. The young son is in danger. There is talk. No blame.
Six in the second place: The wild goose gradually draws near the cliff. Eating and drinking in peace and concord. Good fortune.

Nine in the third place: The wild goose gradually draws near the plateau. The man goes forth and does not return. The woman carries a child but does not bring it forth. Misfortune. It furthers one to fight off robbers.
Six in the fourth place: The wild goose gradually draws near the tree. Perhaps it will find a flat branch. No blame.
Nine in the fifth place: The wild goose gradually draws near the summit. For three years the woman has no child. In the end nothing can hinder her. Good fortune.
Nine at the top: The wild goose gradually draws near the cloud heights. Its feathers can be used for the sacred dance. Good fortune.
53.judgment_es: La doncella es dada en matrimonio. Buena fortuna. La perseverancia favorece.
53.judgment_it: La fanciulla è data in matrimonio. Buona fortuna. La perseveranza favorisce.
lines_es: Seis al principio: El ganso silvestre se acerca gradualmente a la orilla. El hijo joven está en peligro. Hay charla. Sin culpa.
Seis en el segundo lugar: El ganso silvestre se acerca gradualmente al acantilado. Comiendo y bebiendo en paz y concordia. Buena fortuna.

Nueve en el tercer lugar: El ganso silvestre se acerca gradualmente a la meseta. El hombre sale y no regresa. La mujer lleva un niño pero no lo trae al mundo. Desgracia. Favorece al hombre combatir ladrones.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: El ganso silvestre se acerca gradualmente al árbol. Quizás encontrará una rama plana. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: El ganso silvestre se acerca gradualmente a la cumbre. Por tres años la mujer no tiene hijo. Al final nada puede impedirla. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: El ganso silvestre se acerca gradualmente a las alturas de las nubes. Sus plumas pueden usarse para la danza sagrada. Buena fortuna.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: L'oca selvatica si avvicina gradualmente alla riva. Il figlio giovane è in pericolo. C'è chiacchiericcio. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al secondo posto: L'oca selvatica si avvicina gradualmente alla scogliera. Mangiando e bevendo in pace e concordia. Buona fortuna.

Nove al terzo posto: L'oca selvatica si avvicina gradualmente all'altopiano. L'uomo esce e non ritorna. La donna porta un bambino ma non lo porta al mondo. Sventura. È favorevole all'uomo combattere ladri.
Sei al quarto posto: L'oca selvatica si avvicina gradualmente all'albero. Forse troverà un ramo piatto. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al quinto posto: L'oca selvatica si avvicina gradualmente alla cima. Per tre anni la donna non ha figli. Alla fine nulla può impedirle. Buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: L'oca selvatica si avvicina gradualmente alle altezze delle nuvole. Le sue piume possono essere usate per la danza sacra. Buona fortuna.

54.judgment_en: Undertakings bring misfortune. Nothing that would further.
54.commentary_desc: Ku indicates great progress and success (to him who deals properly with the condition represented by it). There will be advantage in (efforts like that of) crossing the great stream. (He should weigh well, however, the events of) three days before the turning point, and those (to be done) three days after it.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows (a son) dealing, with the troubles caused by his father. If he be an (able) son, the father will escape the blame of having erred. The position is perilous, but there will be good fortune in the end.
The second nine, undivided, shows (a son) dealing with the troubles caused by his mother. He should not (carry) his firm correctness (to the utmost).
The third nine, undivided, shows (a son) dealing with the troubles caused by his father. There may be some small occasion for repentance, but there will not be any great error.
The fourth six, divided, shows (a son) viewing indulgently the troubles caused by his father. If he go forward, he will find cause to regret it.
The fifth six, divided, shows (a son) dealing with the troubles caused by his father. He obtains the praise of using (the fit instrument for his work).
The sixth nine, undivided, shows us one who does not serve either king or feudal lord, but in a lofty spirit prefers (to attend to) his own affairs.

image.image_zh: 澤上有雷，歸妹。君子以永終知敝。
image.image_en: Thunder over the lake: The image of the Marrying Maiden. Thus the superior man understands the transitory in the light of the eternity of the end.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El trueno sobre el lago: La imagen de la Muchacha que se Casa. Así el hombre superior entiende lo transitorio y lo permanente.
image.image_it: Il tuono sul lago: L'immagine della Fanciulla che si Sposa. Così l'uomo superiore comprende il transitorio e il permanente.

lines_zh: 初九：歸妹以娣，跛能履，征吉。
九二：眇能視，利幽人之貞。
六三：歸妹以須，反歸以娣。
九四：歸妹愆期，遲歸有時。
六五：帝乙歸妹，其君之袂，不如其娣之袂良，月幾望，吉。
上六：女承筐無實，士刲羊無血，無攸利。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: The marrying maiden as a concubine. A lame man who is able to tread. Undertakings bring good fortune.
Nine in the second place: A one-eyed man who is able to see. The perseverance of a dark man brings good fortune.
Six in the third place: The marrying maiden as a slave. She marries as a concubine.
Nine in the fourth place: The marrying maiden draws out the allotted time. A late marriage comes in due course.

Six in the fifth place: The sovereign I gave his daughter in marriage. The embroidered garments of the princess were not as gorgeous as those of the servingmaid. The moon that is nearly full brings good fortune.
Six at the top: The woman holds the basket, but there are no fruits in it. The man stabs the sheep, but no blood flows. Nothing that acts to further.
54.judgment_es: Las empresas traen desgracia. Nada que favoreciera.
54.judgment_it: Le imprese portano sventura. Nulla che favorisca.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: La doncella que se casa como concubina. Un hombre cojo que es capaz de pisar. Las empresas traen buena fortuna.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Un hombre tuerto que es capaz de ver. La perseverancia de un hombre oscuro trae buena fortuna.
Seis en el tercer lugar: La doncella que se casa como esclava. Ella se casa como concubina.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: La doncella que se casa prolonga el tiempo asignado. Un matrimonio tardío llega a su debido tiempo.
Seis en el quinto lugar: El soberano Yo dio su hija en matrimonio. Las vestiduras bordadas de la princesa no eran tan hermosas como las de la criada. La luna que está casi llena trae buena fortuna.
Seis en lo alto: La mujer sostiene la canasta, pero no hay frutos en ella. El hombre apuñala la oveja, pero no fluye sangre. Nada que actúe para favorecer.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: La fanciulla che si sposa come concubina. Un uomo zoppo che è capace di pestare. Le imprese portano buona fortuna.
Nove al secondo posto: Un uomo guercio che è capace di vedere. La perseveranza di un uomo oscuro porta buona fortuna.
Sei al terzo posto: La fanciulla che si sposa come schiava. Lei si sposa come concubina.
Nove al quarto posto: La fanciulla che si sposa prolunga il tempo assegnato. Un matrimonio tardivo arriva al momento dovuto.

Sei al quinto posto: Il sovrano Io diede sua figlia in matrimonio. I vestiti ricamati della principessa non erano così bellissimi come quelli della cameriera. La luna che è quasi piena porta buona fortuna.
Sei in cima: La donna tiene il cestino, ma non ci sono frutti in esso. L'uomo pugnala la pecora, ma non scorre sangue. Nulla che agisca per favorire.

55.judgment_en: Success. The king attains abundance. Be not sad. Be like the sun at midday.
55.commentary_desc: Pi indicates that there should be free course (in what it denotes). There will be little advantage (however) if it be allowed to advance (and take the lead).
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows one adorning (the way of) his feet. He can discard a carriage and walk on foot.
The second six, divided, shows one adorning his beard.
The third nine, undivided, shows its subject with the appearance of being adorned and bedewed (with rich favors). But let him ever maintain his firm correctness, and there will be good fortune.

The fourth six, divided, shows one looking as if adorned, but only in white. As if (mounted on) a white horse, and furnished with wings, (he seeks union with the subject of the first line), while (the intervening third pursues), not as a robber, but intent on a matrimonial alliance.

The fifth six, divided, shows its subject adorned by (the occupants oo the heights and gardens. He bears his roll of silk, small and slight. He may appear stingy; but there will be good fortune in the end.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows one with white as his (only) ornament. There will be no error.

image.image_zh: 雷電皆至，豐。君子以折獄致刑。
image.image_en: Both thunder and lightning come: The image of Abundance. Thus the superior man decides lawsuits and carries out punishments.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El truero y el relámpago: La imagen de la Abundancia. Así el hombre superior decide los litigios y ejecuta las penas.
image.image_it: Il tuono e il fulmine: L'immagine dell'Abbondanza. Così l'uomo superiore decide le liti ed esegue le pene.

lines_zh: 初九：遇其配主，雖旬無咎，往有尚。
六二：豐其蔀，日中見斗，往得疑疾，有孚發若，吉。
九三：豐其沛，日中見沬，折其右肱，無咎。
九四：豐其蔀，日中見斗，遇其夷主，吉。
六五：來章，有慶譽，吉。
上六：豐其屋，蔀其家，闚其戶，闃其無人，三歲不覿，凶。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: When a man meets his destined ruler, they can be together ten days, and it is not a mistake. Going meets with recognition.
Six in the second place: The curtain is of such fullness that the polestars can be seen at noon. Through going one meets with mistrust and hate. If one rouses him through truth, good fortune comes.
Nine in the third place: The underbrush is of such abundance that the small stars can be seen at noon. He breaks his right arm. No blame.
Nine in the fourth place: The curtain is of such fullness that the polestars can be seen at noon. He meets his ruler, who is of like kind. Good fortune.
Six in the fifth place: Lines are coming, blessing and fame draw near. Good fortune.
Six at the top: His house is in a state of abundance. He screens off his family. He peers through the gate and no longer perceives anyone. For three years he sees nothing. Misfortune.
55.judgment_es: Éxito. El rey alcanza la abundancia. No estés triste. Sé como el sol al mediodía.
55.judgment_it: Successo. Il re raggiunge l'abbondanza. Non essere triste. Sii come il sole a mezzogiorno.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Cuando un hombre encuentra a su gobernante destinado, pueden estar juntos diez días, y no es un error. Ir encuentra reconocimiento.

Seis en el segundo lugar: La cortina es de tal plenitud que las estrellas polares pueden verse al mediodía. A través de ir uno encuentra desconfianza y odio. Si uno lo despierta a través de la verdad, viene la buena fortuna.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: La maleza es de tal abundancia que las estrellas pequeñas pueden verse al mediodía. Él rompe su brazo derecho. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: La cortina es de tal plenitud que las estrellas polares pueden verse al mediodía. Él encuentra a su gobernante, que es de su clase. Buena fortuna.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Las líneas vienen, la bendición y la fama se acercan. Buena fortuna.
Seis en lo alto: Su casa está en un estado de abundancia. Él protege a su familia. Mira a través de la puerta y ya no percibe a nadie. Por tres años no ve nada. Desgracia.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Quando un uomo incontra il suo governante destinato, possono stare insieme dieci giorni, e non è un errore. Andare incontra riconoscimento.

Sei al secondo posto: La tenda è di tale pienezza che le stelle polari possono essere viste a mezzogiorno. Attraverso l'andare uno incontra diffidenza e odio. Se uno lo sveglia attraverso la verità, viene la buona fortuna.
Nove al terzo posto: Il sottobosco è di tale abbondanza che le stelle piccole possono essere viste a mezzogiorno. Egli rompe il suo braccio destro. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al quarto posto: La tenda è di tale pienezza che le stelle polari possono essere viste a mezzogiorno. Egli incontra il suo governante, che è della sua specie. Buona fortuna.
Sei al quinto posto: Le linee vengono, la benedizione e la fama si avvicinano. Buona fortuna.
Sei in cima: La sua casa è in uno stato di abbondanza. Egli protegge la sua famiglia. Guarda attraverso la porta e non percepisce più nessuno. Per tre anni non vede nulla. Sventura.

56.judgment_en: Success through smallness. Perseverance brings good fortune to the wanderer.
56.commentary_desc: Shih Ho indicates successful progress (in the condition of things which it supposes). It will be advantageous to use legal constraints.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows one with his feet in the stocks and deprived of his toes. There will be no error.
The second six, divided, shows one biting through the soft flesh, and (going on to) bite off the nose. There will be no error.
The third six, divided, shows one gnawing dried flesh, and meeting with what is disagreeable. There will be occasion for some small regret, but no (great) error.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows one gnawing the flesh dried on the bone, and getting the pledges of money and arrows. It will be advantageous to him to realize the difficulty of his task and be firm, in which case there will be good fortune.
The fifth six, divided, shows one gnawing at dried flesh, and finding the yellow gold. Let him be firm and correct, realizing the peril (of his position). There will be no error.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows one wearing the cangue, and deprived of his ears. There will be evil.

image.image_zh: 山上有火，旅。君子以明慎用刑而不留獄。
image.image_en: Fire on the mountain: The image of the Wanderer. Thus the superior man is clear-minded and cautious in imposing penalties, and protracts no lawsuits.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El fuego sobre la montaña: La imagen del Viajero. Así el hombre superior es claro en sus decisiones y cauteloso en el uso de las penas.
image.image_it: Il fuoco sulla montagna: L'immagine del Viaggiatore. Così l'uomo superiore è chiaro nelle sue decisioni e cauto nell'uso delle pene.

lines_zh: 初六：旅瑣瑣，斯其所取災。
六二：旅即次，懷其資，得童僕貞。
九三：旅焚其次，喪其童僕，貞厲。
九四：旅于處，得其資斧，我心不快。
六五：射雉一矢亡，終以譽命。
上九：鳥焚其巢，旅人先笑後號咷，喪牛于易，凶。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: If the wanderer busies himself with trivial things, he draws down misfortune upon himself.
Six in the second place: The wanderer comes to an inn. He has his property with him. He wins the steadfastness of a young servant.
Nine in the third place: The wanderer's inn burns down. He loses the steadfastness of his young servant. Danger.
Nine in the fourth place: The wanderer rests in a shelter. He obtains his property and an ax. My heart is not glad.
Six in the fifth place: He shoots a pheasant. It drops with the first arrow. In the end this brings both praise and office.
Nine at the top: The bird's nest burns up. The wanderer laughs at first, then must needs lament and weep. Through carelessness he loses his cow. Misfortune.
56.judgment_es: Éxito a través de la pequeñez. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna al caminante.
56.judgment_it: Successo attraverso la piccolezza. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna al viandante.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Si el caminante se ocupa de cosas triviales, atrae la desgracia sobre sí mismo.
Seis en el segundo lugar: El caminante llega a una posada. Tiene sus pertenencias con él. Gana la constancia de un joven sirviente.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: La posada del caminante se quema. Pierde la constancia de su joven sirviente. Peligro.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: El caminante descansa en un refugio. Obtiene sus pertenencias y un hacha. Mi corazón no está alegre.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Él dispara a un faisán. Caé con la primera flecha. Al final esto trae tanto alabanza como oficio.
Nueve en lo alto: El nido del pájaro se quema. El caminante ríe primero, luego debe lamentarse y llorar. A través de la descuido pierde su vaca. Desgracia.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Se il viandante si occupa di cose banali, attira la sventura su sé stesso.
Sei al secondo posto: Il viandante arriva a una locanda. Ha i suoi averi con sé. Vince la costanza di un giovane servitore.
Nove al terzo posto: La locanda del viandante brucia. Perde la costanza del suo giovane servitore. Pericolo.
Nove al quarto posto: Il viandante riposa in un rifugio. Ottiene i suoi averi e un'ascia. Il mio cuore non è allegro.
Sei al quinto posto: Egli spara a un fagiano. Cade con la prima freccia. Alla fine questo porta sia lode che carica.
Nove in cima: Il nido dell'uccello brucia. Il viandante ride prima, poi deve lamentarsi e piangere. Attraverso la trascuratezza perde la sua mucca. Sventura.

57.judgment_en: Success through what is small. It furthers one to have somewhere to go. It furthers one to see the great man.
57.commentary_desc: Tui intimates that (under its conditions) there will be progress and attainment. (But) it will be advantageous to be firm and correct.,
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows the pleasure of (inward) harmony. There will be good fortune.
The second nine, undivided, shows the pleasure arising from (inward) sincerity. There will be good fortune. Occasion for repentance will disappear.
The third six, divided, shows its subject bringing round himself whatever can give pleasure. There will be evil.
The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject deliberating about what to seek his pleasure in, and not at rest. He borders on what would be injurious, but there will be cause for joy.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject trusting in one who would injure him. The situation is perilous.
The topmost six, divided, shows the pleasure of its subject in leading and attracting others.

image.image_zh: 隨風巽。君子以申命行事。
image.image_en: Winds following one upon the other: The image of the Gently Penetrating. Thus the superior man spreads his commands abroad and carries out his undertakings.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: Sobre el lago, el viento: La imagen de lo Suave. Así el hombre superior difunde sus instrucciones y ejecuta sus asuntos.
image.image_it: Sul lago, il vento: L'immagine del Suave. Così l'uomo superiore diffonde le sue istruzioni ed esegue i suoi affari.

lines_zh: 初六：進退，利武人之貞。
九二：巽在床下，用史巫紛若，吉，無咎。
九三：頻巽，吝。
六四：悔亡，田獲三品。
九五：貞吉，悔亡，無不利，無初有終。先庚三日，後庚三日，吉。
上九：巽在床下，喪其資斧，貞凶。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: In advancing and in retreating, the perseverance of a warrior furthers.
Nine in the second place: Penetration under the bed. Priests and magicians are used in great number. Good fortune. No blame.
Nine in the third place: Repeated penetration. Humiliation.
Six in the fourth place: Remorse disappears. During the hunt three kinds of game are caught.

Nine in the fifth place: Perseverance brings good fortune. Remorse disappears. Nothing that does not further. No beginning, but an end. Before the change, three days. After the change, three days. Good fortune.
Nine at the top: Penetration under the bed. He loses his property and his ax. Perseverance brings misfortune.
57.judgment_es: Éxito a través de lo que es pequeño. Favorece al hombre tener adónde ir. Favorece al hombre ver al gran hombre.
57.judgment_it: Successo attraverso ciò che è piccolo. È favorevole all'uomo avere dove andare. È favorevole all'uomo vedere il grande uomo.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Al avanzar y al retroceder, la perseverancia de un guerrero favorece.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Penetración bajo la cama. Sacerdotes y magos son usados en gran número. Buena fortuna. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Penetración repetida. Humillación.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: El remordimiento desaparece. Durante la caza se capturan tres tipos de presa.

Nueve en el quinto lugar: La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. El remordimiento desaparece. Nada que no favoreciera. No hay comienzo, pero un fin. Antes del cambio, tres días. Después del cambio, tres días. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: Penetración bajo la cama. Pierde sus pertenencias y su hacha. La perseverancia trae desgracia.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Nell'avanzare e nel retrocedere, la perseveranza di un guerriero favorisce.
Nove al secondo posto: Penetrazione sotto il letto. Sacerdoti e maghi sono usati in gran numero. Buona fortuna. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al terzo posto: Penetrazione ripetuta. Umiliazione.
Sei al quarto posto: Il rimorso svanisce. Durante la caccia si catturano tre tipi di preda.

Nove al quinto posto: La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Il rimorso svanisce. Nulla che non favorisca. Non c'è inizio, ma una fine. Prima del cambiamento, tre giorni. Dopo il cambiamento, tre giorni. Buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: Penetrazione sotto il letto. Perde i suoi averi e la sua ascia. La perseveranza porta sventura.

58.commentary_desc: Sun intimates that (under the conditions which it denotes) there will be some little attainment and progress. There will be advantage in movement onward in whatever direction. It will be advantageous (also) to see the great man.,
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject (now) advancing, (now) receding. It would be advantageous for him to have the firm correctness of a brave soldier.
The second nine, undivided, shows the representative of Sun beneath a couch, and employing diviners and exorcists in a way bordering on confusion. There will be good fortune and no error.
The third nine, undivided, shows its subject penetrating (only) by violent and repeated efforts. There will be occasion for regret.
The fourth six, divided, shows all occasion for repentance (in its subject) passed away. He takes game for its threefold use in his hunting.

The fifth nine, undivided, shows that with firm correctness there will be good fortune (to its subject). All occasion for repentance will disappear, and all his movements will be advantageous. There may have been no (good) beginning, but there will be a (good) end. Three days before making any changes, (let him give notice of them); and three days after, (let him reconsider them). There will (thus) be good fortune.

The sixth nine, undivided, shows the representative of penetration beneath a couch, and having lost the axe with which he executed his decisions. However firm and correct he may (try to) be, there will be evil.

image.image_zh: 麗澤兌。君子以朋友講習。
image.image_en: Lakes resting one on the other: The image of the Joyous. Thus the superior man joins with his friends for discussion and practice.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El lago sobre el lago: La imagen de lo Sereno. Así el hombre superior examina a los demás y fortalece su unión.
image.image_it: Il lago sul lago: L'immagine della Serenità. Così l'uomo superiore esamina gli altri e rafforza la loro unione.

lines_zh: 初九：和兌，吉。
九二：孚兌，吉，悔亡。
六三：來兌，凶。
九四：商兌未寧，介疾有喜。
九五：孚于剝，有厲。
上六：引兌。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Contented joyousness. Good fortune.
Nine in the second place: Sincere joyousness. Good fortune. Remorse disappears.
Six in the third place: Coming joyousness. Misfortune.
Nine in the fourth place: Joyousness that is weighed is not at peace. After ridding oneself of mistakes a man has joy.
Nine in the fifth place: Sincerity toward disintegrating influences is dangerous.
Six at the top: Seductive joyousness.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Alegría contenta. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Alegría sincera. Buena fortuna. El remordimiento desaparece.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Alegría venidera. Desgracia.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Alegría que es ponderada no está en paz. Después de librarse de errores un hombre tiene alegría.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Sinceridad hacia influencias disgregantes es peligrosa.
Seis en lo alto: Alegría seductora.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Gioia contenta. Buona fortuna.
Nove al secondo posto: Gioia sincera. Buona fortuna. Il rimorso svanisce.
Sei al terzo posto: Gioia veniente. Sventura.
Nove al quarto posto: Gioia che è ponderata non è in pace. Dopo essersi liberato di errori un uomo ha gioia.
Nove al quinto posto: Sincerità verso influenze disgreganti è pericolosa.
Sei in cima: Gioia seducente.

59.judgment_zh: 亨。王假有廟，利涉大川，利貞。
59.judgment_en: Success. The king approaches his temple. It furthers one to cross the great water. Perseverance furthers.
59.commentary_desc: In (the condition denoted by) Khwan there may (yet be) progress and success. For the firm and correct, the (really) great man, there will be good fortune. He will fall into no error. If he make speeches, his words cannot be made good.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject with bare buttocks straitened under the stump of a tree. He enters a dark valley, and for three years has no prospect (of deliverance).

The second nine, undivided, shows its subject straitened amidst his wine and viands. There come to him anon the red knee-covers (of the ruler). It will be well for him (to maintain his sincerity as) in sacrificing. Active operations (on his part) will lead to evil, but he will be free from blame.
The third six, divided, shows its subject straitened before a (frowning) rock. He lays hold of thorns. He enters his palace, and does not see his wife. There will be evil.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject proceeding very slowly (to help the subject of the first line), who is straitened by the carriage adorned with metal in front of him. There will be occasion for regret, but the end will be good.

The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject with his nose and feet cut off. He is straitened by (his ministers in their) scarlet aprons. He is leisurely in his movements, however, and is satisfied. It will be well for him to be (as sincere) as in sacrificing (to spiritual beings).

The sixth six, divided, shows its subject straitened, as if bound with creepers; or in a high and dangerous position, and saying (to himself), 'If I move, I shall repent it.' If he do repent of former errors, there will be good fortune in his going forward.

image.image_zh: 風行水上，渙。先王以享于帝立廟。
image.image_en: The wind drives over the water: The image of Dispersion. Thus the kings of old sacrificed to the Lord and built temples.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El viento sobre el agua: La imagen de la Dispersión. Así el hombre superior ofrece sacrificio a Dios para establecer su voluntad.
image.image_it: Il vento sull'acqua: L'immagine della Dispersione. Così l'uomo superiore offre sacrificio a Dio per stabilire la sua volontà.

lines_zh: 初六：用拯馬壯，吉。
九二：渙奔其機，悔亡。
六三：渙其躬，無悔。
六四：渙其群，元吉。渙有丘，匪夷所思。
九五：渙汗其大號，渙王居，無咎。
上九：渙其血，去逖出，無咎。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: He brings help with the strength of a horse. Good fortune.
Nine in the second place: At the dissolution, he hurries to that which supports him. Remorse disappears.
Six in the third place: He dissolves his self. No remorse.
Six in the fourth place: He dissolves his bond with his group. Supreme good fortune. Dispersion leads in turn to accumulation. This is something that ordinary men do not think of.
Nine in the fifth place: His loud cries are as dissolving as sweat. Dissolution! A king abides without blame.
Nine at the top: He dissolves his blood. Departing, keeping at a distance, going out, is without blame.
59.judgment_es: Éxito. El rey se acerca a su templo. Favorece al hombre cruzar la gran agua. La perseverancia favorece.
59.judgment_it: Successo. Il re si avvicina al suo tempio. È favorevole all'uomo attraversare la grande acqua. La perseveranza favorisce.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Él trae ayuda con la fuerza de un caballo. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: En la disolución, él se apresura a aquello que lo apoya. El remordimiento desaparece.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Él disuelve su yo. Sin remordimiento.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Él disuelve su vínculo con su grupo. Suprema buena fortuna. La dispersión conduce a su vez a la acumulación. Esto es algo que los hombres ordinarios no piensan.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Sus gritos fuertes son tan disolventes como el sudor. ¡Disolución! Un rey permanece sin culpa.
Nueve en lo alto: Él disuelve su sangre. Partir, manteniendo distancia, salir, es sin culpa.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Egli porta aiuto con la forza di un cavallo. Buona fortuna.
Nove al secondo posto: Nella dissoluzione, egli si affretta verso ciò che lo sostiene. Il rimorso svanisce.
Sei al terzo posto: Egli dissolve il suo sé. Nessun rimorso.
Sei al quarto posto: Egli dissolve il suo legame con il suo gruppo. Suprema buona fortuna. La dispersione conduce a sua volta all'accumulo. Questo è qualcosa che gli uomini ordinari non pensano.
Nove al quinto posto: Le sue grida forti sono tanto dissolventi quanto il sudore. Dissoluzione! Un re permane senza colpa.
Nove in cima: Egli dissolve il suo sangue. Partire, mantenendo distanza, uscire, è senza colpa.

60.judgment_en: Success. Galling limitation must not be persevered in.
60.commentary_desc: Hwan intimates that (under its conditions) there will be progress and success. The king goes to his ancestral temple; and it will be advantageous to cross the great stream. It will be advantageous to be firm and correct.,
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject engaged in rescuing (from the impending evil) and having (the assistance of) a strong horse. There will be good fortune.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject, amid the dispersion, hurrying to his contrivance (for security). All occasion for repentance will disappear.
The third six, divided, shows its subject discarding any regard to his own person. There will be no occasion for repentance.

The fourth six, divided, shows its subject scattering the (different) parties (in the state); which leads to great good fortune. From the dispersion (he collects again good men standing out, a crowd) like a mound, which is what ordinary men would not have thought of

The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject amidst the dispersion issuing his great announcements as the perspiration (flows from his body). He scatters abroad (also) the accumulations in the royal granaries. There will be no error.
The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject disposing of (what may be called) its bloody wounds, and going and separating himself from its anxious fears. There will be no error.

image.image_zh: 澤上有水，節。君子以制數度，議德行。
image.image_en: Water over lake: The image of Limitation. Thus the superior man creates number and measure, and examines the nature of virtue and correct conduct.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El agua sobre el lago: La imagen de la Limitación. Así el hombre superior establece medidas y números, y discute la conducta virtuosa.
image.image_it: L'acqua sul lago: L'immagine della Limitazione. Così l'uomo superiore stabilisce misure e numeri, e discute la condotta virtuosa.

lines_zh: 初九：不出戶庭，無咎。
九二：不出門庭，凶。
六三：不節若，則嗟若，無咎。
六四：安節，亨。
九五：甘節，吉，往有尚。
上六：苦節，貞凶，悔亡。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Not going out of the door and the courtyard is without blame.
Nine in the second place: Not going out of the gate and the courtyard brings misfortune.
Six in the third place: He who knows no limitation will have cause to lament. No blame.
Six in the fourth place: Contented limitation. Success.
Nine in the fifth place: Sweet limitation brings good fortune. Going brings esteem.
Six at the top: Galling limitation. Perseverance brings misfortune. Remorse disappears.
60.judgment_es: Éxito. La limitación que irrita no debe ser perseverada.
60.judgment_it: Successo. La limitazione che irrita non deve essere perseverata.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: No salir de la puerta y el patio es sin culpa.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: No salir de la puerta y el patio trae desgracia.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Quien no conoce limitación tendrá causa para lamentarse. Sin culpa.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Limitación contenta. Éxito.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Limitación dulce trae buena fortuna. Ir trae estima.
Seis en lo alto: Limitación que irrita. La perseverancia trae desgracia. El remordimiento desaparece.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Non uscire dalla porta e dal cortile è senza colpa.
Nove al secondo posto: Non uscire dal cancello e dal cortile porta sventura.
Sei al terzo posto: Chi non conosce limitazione avrà causa per lamentarsi. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al quarto posto: Limitazione contenta. Successo.
Nove al quinto posto: Limitazione dolce porta buona fortuna. Andare porta stima.
Sei in cima: Limitazione che irrita. La perseveranza porta sventura. Il rimorso svanisce.

61.judgment_en: Pigs and fishes. Good fortune. It furthers one to cross the great water. Perseverance furthers.
61.commentary_desc: Kung Fu (moves even) pigs and fish, and leads to good fortune. There will be advantage in crossing the great stream. There will be advantage in being firm and correct.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, shows its subject resting (in himself). There will be good fortune. If he sought to any other, he would not find rest.

The second nine, undivided, shows its subject (like) the crane crying out in her hidden retirement, and her young ones responding to her. (It is as if it were said), ' I have a cup of good spirits,' (and the response were), 'I will partake of it with you.'
The third six, divided, shows its subject having met with his mate. Now he beats his drum, and now he leaves off. Now he weeps, and now he sings.
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject (like) the moon nearly full, and (like) a horse (in a chariot) whose fellow disappears. There will be no error.
The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject perfectly sincere, and linking (others) to him in closest union. There will be no error.
The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject in chanticleer (trying to) mount to heaven. Even with firm correctness there will be evil.

image.image_zh: 澤上有風，中孚。君子以議獄緩死。
image.image_en: Wind over lake: The image of Inner Truth. Thus the superior man discusses criminal cases in order to delay executions.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El viento sobre el lago: La imagen de la Verdad Interior. Así el hombre superior discute los casos penales y retrasa las ejecuciones.
image.image_it: Il vento sul lago: L'immagine della Verità Interiore. Così l'uomo superiore discute i casi penali e ritarda le esecuzioni.

lines_zh: 初九：虞吉，有它不燕。
九二：鳴鶴在陰，其子和之，我有好爵，吾與爾靡之。
六三：得敵，或鼓或罷，或泣或歌。
六四：月幾望，馬匹亡，無咎。
九五：有孚攣如，無咎。
上九：翰音登于天，貞凶。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: Being prepared brings good fortune. If there are secret designs, it is disquieting.
Nine in the second place: A crane calling in the shade. Its young answers it. I have a good goblet. I will share it with you.
Six in the third place: He finds a comrade. Now he beats the drum, now he stops. Now he sobs, now he sings.
Six in the fourth place: The moon is nearly full. The team horse goes astray. No blame.
Nine in the fifth place: He possesses truth, which links together. No blame.
Nine at the top: Cockcrow piercing to heaven. Perseverance brings misfortune.
61.judgment_es: Cerdos y peces. Buena fortuna. Favorece al hombre cruzar la gran agua. La perseverancia favorece.
61.judgment_it: Maiali e pesci. Buona fortuna. È favorevole all'uomo attraversare la grande acqua. La perseveranza favorisce.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Estar preparado trae buena fortuna. Si hay designios secretos, es inquietante.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Una grulla llamando en la sombra. Su cría le responde. Tengo una buena copa. La compartiré contigo.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Él encuentra un camarada. Ahora toca el tambor, ahora se detiene. Ahora solloza, ahora canta.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: La luna está casi llena. El caballo de tiro se extravía. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: Él posee verdad, que une. Sin culpa.
Nueve en lo alto: Canto de gallo perforando al cielo. La perseverancia trae desgracia.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Essere preparati porta buona fortuna. Se ci sono disegni segreti, è inquietante.
Nove al secondo posto: Una gru che chiama nell'ombra. Il suo piccolo le risponde. Ho una buona coppa. La condividerò con te.
Sei al terzo posto: Egli trova un camerata. Ora batte il tamburo, ora si ferma. Ora singhiozza, ora canta.
Sei al quarto posto: La luna è quasi piena. Il cavallo da tiro si smarrisce. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al quinto posto: Egli possiede verità, che unisce. Nessuna colpa.
Nove in cima: Canto di gallo che perfora il cielo. La perseveranza porta sventura.

62.judgment_zh: 亨，利貞，可小事，不可大事。飛鳥遺之音，不宜上宜下，大吉。
62.judgment_en: Success. Perseverance furthers. Small things may be done; great things should not be done. The flying bird brings the message: It is not well to strive upward, it is well to remain below. Great good fortune.
62.commentary_desc: I indicates that with firm correctness there will be good fortune (in what is denoted by it). We must look at what we are seeking to nourish, and by the exercise of our thoughts seek for the proper aliment.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, (seems to be thus addressed), 'You leave your efficacious tortoise, and look at me till your lower jaw hangs down.' There will be evil.
The second six, divided, shows one looking downwards for nourishment, which is contrary to what is proper; or seeking it from the height (above), advance towards which will lead to evil.

The third six, divided, shows one acting contrary to the method of nourishing. However firm he may be, there will be evil. For ten years let him not take any action, (for) it will not be in any way advantageous.

The fourth six, divided, shows one looking downwards for (the power to) nourish. There will be good fortune. Looking with a tiger's downward unwavering glare, and with his desire that impels him to spring after spring, he will fall into no error.
The fifth six, divided, shows one acting contrary to what is regular and proper; but if he abide in firmness, there will be good fortune. He should not, (however, try to) cross the great stream.
The sixth nine, undivided, shows him from whom comes the nourishing. His position is perilous, but there will be good fortune. It will be advantageous to cross the great stream.

image.image_zh: 山上有雷，小過。君子以行過乎恭，喪過乎哀，用過乎儉。
image.image_en: Thunder on the mountain: The image of Preponderance of the Small. Thus in his conduct the superior man gives preponderance to reverence. In bereavement he gives preponderance to grief. In his expenditures he gives preponderance to thrift.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El truero sobre la montaña: La imagen de la Preponderancia de lo Pequeño. Así el hombre superior es respetuoso en su conducta, está triste en su duelo, y usa economía en sus gastos.
image.image_it: Il tuono sulla montagna: L'immagine della Preponderanza del Piccolo. Così l'uomo superiore è rispettoso nella sua condotta, è triste nel suo lutto, e usa economia nei suoi spese.

lines_zh: 初六：飛鳥以凶。
六二：過其祖，遇其妣，不及其君，遇其臣，無咎。
九三：弗過防之，從或戕之，凶。
九四：無咎，弗過遇之，往厲必戒，勿用永貞。
六五：密雲不雨，自我西郊，公弋取彼在穴。
上六：弗遇過之，飛鳥離之，凶，是謂災眚。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: The flying bird brings itself misfortune.
Six in the second place: She passes by her ancestor and meets her ancestress. He does not reach his prince and meets the official. No blame.
Nine in the third place: If one is not extraordinarily careful, someone may come up from behind and strike him. Misfortune.
Nine in the fourth place: No blame. He meets him without passing by. Going brings danger. One must be on guard. Do not act. Be constantly persevering.
Six in the fifth place: Dense clouds, no rain from our western territory. The prince shoots and hits him who is in the cave.
Six at the top: He passes him by, not meeting him. The flying bird leaves him. Misfortune. This means bad luck and injury.
62.judgment_es: Éxito. La perseverancia favorece. Las cosas pequeñas pueden hacerse; las grandes no deben hacerse. El pájaro volador trae el mensaje: No es bueno esforzarse hacia arriba, es bueno permanecer abajo. Gran buena fortuna.
62.judgment_it: Successo. La perseveranza favorisce. Le cose piccole possono essere fatte; le grandi non devono essere fatte. L'uccello volante porta il messaggio: Non è bene sforzarsi verso l'alto, è bene rimanere in basso. Gran buona fortuna.
lines_es: Seis al principio: El pájaro volador trae desgracia sobre sí mismo.
Seis en el segundo lugar: Ella pasa por su ancestro y encuentra a su ancestria. Él no alcanza a su príncipe y encuentra al oficial. Sin culpa.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: Si uno no es extraordinariamente cuidadoso, alguien puede venir por detrás y golpearlo. Desgracia.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: Sin culpa. Lo encuentra sin pasar de largo. Ir trae peligro. Debe estar en guardia. No actúe. Sea constantemente perseverante.
Seis en el quinto lugar: Nubes densas, sin lluvia de nuestro territorio occidental. El príncipe dispara y acierta a quien está en la cueva.
Seis en lo alto: Él lo pasa de largo, sin encontrarlo. El pájaro volador lo deja. Desgracia. Esto significa mala suerte y lesión.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: L'uccello volante porta sventura su sé stesso.
Sei al secondo posto: Lei passa davanti al suo antenato e incontra la sua antenata. Egli non raggiunge il suo principe e incontra l'ufficiale. Nessuna colpa.
Nove al terzo posto: Se uno non è straordinariamente cauto, qualcuno può venire da dietro e colpirlo. Sventura.
Nove al quarto posto: Nessuna colpa. Lo incontra senza passare oltre. Andare porta pericolo. Deve stare in guardia. Non agire. Sii costantemente perseverante.
Sei al quinto posto: Nuvole fitte, senza pioggia dal nostro territorio occidentale. Il principe spara e colpisce chi è nella caverna.
Sei in cima: Egli lo passa oltre, senza incontrarlo. L'uccello volante lo lascia. Sventura. Questo significa sfortuna e ferita.

63.judgment_en: Success in small matters. Perseverance furthers. At the beginning good fortune. At the end disorder.
63.commentary_desc: Ki Chi intimates progress and success in small matters. There will be advantage in being firm and correct. There has been good fortune in the beginning; there may be disorder in the end.
commentary_reading: The first nine, undivided, (shows its subject as a driver) who drags back his wheel, (or as a fox) which has wet his tail. There will be no error.
The second six, divided, (shows its subject as) a wife who has lost her (carriage-)screen. There is no occasion to go in pursuit of it. In seven days she will find it.
The third nine, undivided, (suggests the case of) Kao Chung, who attacked the Demon region, but was three years in subduing it. Small men should not be employed (in such enterprises).
The fourth six, divided, shows its subject with rags provided against any leak (in his boat), and on his guard all day long.

The fifth nine, undivided, shows its subject (as) the neighbor in the east who slaughters an ox (for his sacrifice); but this is not equal to the (small) spring sacrifice of the neighbor in the west, whose sincerity receives the blessing.
The topmost six, divided, shows its subject with (even) his head immersed. The position is perilous.

image.image_zh: 水在火上，既濟。君子以思患而豫防之。
image.image_en: Water over fire: The image of the condition in After Completion. Thus the superior man takes thought of misfortune and arms himself against it in advance.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El agua sobre el fuego: La imagen del Después del Fin. Así el hombre superior toma precauciones contra la eventualidad.
image.image_it: L'acqua sul fuoco: L'immagine del Dopo la Fine. Così l'uomo superiore prende precauzioni contro l'eventualità.

tuan.tuan_zh: 既濟亨，小者亨也。利貞，剛柔正而位當也。初吉，柔得中也。終止則亂，其道窮也。
tuan.tuan_en: Ji Ji intimates progress and success in small matters. 'There will be advantage in being firm and correct' has been achieved indeed, and the weak (line) is in the centre. 'In the beginning there is good fortune' - the weak (line) is in the centre above. 'In the end' there is a cessation (of effort), and 'disorder arises' - the course (that led to rule and order) is now exhausted.
tuan.source: Tuan Zhuan (彖傳 - Commentary on the Decision), Zhou Yi (周易)

lines_zh: 初九：曳其輪，濡其尾，無咎。
六二：婦喪其茀，勿逐，七日得。
九三：高宗伐鬼方，三年克之，小人勿用。
六四：繻有衣袽，終日戒。
九五：東鄰殺牛，不如西鄰之禴祭，實受其福。
上六：濡其首，厲。
lines_en: Nine at the beginning: He brakes his wheels. He gets his tail in the water. No blame.
Six in the second place: The woman loses the curtain of her carriage. Do not run after it; on the seventh day you will get it.
Nine in the third place: The Illustrious Ancestor disciplines the Devil's Country. After three years he conquers it. Inferior people must not be employed.
Six in the fourth place: The finest clothes turn to rags. Be careful all day long.
Nine in the fifth place: The neighbor in the east who slaughters an ox does not attain as much real happiness as the neighbor in the west with his small offering.
Six at the top: He gets his head in the water. Danger.
63.judgment_es: Éxito en asuntos pequeños. La perseverancia favorece. Al principio buena fortuna. Al final desorden.
63.judgment_it: Successo in questioni piccole. La perseveranza favorisce. All'inizio buona fortuna. Alla fine disordine.
lines_es: Nueve al principio: Él frena sus ruedas. Mete su cola en el agua. Sin culpa.
Seis en el segundo lugar: La mujer pierde la cortina de su carruaje. No corras tras ella; al séptimo día la conseguirás.
Nueve en el tercer lugar: El Ancestro Ilustre disciplina al País del Diablo. Después de tres años lo conquista. No deben emplearse personas inferiores.
Seis en el cuarto lugar: Las ropas más finas se convierten en harapos. Ten cuidado todo el día.
Nueve en el quinto lugar: El vecino del este que sacrifica un buey no alcanza tanta felicidad real como el vecino del oeste con su pequeña ofrenda.
Seis en lo alto: Mete su cabeza en el agua. Peligro.
lines_it: Nove all'inizio: Egli frena le sue ruote. Mette la sua coda nell'acqua. Nessuna colpa.
Sei al secondo posto: La donna perde la tendina del suo carro. Non corrergli dietro; al settimo giorno la otterrai.
Nove al terzo posto: L'Antenato Illustre disciplina il Paese del Diavolo. Dopo tre anni lo conquista. Non devono essere impiegate persone inferiori.
Sei al quarto posto: I vestiti più fini si trasformano in stracci. Stai attento tutto il giorno.
Nove al quinto posto: Il vicino di est che sacrifica un bue non raggiunge tanta felicità reale quanto il vicino di ovest con la sua piccola offerta.
Sei in cima: Mette la testa nell'acqua. Pericolo.

64.judgment_zh: 亨，小狐汔濟，濡其尾，無攸利。
64.judgment_en: Success. But if the little fox, after nearly completing the crossing, gets his tail in the water, there is nothing that would further.
64.commentary_desc: Wei Chi intimates progress and success (in the circumstances which it implies). (We see) a young fox that has nearly crossed (the stream), when its tail gets immersed. There will be no advantage in any way.
commentary_reading: The first six, divided, shows its subject (like a fox) whose tail gets immersed. There will be occasion for regret.
The second nine, undivided, shows its subject dragging back his (carriage-)wheel. With firmness and correctness there will be good fortune.
The third six, divided, shows its subject, with (the state of things) not yet remedied, advancing on; which will lead to evil. But there will be advantage in (trying to) cross the great stream.

The fourth nine, undivided, shows its subject by firm correctness obtaining good fortune, so that all occasion for repentance disappears. Let him stir himself up, as if he were invading the Demon region, where for three years rewards will come to him (and his troops) from the great kingdom.

The fifth six, divided, shows its subject by firm correctness obtaining good fortune, and having no occasion for repentance. (We see in him) the brightness of a superior man, and the possession of sincerity. There will be good fortune.

The topmost nine, undivided, shows its subject full of confidence and therefore feasting (quietly). There will be no error. (If he) cherish this confidence, till he (is like the fox who) gets his head immersed, it will fail of what is right.

image.image_zh: 火在水上，未濟。君子以慎辨物居方。
image.image_en: Fire over water: The image of the condition before transition. Thus the superior man is careful in the differentiation of things, so that each finds its place.
image.source: Xiang Zhuan (象傳 - Image Commentary), Zhou Yi (周易)
image.image_es: El fuego sobre el agua: La imagen del Antes del Fin. Así el hombre superior es cauteloso en la diferenciación de las cosas, para que cada una ocupe su lugar.
image.image_it: Il fuoco sull'acqua: L'immagine del Prima della Fine. Così l'uomo superiore è cauto nella differenziazione delle cose, affinché ciascuna occupi il suo posto.

tuan.tuan_zh: 未濟亨，柔得中也。小狐汔濟，未出中也。濡其尾，无攸利，不續終也。雖不當位，剛柔應也。
tuan.tuan_en: Wei Ji intimates progress and success (in the circumstances which it implies). The weak (line is in the centre of the figure and) line has the strong lines) in correspondence with it. When the young fox has nearly crossed (the stream), its tail gets immersed. There will be no advantage in any way: this means that there is not a correspondence between the first and the fourth line). Although the positions are not proper ones, there is a correspondence between the strong and weak.
tuan.source: Tuan Zhuan (彖傳 - Commentary on the Decision), Zhou Yi (周易)

lines_zh: 初六：濡其尾，吝。
九二：曳其輪，貞吉。
六三：未濟，征凶，利涉大川。
九四：貞吉，悔亡，震用伐鬼方，三年有賞于大國。
九五：貞吉，無悔，君子之光，有孚，吉。
上九：有孚于飲酒，無咎，濡其首，有孚失是。
lines_en: Six at the beginning: He gets his tail in the water. Humiliating.
Nine in the second place: He brakes his wheels. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Six in the third place: Before completion, attack brings misfortune. It furthers one to cross the great water.
Nine in the fourth place: Perseverance brings good fortune. Remorse disappears. Shock, thus to discipline the Devil's Country. For three years, great realms are awarded.
Six in the fifth place: Perseverance brings good fortune. No remorse. The light of the superior man is true. Good fortune.
Nine at the top: There is drinking of wine in genuine confidence. No blame. But if one wets his head, he loses it, in truth.
64.judgment_es: Éxito. Pero si el pequeño zorro, después de casi completar el cruce, mete su cola en el agua, no hay nada que favoreciera.
64.judgment_it: Successo. Ma se la piccola volpe, dopo aver quasi completato la traversata, mette la coda nell'acqua, non c'è nulla che favorisca.
lines_es: Seis al principio: Mete su cola en el agua. Humillante.
Nueve en el segundo lugar: Él frena sus ruedas. La perseverancia trae buena fortuna.
Seis en el tercer lugar: Antes de la terminación, atacar trae desgracia. Favorece al hombre cruzar la gran agua.
Nueve en el cuarto lugar: La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. El remordimiento desaparece. Shock, así para disciplinar al País del Diablo. Por tres años, grandes reinos son otorgados.
Seis en el quinto lugar: La perseverancia trae buena fortuna. Sin remordimiento. La luz del hombre superior es verdadera. Buena fortuna.
Nueve en lo alto: Hay bebida de vino en genuina confianza. Sin culpa. Pero si uno moja su cabeza, la pierde, en verdad.
lines_it: Sei all'inizio: Mette la coda nell'acqua. Umiliante.
Nove al secondo posto: Egli frena le sue ruote. La perseveranza porta buona fortuna.
Sei al terzo posto: Prima del completamento, attaccare porta sventura. È favorevole all'uomo attraversare la grande acqua.
Nove al quarto posto: La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Il rimorso svanisce. Shock, così per disciplinare il Paese del Diavolo. Per tre anni, grandi regni sono assegnati.
Sei al quinto posto: La perseveranza porta buona fortuna. Nessun rimorso. La luce dell'uomo nobile è vera. Buona fortuna.
Nove in cima: C'è bevuta di vino in genuina fiducia. Nessuna colpa. Ma se uno bagna la testa, la perde, in verità.
